rollCalls.summary: Allows real property owners to petition the Arizona Finance Authority (AFA), until June 30, 2036, to establish a state affordability infrastructure district (district) that is managed by a district board comprised of real property owners in the district and allows a district to issue and sell bonds and levy taxes and assessments. Outlines procedures for district formation petitions, elections, financing, public hearings, governance, powers, dissolution, property disclosures and public infrastructure project review.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: tax returns; late filing; penalties
rollCalls.summary: Retroactive to January 1, 2026, prohibits a late filing penalty from being assessed on a taxpayer if the taxpayer's income tax liability is zero.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: DWR; application; administrative completeness
rollCalls.summary: Allows the court to order a person who is indigent and experiencing homelessness to perform mandatory community restitution in lieu of paying the $20 assessment that is collected for certain violations and deposited into the Judicial Collection Enhancement Fund (Fund).
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: vaccination mandates; masks; prohibition
rollCalls.summary: Prohibits governmental entities from imposing a mask, face covering or vaccination requirement on any Arizona resident.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: bullion depository; state monies; treasurer
rollCalls.summary: Requires the State Treasurer to invest and reinvest up to 10 percent of state trust and treasury monies in physical gold or silver bullion that is held in a commercial depository that meets specified requirements.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: nursing facilities; records; surveys; timelines
rollCalls.summary: Modifies Department of Health Services (DHS) oversight and investigative procedures for nursing care institutions, including personnel record access and complaint investigations.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: identifying information; records; confidentiality
rollCalls.summary: Clarifies that an eligible person may request that the general public be prohibited from accessing that person's identifying information. Specifies that the request to redact a person's identifying information does not prohibit access to an eligible person's voter registration record or unredacted records of a county recorder by statutorily authorized parties.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: public cold plunge; rules; exemption
rollCalls.summary: Excludes single-user public or semipublic cold plunges from rules adopted by the Arizona Department of Environmental Quality (ADEQ) governing water pollution in public or semipublic swimming pools and bathing places.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: business property; theft; penalties; prohibition
rollCalls.summary: Declares the imposition of an ordinance, rule or regulation that penalizes a business for the theft of the movable property of the business to be a matter of statewide concern and preempts further regulation by a municipality or county. Allows the Attorney General (AG) or any business to bring an action regarding the prohibited regulation of the theft of movable property and entitles a business that prevails to reasonable attorney fees and costs.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: candidate petitions; felony disclosure
rollCalls.summary: Requires a health care provider to provide a patient with access to, or copies of, the patient's medical records or payment records within specified timeframes after receiving a written request.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: health boards; licensure decisions; investigation
rollCalls.summary: Prescribes procedures for a health care profession regulatory board (health board) when making a licensing decision that is detrimental to a health professional's continued practice.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: fetal and prenatal development; instruction
rollCalls.summary: Requires the State Board of Education (SBE) to adopt age-appropriate academic standards in the area of science that require prescribed instruction on fetal and prenatal human development.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: statewide assessment; testing window; revisions
rollCalls.summary: Delays the date by which a local education agency (LEA) must receive statewide assessment test scores and data to May 26. Prohibits the statewide assessment testing window for students in grades three through eight from beginning before the second week of April during the school year and removes the authority for the Arizona Department of Education (ADE) to adjust the testing window for the statewide assessment.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: statewide assessment; written form; requirements
rollCalls.summary: Authorizes a school district or charter school to administer the statewide assessment in the form of a written test on approval by a majority vote of the school district governing board or charter school governing body.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: mental health instruction requirement; repeal
rollCalls.summary: Removes the requirement for mental health instruction to incorporate the multiple dimensions of health. Repeals, on January 1, 2037, the statutory requirements on the State Board of Education (SBE) to require all health education instruction to include mental health instruction.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: accumulated sick leave; payments
rollCalls.summary: Appropriates $4,750,000 from the Arizona Highway Patrol Fund (Fund) in FY 2026 to the Department of Public Safety (DPS) and exempts DPS from the statutory prohibition against state agencies employing legal counsel until December 31, 2026.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: driver license instruction permit; age
rollCalls.summary: Effective December 1, 2026, lowers the age at which a person is eligible for an instruction permit for a class D, G or M license from 15 years and 6 months to 15 years old. Increases the number of driving practice hours that a permittee must complete before applying for a class G or M license when the person is between 16 and 18 years old.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: exceptional events; air quality; wildfires
rollCalls.summary: Requires the Arizona Department of Environmental Quality (ADEQ) to submit an exceptional event demonstration to the U.S. Environmental Protection Agency (EPA) if a wildfire that is larger than 25,000 acres occurs on federally managed land and the attributable smoke or land damage affects Arizona.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: grandfathered right; Willcox AMA; extension
rollCalls.summary: Retroactive to January 8, 2025, extends the time period, from no later than 15 months to no later than 27 months after the date of the designation of the Willcox Active Management Area (AMA), in which a person claiming the right to withdraw or receive and use groundwater in the Willcox AMA pursuant to a grandfathered right must apply for a certificate of grandfathered right with the Arizona Department of Water Resources (ADWR).
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: brackish groundwater recovery program
rollCalls.summary: Establishes the Brackish Groundwater Recovery Program Fund (Fund). Requires the Water Infrastructure Finance Authority (WIFA) to administer the Brackish Groundwater Recovery Program and establish minimum criteria for choosing and evaluating outlined projects. Allows monies and other assets in the Long-Term Water Augmentation Fund (LTWAF) to be used for developing one or more brackish groundwater recovery projects that create new sources of potable water within the boundaries of Arizona.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: domestic water improvement districts; hauling
rollCalls.summary: Allows a county improvement district (district) that is formed in a subsequent active management area (AMA) or in a groundwater transportation basin or subbasin, for the purpose of delivering water through water hauling, to exercise the power of eminent domain only for the limited purpose of acquiring or otherwise securing a site in the subsequent AMA or groundwater transportation basin or subbasin for the construction of and legal access to a single well and a standpipe to produce water and make water available at the site for delivery through water hauling.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: water improvements program; water hauling
rollCalls.summary: Modifies the requirements of a water improvements program by allowing persons to make gifts, grants or donations for the purpose of providing financial assistance to qualified owners of residential real property for water hauling, water delivery and by allowing a county with a water improvements program to use the collections from groundwater transportation fees only for qualified owners of residential property who reside within the groundwater transportation basin.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: natural resource conservation board; fund
rollCalls.summary: Caps the annual distribution by the Arizona Natural Resource Conservation Board (Board) to each Natural Resource Conservation District (NRCD) with an established education center at $10,000 and requires the Board, rather than the Arizona State Land Department (ASLD), to disburse annual donations in the Environmental Special Plate Fund for environmental education programs.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: sexual material; consent; synthetic depiction
rollCalls.summary: Requires commercial entities that publish or distribute sexual material on the internet to obtain age and consent verification from individuals depicted in the material. Subjects commercial entities that do not obtain such verification to civil liability for damages.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: attorney general; nuisance action; damages
rollCalls.summary: Subjects the Attorney General (AG) to liability for damages to an injured defendant in a public nuisance action or a consumer fraud action that meets outlined criteria.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: processing arrestees; veteran status
rollCalls.summary: Requires the court to inquire as to a person's veteran status at the person's initial appearance hearing and to notify the prosecuting agency if the person is a veteran. Requires the prosecuting agency to consider referring the person to the veterans' court, other treatment court or diversion program.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: Arizona geological survey; analysis; division
rollCalls.summary: Transfers the Resource Analysis Division of the Arizona State Land Department (ASLD) from the ASLD to the Arizona Geological Survey and requires the State Geologist to collaborate with the ASLD to fulfill the duties of the Resource Analysis Division of the Arizona Geological Survey and advise the ASLD on request.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: county seal; authority; sheriff's posse
rollCalls.summary: Expands the procedures and requirements to authorize a person to use, display or otherwise employ a county seal to include the logo, insignia or another visual or textual identifier of the county or county office, as prescribed. Grants the exclusive right to name a posse associated with the county sheriff's office and dissolve a posse that operates under the county sheriff's jurisdiction to each county sheriff.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: financial assurance; reclamation; escrow; trusts
rollCalls.summary: Adds cash deposits with a third-party escrow or trust account to the list of statutorily prescribed allowable financial assurance mechanisms for owners and operators of exploration operations, mining units and aggregate mining units who create surface disturbances.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: schools; weapons detection systems; administration
rollCalls.summary: Allows, if a school district or charter school has a weapons detection system, the school district governing board (governing board) or charter school governing body (governing body) to authorize the school district superintendent or highest-ranking charter school officer to modify the weapons detection system without prior approval. Requires a school district superintendent or the highest-ranking charter school officer to report each modification within 24 hours after the modification is made.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: school facilities oversight board; members
rollCalls.summary: Modifies eligibility requirements for the School Facilities Oversight Board (SFOB) members who are a registered professional engineer and a registered professional architect by specifying that such members' business may not include school construction.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: public monies; genetic sequencing; prohibition
rollCalls.summary: Prohibits the expenditure of public monies to pay for genetic sequencing procedures performed using a device produced by a company domiciled in a foreign adversary or by a company owned or substantially controlled by a company domiciled in a foreign adversary.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: schools; clubs; organizations; parental consent
rollCalls.summary: Prohibits a public school from allowing any student in grades six, seven or eight to participate in or join a student club or organization without first obtaining written parental permission. Outlines requirements for communication with parents when requesting parental permission for a student's participation.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: manslaughter; online advice; encouragement
rollCalls.summary: Specifies that the manslaughter criminal classification applies to a person who is at least 18 years old and who intentionally provides advice or encouragement, through a directed communication, that a minor uses to die by suicide with the knowledge that the minor intends to die by suicide.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: sexual extortion; classification
rollCalls.summary: Classifies sexual extortion as a class 2 felony, rather than a class 3 felony, if the offender is at least 18 years old and knows or should have known that the victim is 15, 16 or 17 years old. Requires the sentence for sexual extortion in this circumstance to run consecutively to any other sentence imposed.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: insurance; bona fide associations; qualifications
rollCalls.summary: Modifies requirements to qualify as a bona fide association. Specifies that a statewide chamber of commerce and statewide business league that meets specified criteria is not prohibited from operating a self-funded multiple employer welfare arrangement (MEWA). Requires, subject to available monies, the Arizona Department of Administration (ADOA) to conduct a feasibility study on state employee and public school district employee health insurance plans in Arizona and outlines requirements for the feasibility study.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: federal nullification; Mexican wolf; reintroduction
rollCalls.summary: Prohibits the state, any agency or political subdivision of Arizona and any employee of Arizona or an agency or political subdivision of Arizona acting in the employee's official capacity from using any personnel or financial resources to enforce, administer or cooperate with the Mexican Wolf Reintroduction Program under the Endangered Species Act.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: small modular reactors; zoning; approval
rollCalls.summary: Prohibits county ordinances from restricting the use of land for the construction of a small modular reactor (SMR) if, prior to the construction, the SMR provides evidence of adherence to outlined federal site permits and design certifications to the corresponding county board of supervisors (county BOS).
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: obstructing governmental operations; lawful arrest
rollCalls.summary: Expands the criminal classification of obstructing governmental operations to include knowingly obstructing, impairing or hindering the making of a lawful arrest by using or threatening to use violence or physical force and classifies a violation as a class 5 felony.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: public bodies; executive sessions; agenda
rollCalls.summary: Prohibits a public body from placing any proposal that imposes or increases a tax or fee on a consent agenda. Requires any matter that is discussed in executive session that requires a final vote to be placed on the regular agenda.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: CAP water; state land; allocation
rollCalls.summary: Requires the Arizona State Land Department (ASLD), within 120 days of the general effective date, to initiate a public stakeholder process to adopt a procedure for allocating outlined Central Arizona Project (CAP) water that is currently allocated to the ASLD to parcels of state trust land that may be sold or leased.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: sample ballots; mailing date
rollCalls.summary: Requires a county board of supervisors (county BOS) to mail printed mailer-type sample ballots for both primary and general elections at least 14 days before an election, rather than 11 days before an election, in counties that do not contain a United States Postal Service (USPS) Processing and Distribution Center.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: digital goods; seller's requirements; enforcement
rollCalls.summary: Outlines unlawful advertising practices for digital goods. Provides for enforcement of the digital goods advertising requirements in accordance with the Arizona Consumer Fraud Act.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: assured water supply; commingling
rollCalls.summary: Allows the Director of the Arizona Department of Water Resources (ADWR), for the purpose of determining whether sufficient groundwater, surface water or effluent of adequate quality will be continuously available to satisfy the water needs of the proposed use, to consider only the proposed source or sources of the supply dedicated to the proposed use regardless of whether the water is distributed through a water delivery system that is commingled with other sources of water supply.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: water conservation grant fund; disclosure
rollCalls.summary: Prescribes disclosure requirements for an eligible entity applying for a grant from the Water Conservation Grant Fund (Fund) that receives water from a multi-county water conservation district.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: annual probation review; prehearing; notification
rollCalls.summary: Adds prehearings for probation reviews of certain probationers to the probation hearings for which notification must be provided to specified individuals.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: radiologic technologists; radiologist assistants
rollCalls.summary: Modifies Department of Health Services (DHS) standards regarding radiologic technologists and radiologic assistants, including radiologic technology school approvals, certification requirements and supervision requirements.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: Buffalo Soldiers Arizona territory monument
rollCalls.summary: Authorizes the Legislative Council to provide for the placement of a memorial dedicated to the commemoration of Buffalo Soldiers in the Wesley Bolin Plaza.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: ASRS; premium payment
rollCalls.summary: Defines active employee group health and accident insurance program for the purposes of clarifying which individuals are entitled to receive a health insurance premium subsidy.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: ASRS; long-term disability
rollCalls.summary: Allows an Arizona State Retirement System (ASRS) member to continue receiving long term disability (LTD) benefits after 24 months of being unable to perform work duties while under the direct care of a physician and also receiving LTD benefits, regardless of whether the 24 months occur within a five-year period.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: ASRS; eligibility waiver
rollCalls.summary: Allows a person to waive participation in the Arizona State Retirement System (ASRS) if the person becomes eligible for participation after turning 65 years old.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: county water augmentation authorities; bond
rollCalls.summary: Outlines requirements for a county water augmentation authority (authority) to issue revenue bonds, hold public hearings relating to the issuance of revenue bonds and enter into loan repayment agreements with the Water Infrastructure Finance Authority (WIFA).
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: board of technical registration; qualifications
rollCalls.summary: Clarifies the qualifications for registration as a professional engineer, architect, land surveyor or landscape architect with the Arizona State Board of Technical Registration (AZBTR) through reciprocity or endorsement.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: venue; employee conflict; superior court
rollCalls.summary: Grants a party to a civil action pending in the superior court the right to a change of venue when a party to the action is an employee of the judicial branch or the clerk of the superior court in the county where the action is pending and specified conditions are met.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: fentanyl; possession; sale; amount; sentencing
rollCalls.summary: Reduces, from 200 grams to 100 grams, the amount of fentanyl that must be involved in specified offenses for enhanced criminal sentencing ranges to apply.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: firefighters; employment status
rollCalls.summary: Defines firefighter for the purposes of workers' compensation coverage while traveling directly to or from work as a firefighter.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: property tax errors; electronic communications
rollCalls.summary: Allows a tax officer to accept an electronic response to a notice of proposed property tax correction or notice of claim from a taxpayer and to provide related communications electronically, unless the communication is required to be served by certified mail.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: health facilities; licensure; complaints; investigations
rollCalls.summary: Modifies the criteria under which the Department of Health Services (DHS) may deny a health care institution license or change of ownership. Establishes requirements and procedures for DHS complaint investigations, compliance inspections and the issuance and dispute of statements of deficiencies.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: AHCCCS; waivers; American Indians; services
rollCalls.summary: Requires the Director of the Arizona Health Care Cost Containment System (AHCCCS) to annually apply for a federal waiver to authorize Medicaid payments for certain services provided to American Indian and Alaska Native (AI/AN) members through Indian Health Service (IHS) facilities or other facilities operated by tribes or tribal organizations under the Indian Self-Determination and Education Assistance Act (638 facilities) that were eliminated or reduced during or after September 2010.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: agency; chief medical officer; license
rollCalls.summary: Requires any person serving as a chief medical officer for a state agency to possess an active license to practice medicine.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: air ambulance services
rollCalls.summary: Defines air ambulance and conforms statutes relating to the regulation of ambulances to include air ambulances.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: tourism advisory council; representation
rollCalls.summary: Modifies the representation for the Tourism Advisory Council (Council) by adding La Paz County to an area that currently consists of Mohave and Yuma County.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: property tax; agricultural real property
rollCalls.summary: Specifies that the class 2 property subclassification that consists of real property and improvements includes property used as agricultural real property, rather than property used for agricultural purposes. Requires property classified as agricultural real property, rather than land used for agricultural purposes, to be valued using only the income approach to value without any allowance for urban or market influences.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: qualified marketplace contractors; employment
rollCalls.summary: Specifies the requirements for termination of a contract between a qualified marketplace contractor and a qualified marketplace platform.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: warranties; leased vehicles; lessee; definition
rollCalls.summary: Modifies the definition of consumer , under the Arizona Motor Vehicle Warranties Act, to include a lessee of a motor vehicle.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: fire code; municipalities; county buildings
rollCalls.summary: Authorizes a city or town, under prescribed conditions, to request the Office of the State Fire Marshall (Office) to enter into an intergovernmental agreement with a county to enforce the fire code adopted by the city or town for county-owned buildings.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: fitness program; school report cards
rollCalls.summary: Establishes the Arizona School Fitness Program (Fitness Program) in the Arizona Department of Education (ADE) to recognize public schools that elect to participate in a nationally recognized physical fitness test or event.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: emissions; reduction credits; counties
rollCalls.summary: Allows a county to claim concurrent jurisdiction over components of a portable source and mobile sources within the county jurisdiction for the sole purpose of issuing, revising or enforcing a permit for emission reduction credits (ERCs).
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: local regulation; prohibition; unmanned aircraft
rollCalls.summary: Modifies the prohibition on unmanned aircraft regulations by a city, town or county.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: timeshare salespersons; licensure
rollCalls.summary: Adds alternative pathways for a person to become certified as a veterinary technician.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: dangerous crimes against children; probation
rollCalls.summary: Prohibits the early termination or modification of a period of probation that is imposed in a conviction for a dangerous crime against children (DCAC) on or after January 1, 2027.
rollCalls.question: Final Reading

rollCalls.title: tax corrections act of 2026
rollCalls.summary: Corrects errors and obsolete language, addresses blending problems and provides clarifying changes to tax statutes.
rollCalls.question: Final Reading

rollCalls.title: deeds; identification; forgery; notice; notaries
rollCalls.summary: Modifies statutes relating to deeds evidencing a transfer of title to real property, including requirements addressing recordings, notifications and forgeries.
rollCalls.question: Final Reading

rollCalls.title: school libraries; professional associations; prohibitions
rollCalls.summary: Prohibits a public school library from using public monies to pay a professional association that promotes, supports and advocates for libraries, librarians and information services. Designates this legislation as the Library Freedom Act .
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: public educational institutions; adoption information
rollCalls.summary: Requires a public educational institution to provide information relating to current adoption practices in the United States to students if an employee discusses or dispenses contraception or discusses or provides testing for sexually transmitted diseases (STDs) or sexually transmitted infections (STIs). Adds instructional requirements relating to adoption that each school district and charter school must include in the school district's or charter school's sex education curricula.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: special plate; centennial; fleet discount
rollCalls.summary: Lowers the registration and renewal fee for the Arizona Centennial Special Plate for vehicles registered in a registered fleet.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: school districts; employment contracts; publication
rollCalls.summary: Requires each school district governing board (governing board) to submit to the Arizona Department of Education (ADE) a copy of the employment contract for each superintendent, assistant superintendent, associate superintendent (district superintendent) or chief financial officer (CFO) employed by the school district as outlined. Directs ADE to create a searchable online database that contains specified information from each submitted employment contract. Outlines posting and reporting requirements on ADE and each governing board.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: property tax exemption; disability; determination
rollCalls.summary: Adds a U.S. Social Security Administration (SSA) determination letter to the items that may be used to certify a person's disability for the purposes of determining eligibility for a property tax exemption.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: trafficking weapons or explosives
rollCalls.summary: Prohibits a person who is convicted of trafficking three or more weapons or explosives in one or multiple offenses from being eligible for suspension of sentence, probation, pardon or release on any basis until the sentence is served.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: insurance; modeling organizations; predictive models
rollCalls.summary: Renames advisory organizations as model and data organizations and applies the advisory organizations statutory authorities and requirements to model and data organizations. Removes the authority of the Director of the Department of Insurance and Financial Institutions (DIFI) to examine these organizations.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: department of education; reporting requirements
rollCalls.summary: Requires the Arizona Department of Education (ADE) to review statutory reporting requirements on public schools and ADE to identify requirements that are duplicative, expired or otherwise obsolete. Requires ADE, by December 1, 2026, to submit a report as outlined that includes a summary of the review and recommendations for legislative action to repeal or modify duplicative, expired or obsolete requirements. Repeals the outlined requirements on ADE on July 1, 2029.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: name change petition; sex offenders
rollCalls.summary: Outlines additional requirements for individuals required to register as sex offenders who apply for a change of name.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: teachers academy; community college students
rollCalls.summary: Increases the maximum number of academic years, from two to four, and semesters, from four to eight, that a community college student may participate in the Arizona Teachers Academy (Academy). Contains requirements for enactment for initiatives and referendums (Proposition 105).
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: mining; mineral; museum; state history
rollCalls.summary: Requires the University of Arizona (U of A), in coordination with the Mining, Mineral and Natural Resources Education Museum Advisory Council (Council), to promote the history of Arizona and the importance of the Five C's.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: truth in taxation; bonds; notices
rollCalls.summary: Adds the tax rate and estimated cost associated with each proposed capital improvement for a single-family home valued at $300,000 to the information required to be included in an informational pamphlet for certain budget override and bond elections. Adds the estimated tax impact of an increase in property taxes on a home valued at $300,000 to the information required to be included in a statutorily required Truth in Taxation hearing notice of tax increase (TNT notice).
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: school districts; leases; housing development
rollCalls.summary: Amends Laws 2014, Chapter 259, which established trampoline court regulations, to designate the legislation as Ty's Law .
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: technical correction; national guard
rollCalls.summary: Allows the Arizona Department of Corrections, Rehabilitation and Reentry (ADCRR) to store an inmate's medical records electronically and allows ADCRR to dispose of any physical copies of an inmate's medical records if the medical records are stored electronically.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: firearm destruction
rollCalls.summary: Outlines requirements relating to the enforceability of postnuptial agreements.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: social credit; use; prohibition
rollCalls.summary: Prohibits the state from requiring a bank or financial institution to use a social credit score when evaluating whether to lend money to a customer.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: campaign committees; termination statements; contributions

rollCalls.summary: Allows a person to carry a concealed handgun on the premises of a restaurant licensee, provided that the person has a concealed carry weapon permit (CCW) and does not consume spirituous liquor and the restaurant has no other licenses attached to the premises. Modifies liabilities and legal obligations for licensees and employees of restaurants that must allow for the carrying of concealed handguns on licensed premises.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: probation; immigration enforcement; court notification
rollCalls.summary: Assigns the responsibility to immediately notify a federal authority of a person who is unlawfully present in the United States to the convicting court and the state or local agency that discharges the person from imprisonment or assesses a monetary obligation and bars such a person from being eligible for probation.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: missing; kidnapped children; reporting requirements
rollCalls.summary: Restructures and prescribes additional mandatory reporting requirements for a law enforcement agency (LEA) that receives a report of a missing, kidnapped or runaway child and requires each LEA to develop and conduct training on those requirements. Requires LEA employee training regarding the Seek and Find Alert to be conducted biennially, rather than biannually.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: immigration laws; local enforcement; training
rollCalls.summary: Prescribes requirements for state and local cooperation with federal immigration authorities and the enforcement of federal immigration laws that include entering into memorandums of agreement (MOAs) to train law enforcement, establishing state preemptions and investigating violations.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: commercial vehicles; operator; lawful presence
rollCalls.summary: Prohibits a commercial motor vehicle operator who is issued a nondomiciled commercial driver license (CDL) from operating in Arizona without evidence of lawful immigration status or lawful presence in the United States, prescribes penalties for failing to provide evidence that may include placing the driver out-of-service and impounding the vehicle and its cargo, and outlines procedures for out-of-service orders, the retrieval of impounded vehicles and cargo and the payment of related charges and fees.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: ultralight vehicles; definition
rollCalls.summary: Defines ultralight vehicle and modifies the definition of advanced air mobility to include an ultralight vehicle.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: judicial determinations; religious sectarian laws
rollCalls.summary: Prohibits a court from relying on religious sectarian law as controlling or persuasive authority.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: early voters; signature comparison; MVD
rollCalls.summary: Requires the Arizona Department of Transportation (ADOT) to provide the Secretary of State (SOS) with a copy of an applicant's signature that was written by hand on a document.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: elections; foreign contributions prohibited
rollCalls.summary: Prohibits foreign corporations, persons and nongovernmental sources from contributing monies or in-kind goods or services to influence the outcome of an election on a ballot measure.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: digital assets strategic reserve fund
rollCalls.summary: Establishes the Digital Assets Strategic Reserve Fund (Fund), administered by the State Treasurer, and consisting of digital assets held by, confiscated by or surrendered to the state. Allows the State Treasurer to invest the total amount of monies deposited in the Fund in any fiscal year and to loan digital assets from the Fund, if the loan does not increase financial risk to the state.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: signatures required; nomination petitions
rollCalls.summary: Requires a nomination petition for a candidate for constable in Maricopa or Pima county to be signed by at least 1 percent of the number of qualified signers in a justice precinct, or at least 1,000 signatures, whichever is less.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: marijuana smoke; public; private nuisance
rollCalls.summary: Deems the creation of excessive marijuana smoke or odor as a public and private nuisance.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: elections; voting centers; polling places
rollCalls.summary: Requires voting centers to be established in addition to, rather than in place of, specifically designated polling places. Requires a state, county, city, town or school district office and schools within a school district (district schools) with a gymnasium to provide sufficient space for use as a polling place and requires district schools to close on an election day.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: elections; foreign contributions; prohibition
rollCalls.summary: Subject to voter approval, statutorily prohibits foreign nationals from contributing monies or in-kind goods or services to influence the outcome of an election on a ballot measure.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: independent redistricting commission; membership
rollCalls.summary: Subject to voter approval, constitutionally renames the Independent Redistricting Commission (IRC) as the Fair and Independent Redistricting Commission (FAIR Commission). Outlines requirements for the FAIR Commission membership and increases the membership from five members to nine members. Prohibits the population of the largest legislative district from exceeding the smallest legislative district by more than 5,000 persons.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: general election day; all offices
rollCalls.summary: Subject to voter approval, constitutionally requires that a general election for city, town and school district officials must take place on the first Tuesday after the first Monday in November of every even numbered year.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: public; private nuisance; marijuana smoke
rollCalls.summary: Subject to voter approval, statutorily deems the creation of excessive marijuana smoke or odor as a public and private nuisance.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: appropriation; Arizona trail fund
rollCalls.summary: Grants a resident of a long-term care facility or the resident's authorized representative the right to conduct electronic monitoring of the resident's room and establishes requirements relating to terms and conditions of use.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: rural hospitals; radiation protection grants
rollCalls.summary: Appropriates $3 million in FY 2027 from the state General Fund (state GF) to the Department of Health Services (DHS) to establish a grant program to assist rural hospitals with the costs of installing radiation protection systems in cardiac catheterization procedure rooms.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: cardiac emergency response plans; schools
rollCalls.summary: Requires each school district and charter school to submit a report to the Arizona Department of Education (ADE) that contains outlined information relating to cardiac emergency preparedness by November 1, 2026, and requires ADE to submit and post a summary and the compiled reports as outlined by December 1, 2026. Appropriates $1,000,000 from the state General Fund (state GF) in FY 2027 to ADE for the outlined reports and for public schools to purchase and maintain automated external defibrillators (AEDs).
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: expungement of misdemeanor records
rollCalls.summary: Effective January 1, 2027, allows a person to petition the court for an expungement of case records involving a misdemeanor offense after a specified amount of time has passed and if the person meets all other prescribed criteria.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: appropriation; lapsing exemption; Yuma county
rollCalls.summary: Exempts the $750,000 appropriation included in the FY 2026 General Appropriations Act to the Department of Public Safety (DPS) for the Yuma County Family Advocacy Center from lapsing.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: nonoperating identification; fees; homeless exemption
rollCalls.summary: Expands the list of persons who are exempt from the nonoperating identification license fees and establishes an expiration date of eight years, except as otherwise prescribed, for nonoperating identification licenses issued after the general effective date.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: Alzheimer's disease state plan; appropriation
rollCalls.summary: Requires the Department of Health Services (DHS) to establish a dementia services program and develop an Alzheimer's disease state plan (plan). Appropriates $600,000 in FY 2027 from the Health Services Lottery Monies Fund to DHS for the dementia services program and the plan.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: prepaid capitated contractors; cost reports
rollCalls.summary: Requires, by December 1 of each year, the Arizona Health Care Cost Containment System (AHCCCS) to report the percentage of monies all nongovernment entities that have a prepaid capitated contract with AHCCCS spent in the previous contract year on direct payments to providers for services and administrative costs, by category, to specified officials.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: appropriation; barbering and cosmetology board
rollCalls.summary: Appropriates $235,500 and three full-time equivalent positions (FTEs) from the Barbering and Cosmetology Fund to the Arizona Barbering and Cosmetology Board (Board) for salaries and operational costs.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: barbering and cosmetology board; continuation
rollCalls.summary: Continues the Arizona Barbering and Cosmetology Board (Board) for eight years. Adjusts the statutory caps on fees issued by the Board.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: electronic monitoring; long-term care
rollCalls.summary: Requires, by December 1, 2026, or on initial licensure, assisted living facilities and nursing care institutions to disclose to the Department of Health Services (DHS) the facility's policies regarding the use of electronic monitoring devices and other monitoring technology in resident rooms, personal spaces and common areas and to notify DHS of any subsequent policy updates.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: appropriation; schools; community gardens
rollCalls.summary: Appropriates $500,000 from the state General Fund (state GF) in FY 2027 to the Arizona Department of Education (ADE) to award grants to school districts and charter schools to build community gardens.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: behavioral health; contracts; network adequacy
rollCalls.summary: Requires managed care organizations (MCOs) contracted with the Arizona Health Care Cost Containment System (AHCCCS), including Arizona Long Term Care System (ALTCS) program contractors and regional behavioral health authorities (RBHAs), to provide written notice to AHCCCS at least 90 days before terminating a high-volume service provider's contract without cause and prohibits termination unless AHCCS determines network adequacy standards will continue to be met. Establishes requirements relating to network adequacy studies and AHCCCS review.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: appropriation; crime victim notification fund
rollCalls.summary: Appropriates $5,000,000 from the state General Fund (state GF) in FY 2027 to the Law Enforcement Crime Victim Notification Fund (Fund).
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: ADE; special education; parent complaints
rollCalls.summary: Allows the Division of Special Education (Division) within the Arizona Department of Education (ADE) to assist individuals who file a complaint alleging that a school district or charter school has violated federal or state law relating to children with disabilities. Requires ADE to adopt policies and procedures for complaints filed with the Division as outlined and post all state complaint investigative reports on ADE's website 90 days after completing an investigation.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: dangerous crimes against children; probation
rollCalls.summary: Prohibits the early termination or modification of a period of probation that is imposed in a conviction for a dangerous crime against children (DCAC) on or after January 1, 2027.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: stem cells; birth tissue; therapy
rollCalls.summary: Establishes regulations governing the use of stem cell and regenerative therapies that are not approved by the U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA).
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: appropriation; Douglas port of entry
rollCalls.summary: Appropriates $30,723,600 from the state General Fund (state GF) in FY 2027 to the State Treasurer to distribute to the City of Douglas for the state match of the Douglas port of entry.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: ABOR; foreign countries; restrictions; penalties
rollCalls.summary: Requires the Arizona Board of Regents (ABOR) to require each public university to adopt a research security policy that promotes a security culture, furthers national security interests and mitigates threats to the integrity and conduct of the public university's research against malign foreign influence. Outlines processes that a research security policy must include and reporting requirements on ABOR relating to the research security policy.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: public safety employees; counseling; wellness
rollCalls.summary: Authorizes wellness programs for law enforcement agency (LEA) employees and crisis response services programs for public safety employees, outlines requirements for the programs and protects specified activities and communications from disclosure, except as specified.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: social workers; documentation; dialysis centers
rollCalls.summary: Prescribes documentation requirements for social workers that provide dialysis services at an outpatient treatment center.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: off-highway vehicles; weight
rollCalls.summary: Increases, from 2,500 pounds to 3,500 pounds, the maximum unladen weight of an all-terrain vehicle (ATV) that must register for a resident or nonresident off-highway vehicle (OHV) user indicia. Sets the vehicle license tax (VLT) for an ATV or OHV that has an unladen weight of more than 2,500 pounds but less than 3,501 pounds at 50 percent of the statutorily prescribed VLT and directs the prescribed VLT collections into the Off-Highway Vehicle Laws Enforcement Fund (Fund).
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: schools; prohibition; unmanned aircraft
rollCalls.summary: Prohibits a person from operating or using an unmanned aircraft or unmanned aircraft system to intentionally photograph or loiter within 200 feet above a school that provides instruction to students in kindergarten programs or grades 1-12 (K-12), if specified conditions apply.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: home; community-based services; mental illness
rollCalls.summary: Establishes the Seriously Mentally Ill Enhanced Residential Treatment Pilot Program (Pilot Program) in the Arizona Health Care Cost Containment System (AHCCCS) to provide, with federal approval, enhanced residential treatment services for adults who are determined to be seriously mentally ill (SMI), operated by and administered through contractors. Outlines Pilot Program coverage, eligibility, capacity, appeals and grievances processes and reporting requirements.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: landownership; foreign adversary; prohibition
rollCalls.summary: An emergency measure that expands the prohibition on a foreign adversary nation or a foreign adversary agent from directly or indirectly purchasing, owning, acquiring or otherwise obtaining a substantial interest in real property in Arizona to include leasing, obtaining a concession or otherwise obtaining a current or future substantial interest.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: Charlie Kirk; Don Bolles; memorial
rollCalls.summary: Renames the Wesley Bolin Memorial Plaza as the Wesley Bolin and Charlie Kirk Freedom Plaza . Authorizes the Legislative Council to provide for the placement of a Don Bolles Memorial and Charlie Kirk Memorial in the Wesley Bolin and Charlie Kirk Freedom Plaza.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: equal parenting time; best interests
rollCalls.summary: Requires the court to presume that equal parenting time is in the best interests of a child when prescribed conditions are met. Outlines requirements relating to the court's decision in awarding or denying equal parenting time.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: local excise taxes; rate limit
rollCalls.summary: Caps at 2.5 percent, for cities and towns with a population of 550,000 persons or more, the transaction privilege tax (TPT) or excise tax rate that may be imposed on each TPT classification. Requires a city or town to submit any proposed increase in a TPT or excise tax to the voters and exempts a TPT or excise tax rate approved by voters from the tax rate cap. Requires the Attorney General (AG) to withhold state shared revenues from a city or town that violates the tax rate cap or voter approval requirements.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: appropriation; wayfinding signs; rural communities
rollCalls.summary: Conditional on the enactment of S.B. 1827, appropriates $500,000 from the Advanced Air Mobility Fund (Fund) in FY 2027 to the Office of Advanced Air Mobility for operation and support.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: vertiport; definition; designations
rollCalls.summary: Establishes the Office of Advanced Air Mobility (Office) and outlines requirements relating to the Office. Appropriates $500,000 from the Advanced Air Mobility Fund (Fund) in FY 2027 to the Office to grant to entities for the advancement of advanced air mobility in Arizona.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: probation; dangerous crimes against children
rollCalls.summary: An emergency measure that prohibits the early termination or modification of a period of probation that is imposed on a defendant who is convicted of a dangerous crime against children (DCAC), unless the offense was committed when the defendant was under 18 years old.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: solar radiation management; prohibition; enforcement
rollCalls.summary: Prohibits a person from intentionally injecting, releasing or dispensing or causing the injection, release or dispensation of any material within Arizona for solar radiation management, which is the modification or attempted modification of atmospheric reflectivity that modifies the amount or intensity of sunlight that reaches the Earth.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: patriotic youth groups; school access.
rollCalls.summary: Authorizes a public school principal (principal) to allow representatives from a recognized patriotic youth group to address students during regular school hours in the first quarter of an academic school year. Allows a principal to accept materials provided by the patriotic youth group for distribution to students and prohibits a public school from discriminating against, or denying access to, any patriotic youth group that wishes to conduct a meeting.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: cosmetics sales; animal testing; prohibitions
rollCalls.summary: Deems it unlawful for a manufacturer to knowingly sell or offer for sale, in Arizona, a cosmetic that used cosmetic animal testing during the development or manufacture of the cosmetic and subjects a manufacturer that violates the prohibition on cosmetic animal testing to a civil penalty of up to $1,000 for the first day of the violation and an additional civil penalty of $500 for each day the violation continues.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: DCS cases; attorney appearances
rollCalls.summary: Prohibits an attorney representing the Department of Child Safety (DCS) in specified cases from appearing before a judge whom the attorney has already appeared before in any of DCS' previous five cases.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: home confinement; eligibility; electronic monitoring.
rollCalls.summary: Establishes a home confinement program (program) for eligible inmates.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: workers' compensation; death benefits; remarriage
rollCalls.summary: Establishes workers' compensation death benefit payment requirements for the surviving spouse of a first responder, including allowing the surviving spouse to receive death benefit payments until their death. Applies the death benefit eligibility to spouses of first responders who lost benefits due to remarriage on or after January 1, 2000, only for prospective benefit payments.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: DCS; periodic review hearing; report
rollCalls.summary: Requires the Department of Child Safety (DCS) to file a fact-based written report with the court and provide the report to all parties at least 15 days before a periodic review hearing.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: ALTCS; providers; change of ownership
rollCalls.summary: Outlines change of ownership procedures for licensed skilled nursing facilities and assisted living facilities to continue processing claims for services rendered to Arizona Long-Term Care System (ALTCS) members.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: EMS reciprocity; compact.
rollCalls.summary: Adopts the Emergency Medical Services Personnel Licensure Interstate Compact (Compact), allowing emergency medical service (EMS) personnel, such as emergency medical technicians (EMTs), advanced emergency medical technicians (AEMTs) and paramedics, in participating states to obtain licensure in any other Compact state.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: sex offenders; statute of limitations
rollCalls.summary: Adds failing to register as a sex offender to the list of offenses for which there is an unlimited statute of limitations and a prosecution may be commenced at any time.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: probation success incentive payments; calculation
rollCalls.summary: Excludes probationers who are convicted of a dangerous crime against children (DCAC) from being included in the calculation that determines probation success incentive payments to counties.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: public schools; interoperable communications; requirements
rollCalls.summary: Requires each school district and charter school that receives monies from the state or a local law enforcement agency (LEA) for interoperable communications to establish and maintain interoperable communications capabilities that include specified mechanisms to notify and communicate with local LEAs during a school emergency. Outlines reporting requirements on public schools and the Arizona Department of Education (ADE) relating to the requirement to maintain interoperable communications capabilities.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: medicaid; dental benefit study committee
rollCalls.summary: Prohibits a health insurer that issues, amends or renews a subscription contract from imposing a reimbursement rate for a certified registered nurse anesthetist (CRNA) that differs from the reimbursement rate for a physician.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: crimes against children; probation; monitoring
rollCalls.summary: Requires, rather than allows, the court to impose a fee on a probationer to offset the cost of a required monitoring device.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: corporation commission; small modular reactors
rollCalls.summary: Allows a utility, after providing 30 days written notice to the Arizona Corporation Commission (ACC), to construct small modular reactor (SMR) in Arizona without filing an application or receiving a certificate of environmental compatibility if the new SMR is co-located with an extra high load factor customer.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: WICHE; continuation
rollCalls.summary: Continues the Western Interstate Commission for Higher Education (WICHE) for 10 years.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: school districts; bonds; overrides; ballots
rollCalls.summary: Prescribes required ballot language for elections relating to a school district budget override continuation or a school district's authority to continue issuing and selling bonds that states the estimated average secondary property tax reduction if voters reject the override or bond proposal.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: pharmacy board; civil penalties
rollCalls.summary: Caps certain civil penalties the Arizona State Board of Pharmacy (ASBP) may issue upon a licensee or permittee within a six-month period.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: school mapping data; requirements; accessibility
rollCalls.summary: Establishes the School Mapping Data Program (Program) and School Mapping Data Program Fund (Program Fund) to facilitate efficient emergency responses on school campuses and outlines requirements for Program administration, Program participation and the award of grants.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: agencies; statutory authority
rollCalls.summary: Expands the scope of review by the Administrative Rules Oversight Committee (Committee) to include determining whether a statute, rule, agency practice or substantive policy statement is beyond an agency's statutory authority.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: vulnerable adults; theft; definitions
rollCalls.summary: Modifies the definitions of vulnerable adult and position of trust and confidence as the terms relate to a person who commits theft against a vulnerable adult.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: industrial commission; revisions
rollCalls.summary: Makes various changes relating to the regulatory statutes governing the Industrial Commission of Arizona (ICA).
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: peace officer fund; commission; repeal
rollCalls.summary: Renames the Peace Officer Training Equipment Fund ( Training Equipment Fund ) as the Public Safety De-Escalation and Life Safety Fund and repeals the Training Equipment Fund Advisory Commission (Commission).
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: assisted living; notice; study committee
rollCalls.summary: Establishes the Vulnerable Adult System Study Committee and outlines membership, duties and reporting requirements. Requires assisted living facility discharge or eviction notices to provide a statement of the resident's rights.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: business entities; licensees; exemptions
rollCalls.summary: Exempts dental schools, dental therapy schools and dental hygiene schools from the Arizona State Board of Dental Examiners (BODEX) registration requirements.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: performance audits; auditor general
rollCalls.summary: Requires the Auditor General (OAG), if requested by the Joint Legislative Audit Committee (JLAC), to conduct performance audits of an agency or political subdivision to determine whether the required terms and conditions are being met.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: absence; state elected officials
rollCalls.summary: Requires the Governor to choose a member of the executive department to be excused during the inauguration of state elected officials and any address where the members of the executive department are in attendance. Requires the Department of Public Safety (DPS) to establish a protective detail to protect the excused elected official and prescribes requirements for the protective detail.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: family court; attorney fees; cap
rollCalls.summary: Requires the court to award attorney fees from the community assets of the parties in a marital or domestic relations proceeding, except when there are no community assets the court may award attorney fees in an amount up to 15 percent of a party's disposable income or $8,000, whichever is greater.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: in-state custodial interference; penalty
rollCalls.summary: Effective January 1, 2027, establishes the criminal classification of in-state custodial interference .
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: disposition; remains; authorization; legal decision-making
rollCalls.summary: Modifies the requirements relating to the duty for funeral and disposition arrangements of a minor decedent.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: sexual offenses; victim; evidence
rollCalls.summary: Requires evidence of a victim's specific sexual activity to show the source or origin of physical injury, rather than trauma, when considering whether such evidence relating to the victim's prior sexual conduct is admissible.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: health facilities; group homes; resident information
rollCalls.summary: Prescribes criteria for the Department of Health Services (DHS) to conduct an investigation into a health care institution if a patient's or resident's do-not-resuscitate order is not followed after requested emergency medical services. Reestablishes the Vulnerable Adult System Study Committee (Study Committee).
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: victims' rights; opt in process
rollCalls.summary: Requires a victim to opt in only once to be able to exercise the victim's rights and receive victim notifications from all applicable state agencies and for all proceedings and events related to the victim's case as prescribed.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: water storage facility; withdrawals; area
rollCalls.summary: Requires the Director of the Arizona Department of Water Resources (ADWR), if a recovery well permit applicant foregoes submitting a separate hydrologic study and the well is located within outlined locations, to assume the recovery well is located within the stored water’s area of impact.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: artificial intelligence; content verification
rollCalls.summary: Effective February 2, 2027, requires certain providers of generative artificial intelligence (AI) systems to include provenance data in specified media that is created or materially altered by the system.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: legislative sessions; opening date
rollCalls.summary: Subject to voter approval, constitutionally requires the Legislature to commence on the fourth Monday in January, rather than the second Monday in January.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: mine inspector; four-year term
rollCalls.summary: Subject to voter approval, constitutionally resolves conflicting constitutional sections by repealing Ariz. Const. art. 19 § 0 vers. 1 as passed by Proposition 107 in 1992. Sets the term limit for the State Mine Inspector at two consecutive terms.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: mandatory rounding method; cash transactions
rollCalls.summary: An emergency measure effective March 12, 2026, that requires sellers to apply the Swedish rounding method in cash transactions if one-cent coins are not available or utilized at a point of sale.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: ESA students; interscholastic activities; requirements
rollCalls.summary: Exempts a student's absences from being considered excessive if the student meets specified characteristic requirements.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: public employees; merit; hiring practices
rollCalls.summary: Prohibits the State of Arizona or a political subdivision of Arizona from establishing any policies or practices that require a person to be hired based on anything other than merit of the employee.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: foreign law; sharia law; prohibition
rollCalls.summary: Specifies that the definition of foreign law includes Sharia law and outlined foreign, religious or cultural laws, customs or practices.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: chiropractic board; complaints; training; authority
rollCalls.summary: Outlines various actions that constitute unprofessional conduct for the purpose of disciplining a doctor of chiropractic (DC). Modifies the powers and duties of the Arizona Board of Chiropractic Examiners (Board) and the Executive Director of the Board (Executive Director) when investigating and reviewing complaints of unprofessional conduct.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: interactive computer service; prostitution; violation
rollCalls.summary: Establishes the unlawful use of interactive computer service for the primary purpose of facilitating, promoting or soliciting prostitution, pandering or sex trafficking involving a minor as a class 5, 4 or 2 felony, which is punishable as a dangerous crime against children (DCAC), and details various violations of the offense.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: mental health; hearings; acquaintance witnesses
rollCalls.summary: Allows the Court, during court-ordered treatment proceedings, to waive the required testimony of an acquaintance witness of the patient if the court finds that the standard for issuing an order for treatment has been established by clear and convincing evidence from other testimony and evidence presented at the hearing.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: AHCCCS; claims review; behavioral health
rollCalls.summary: Requires a claim denial or adverse appeal determination based on the medical necessity of a behavioral health service covered by the American Indian Health Program (AIHP) to be reviewed and approved by an individual with specified relevant clinical experience.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: radiation protection systems; installation requirement
rollCalls.summary: Effective July 1, 2027, requires hospitals that perform cardiac catheterization procedures involving real-time x-ray imaging to ensure that at least 50 percent of the procedure rooms are equipped with a radiation protection system, as specified.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: radiation protection systems; medical procedures
rollCalls.summary: Prohibits hospitals that perform cardiac catheterization procedures involving real-time x-ray imaging from requiring health professionals to wear lead aprons during those procedures if the procedure room is equipped with a radiation protection system.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: health care institutions; licensing; complaints
rollCalls.summary: Requires the Department of Health Services (DHS) and the Arizona Health Care Cost Containment System (AHCCCS) to coordinate to review each agency's monitoring and compliance functions to identify areas of overlap related to health care institution licensing standards. Establishes minimum qualifications and training requirements for behavioral health technicians (BHTs) and prescribes BHT scope of practice, supervision and duties.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: insurance; cost sharing; breast exams
rollCalls.summary: Prohibits, for contracts, evidences of coverage and policies issued on or after January 1, 2027, a hospital or medical service corporation, health care services organization, disability insurer and group or blanket disability insurer (health insurer) from imposing cost sharing requirements for preventative screening services for breast cancer or for additional screening services required to complete the screening continuum.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: naturopathic physicians; drug administration
rollCalls.summary: Allows a naturopathic physician, by expanding the definition of dru g, to intravenously administer antibiotics, antivirals and antifungals.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: group home monitoring program; continuation
rollCalls.summary: Extends, to January 1, 2032, the delayed repeal date of the Developmental Disabilities Group Home Monitoring Program (Program) and removes the stipulation that the Department of Economic Security's (DES's) obligation to contract with a designated entity to conduct the Program be subject to available appropriations.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: document retention; proposals; donations
rollCalls.summary: Modifies the requirements under the Arizona Procurement Code and for the solicitation and award of grants by state governmental units.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: storm related insurance claims
rollCalls.summary: Prohibits an adjuster and a contractor from soliciting services while a loss-producing event or emergency response is active and prohibits a contractor from advertising to pay, promising to pay or paying a policyholder's insurance deductible.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: firefighters; occupational disease; cancers
rollCalls.summary: Retroactive to July 1, 2021, clarifies the conditions presumed to have arisen out of employment as a peace officer, firefighter or fire investigator for the purposes of workers' compensation coverage.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: court-ordered treatment; continuation
rollCalls.summary: Effective January 1, 2027, establishes a process to convert an order for court-ordered treatment to an order for continuing court-ordered treatment after a patient's second consecutive annual review by the medical director of the mental health treatment agency (medical director) that is conducting the patient's court-ordered treatment.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: agricultural property; inspections; notice.
rollCalls.summary: Prohibits a planned community (HOA) board from taking action on an item under consideration during the closed portion of a meeting.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: agricultural property; classification; inspection.
rollCalls.summary: Prohibits a county assessor from reclassifying or conducting an on-site inspection of agricultural property for four years after a property owner prevails in a property tax appeal, unless there is a change in use or ownership, a property split or a taxable improvement.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: health insurance; fertility preservation; coverage
rollCalls.summary: Effective January 1, 2028, requires a health insurer to provide coverage for standard fertility preservation services to an insured who is within reproductive age, who is diagnosed with cancer and whose medically necessary treatment is likely to cause iatrogenic infertility. Prescribes procedures for a religious employer to request an exemption from the coverage requirement.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: commercial buildings; telecommunications services
rollCalls.summary: Establishes the Public Property Towing and Impound Practices Study Committee (Study Committee).
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: solar energy; inspection; contractors
rollCalls.summary: Prescribes requirements relating to the installation and inspection of solar energy devices. Outlines requirements for distributed energy generation system agreements and disclosure requirements for sales presentations or documents relating to a distributed energy generation system.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: municipalities; planned communities; design; prohibition
rollCalls.summary: Prescribes restrictions on municipalities requiring certain home design standards on single-family homes and accessory dwelling units (ADUs) or shared features as part of a planned community.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: interscholastic activities; criminal offenses; ineligibility
rollCalls.summary: Requires a school district governing board (governing board) to prohibit a student from participating in a school-sponsored interscholastic activity or program if the student has been convicted of, admitted in court, plead no contest or admitted in a plea agreement to committing outlined criminal offenses. Requires a governing board to require any student who participates in an interscholastic activity or program to certify whether the student committed an outlined criminal offense.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: deeds; identification; forgery; notice; notaries
rollCalls.summary: Modifies statutes relating to deeds evidencing a transfer of title to real property, including requirements addressing recordings, notifications and forgeries.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: appropriation; police department; training center
rollCalls.summary: Appropriates $2,500,000 in FY 2027 from the state General Fund (state GF) to the State Treasurer to distribute to the Paradise Valley Police Department to construct a law enforcement training center.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: unlawful flight; reckless endangerment; violation.
rollCalls.summary: Classifies willfully fleeing or attempting to elude a pursuing official law enforcement vehicle and operating a vehicle in a manner that recklessly endangers the life of another person as a class 4 felony, or a class 2 felony under outlined conditions.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: unfair claims settlement practices; chiropractic
rollCalls.summary: Expands the scope of practice of a chiropractor to include performing diagnostic imaging, rather than only diagnostic x-rays.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: malicious delay; enforcement; penalty
rollCalls.summary: Prohibits a municipality or county from maliciously delaying the statutory licensing time frames for single-family residential construction. Allows the Attorney General (AG) to enforce the prohibition on maliciously delaying a response and subjects a municipality or county to a civil penalty of $5,000 per violation. Grants an expedited judicial review of a claim to a plaintiff who files a malicious delay claim in the superior court.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: unlawful alert; arrests
rollCalls.summary: Establishes the criminal classification of unlawful alerting of another person to avoid arrest , which a person commits by knowingly communicating information to another specific person with intent to hinder, delay or prevent the lawful arrest of the other specific person.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: compensation; elderly; best interests
rollCalls.summary: Modifies requirements relating to the process by which a guardian, conservator, attorney or guardian ad litem requests compensation from the estate of a ward or protected person.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: family court; fees; costs; award
rollCalls.summary: Limits the court's calculation of an award for the payment of court-ordered services or an award of child support in a marital or domestic relations proceeding to factual income presented as evidence before the court and prohibits the court from considering the imputed income of either parent. Caps an award of attorney fees in an outlined proceeding at 15 percent of a party's disposable income or $8,000, whichever is greater, when no community assets are shared by the parties.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: family court; professional personnel; requirements
rollCalls.summary: Prescribes additional requirements for court appointed professional personnel (personnel).
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: legal decision-making; jury trial
rollCalls.summary: Modifies requirements relating to proceedings involving legal decision-making or parenting time and reorganizes the list of prescribed relevant factors that the court must consider when determining legal decision-making and parenting time by priority.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: gaming; racing; boxing; conflict-of-interest continuation
rollCalls.summary: Continues the Arizona Department of Gaming (ADG), Arizona Racing Commission (Racing Commission) and Arizona State Boxing and Mixed Martial Arts (Boxing and MMA Commission) Commission for six years. Modifies the powers and duties of the ADG, Racing Commission, and Boxing and MMA Commission.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: DCS; training; child placement; management
rollCalls.summary: Modifies Department of Child Safety (DCS) oversight, audit and placement procedures and establishes training requirements for child safety workers.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: precinct committeemen; vacancy; application
