rollCalls.title: SNAP; allowed purchases; waiver.
rollCalls.summary: Requires the Director of the Department of Economic Security (Director) to request a waiver from the U.S. Department of Agriculture (USDA) granting the authority to restrict the purchase of specified noneligible foods using Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program (SNAP) benefits.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: property tax; exemption; veterans
rollCalls.summary: An emergency measure effective February 12, 2026 , that exempts the primary residence, rather than the property, of a veteran with a service-connected disability whose U.S. Department of Veterans Affairs (VA) disability rating is 100 percent from the full amount of property tax and requires the primary residence, if owned jointly by an eligible veteran and their spouse, to be treated as if owned solely by the veteran.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: hospitals; patient immigration status; reporting
rollCalls.summary: Requires hospitals that accept payment from the Arizona Health Care Cost Containment System (AHCCCS) to include on patient admission forms a place to indicate citizenship status and prescribes quarterly reporting requirements.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: medical examiners; authorized persons
rollCalls.summary: Authorizes a licensed physician who is trained, rather than board-certified, in forensic pathology to supervise autopsies and related functions performed by medical students or residents and fellows in pathology training.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: DCS; memorandum of understanding; tribes
rollCalls.summary: Requires the Department of Child Safety (DCS) to make efforts on an annual basis to enter into a memorandum of understanding (MOU) with each Indian Tribe in Arizona that does not have an MOU and outlines the required contents of an MOU.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: behavior analysts; committee; regulatory authority
rollCalls.summary: Effective January 1, 2027, requires the Arizona Board of Psychologist Examiners (Board) to delegate responsibilities relating to licensing and regulating behavior analysts to the Committee of Behavior Analysts (Committee). Restructures the membership of the Board.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: Arizona rural health transformation fund
rollCalls.summary: Establishes the Arizona Rural Health Transformation Fund (Fund) under the Arizona Health Care Cost Containment System (AHCCCS) consisting of monies received through the Rural Health Transformation Program (RHTP) and establishes procedures for utilization of Fund monies.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: elections; July primary; curing; observers
rollCalls.summary: An emergency measure that moves the date of the primary election from the first Tuesday in August to the second to last Tuesday in July in any year in which a general or special election is held. Adjusts election administration timeframes.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: internal revenue code; conformity; deductions
rollCalls.summary: Retroactive to January 1, 2025, conforms Arizona tax statutes to the U.S. Internal Revenue Code (U.S. IRC) as of January 1, 2026, to reflect changes adopted by the U.S. Congress during 2025. Establishes individual income tax subtractions, modifies individual income tax deductions and increases the Dependent Tax Credit. Declares the state's election to participate in the federal tax credit for individuals who make qualified contributions to school granting organizations (SGOs) and outlines SGO certification and administration requirements.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: EORP; CORP; funded ratio
rollCalls.summary: Prescribes procedures for a Corrections Officer Retirement Plan (CORP) employer to request an asset transfer. Outlines CORP and Elected Officials' Retirement Plan (EORP) employer contribution reductions if an employer's funded ratio is 100 percent or more and removes minimum CORP employer contribution rates.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: ASRS; supplemental employee deferral plan
rollCalls.summary: Specifies that an employee of an Arizona State Retirement System (ASRS) employer, or of a political subdivision or political subdivision entity, who is participating in the Public Safety Personnel Retirement System (PSPRS) or a PSPRS-administered retirement plan is not eligible to participate in a supplemental employee deferral plan.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: ASRS; termination incentive programs
rollCalls.summary: Defines unfunded liability for the purposes of assessing a cost for an unfunded liability resulting from a termination incentive program.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: ASRS; temporary personnel service
rollCalls.summary: Allows an active Arizona State Retirement System (ASRS) member who is appointed to temporary personnel service by a federal agency to receive credited service in ASRS for up to 60 months of temporary personnel service. Requires ASRS employers to make member and employer contributions as outlined.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: ASRS; long-term disability
rollCalls.summary: Specifies that, for an Arizona State Retirement System (ASRS) member to qualify for long-term disability (LTD) benefits, the disability must have occurred while employed for an ASRS employer.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: auditor general; county treasurer; review
rollCalls.summary: Outlines the requirements for procedural reviews of county treasurer offices conducted by the Office of the Auditor General (OAG).
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: patriotic youth groups; school access
rollCalls.summary: Authorizes a public school principal (principal) to allow representatives from a recognized patriotic youth group to address students during regular school hours in the first quarter of an academic school year. Allows a principal to accept materials provided by the patriotic youth group for distribution to students and prohibits a public school from discriminating against, or denying access to, any patriotic youth group that wishes to conduct a meeting.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: drug cartels; terrorist organizations
rollCalls.summary: Subject to voter approval, statutorily declares that drug cartels are terrorist organizations and requires the Arizona Department of Homeland Security ( AZDHS ) to do everything in its authority to address the threat posed by drug cartels.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.summary: Bars a foreign adversary nation or agent from having a substantial interest of 30 percent or more in real property in Arizona, outlines requirements for enforcement and prescribes related exceptions. rollCalls.title: animal cruelty; classification
rollCalls.summary: Increases criminal penalties associated with animal cruelty offenses.

rollCalls.summary: Modifies existing and prescribes additional requirements for a person to qualify as the Adjutant General of Arizona (TAG) or an Assistant TAG. Allows, rather than requires, TAG to establish an educational program and authorizes TAG to enter into contracts and agreements to support the program.
rollCalls.question: Final Reading

rollCalls.summary: Modifies the definitions of qualifying charitable organizations (QCOs) and services for the purposes of the Credit for Contributions to QCOs.
rollCalls.question: Final Reading

rollCalls.title: permanency placement; grandparent; priority
rollCalls.summary: Beginning January 1, 2026, establishes a claimant's ability to bring an action against the state for an erroneous conviction, with outlined procedures for the processing of the claim and entitlements to the claimant if the claim is granted.
rollCalls.question: Final Reading

rollCalls.title: independent corrections ombudsman; auditor general
rollCalls.summary: Establishes the Office of the Independent Corrections Ombudsman (Office) within the Ombudsman-Citizens Aide to monitor inmate health and safety and investigate related complaints.
rollCalls.question: Final Reading

rollCalls.title: municipal housing; preapproved design
rollCalls.summary: Requires municipalities to establish standard preapproved housing design plans or a preapproved housing design plan program, as prescribed. Modifies municipal annexation requirements.
rollCalls.question: Final Reading

rollCalls.title: transitional housing; reentry programs; licensure
rollCalls.summary: Establishes a regulatory system for the licensing and operation of transitional housing facilities to provide temporary living arrangements and basic living necessities to individuals transitioning from incarceration to independent living.

rollCalls.title: food; municipal tax; exemption

rollCalls.title: DIFI; financial enterprises; insurance; compact
rollCalls.summary: Requires a homeowners insurer to file with the Director of the Department of Insurance and Financial Institutions (DIFI) specified policy information relating to fire loss and wildfire risk. Establishes the Fire Insurance Review Task Force (Task Force) and outlines Task Force membership and duties. Modifies the license renewal deadline for consumer lenders, debt management companies, escrow agents, advance fee loan brokers and sales finance companies.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: technical correction; unclaimed property; interest
rollCalls.summary: Allows a court to order a person convicted of an offense for which forfeiture applies to forfeit any digital asset that is owned by the convicted person and used in, acquired through or traceable to the offense. Prescribes procedures for a government agency to sell seized digital assets and outlines the allocation of monies acquired from the sale. Establishes the Bitcoin and Digital Assets Reserve Fund (Fund), administered by the State Treasurer, to store, manage and allocate digital assets securely.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: state contracts; foreign adversary; prohibition
rollCalls.summary: Prohibits a company domiciled in the People's Republic of China from bidding on, submitting a proposal for or entering into a contract with a state agency for goods or services. Requires each company that submits a bid or proposal for a state contract for goods or services to certify that the company is not domiciled in the People's Republic of China. Outlines penalties for a company that submits a false certification letter.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: tax; distribution; county stadium district
rollCalls.summary: Redirects, to the Maricopa County Stadium District Fund (District Fund), specified transaction privilege tax (TPT) revenues collected from certain business activities at a Major League Baseball (MLB) facility or adjacent buildings that are owned by the Maricopa County Stadium District (Chase Field and its adjacent buildings) and redirects 82 percent of the state income tax from the professional baseball franchise organization domiciled in Arizona before the general effective date (Arizona Diamondbacks), Arizona Diamondback employees and any professional baseball franchise organizations from…
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: litigation; financing; consumer protection; enforcement
rollCalls.summary: Effective January 1, 2026, prescribes consumer protection requirements for litigation financing agreements.
rollCalls.question: Final Reading

rollCalls.title: issuance; affidavit; arrest warrant
rollCalls.summary: Requires a magistrate to issue an arrest warrant for a person if presented with an affidavit that establishes probable cause that a felony offense has been committed, and modifies requirements relating to where a person who is arrested by virtue of an arrest warrant must be brought before the court.
rollCalls.question: Final Reading

rollCalls.title: Arizona teachers academy; community colleges
rollCalls.summary: Conforms the state minimum legal age to buy or possess a tobacco product to the federal minimum legal age of 21. Allows National Guard or U.S. Armed Forces personnel who are at least 18 years old to possess, receive or use a tobacco product if specified conditions are met.
rollCalls.question: Final Reading

rollCalls.title: mental health transition program; extension
rollCalls.summary: Extends the Mental Health Transition Program (Program) for three years.
rollCalls.question: Final Reading

rollCalls.title: employer-employee arbitration; contract; disputes
rollCalls.summary: Authorizes arbitration agreements for resolution of certain employment-related disputes between an employer and employee.
rollCalls.question: Final Reading

rollCalls.title: psilocybin services; regulation; licensure
rollCalls.summary: Declares any pharmaceutical composition of crystalline polymorph psilocybin approved by the U.S. Food and Drug Administration (U.S. FDA) and rescheduled by the U.S. Drug Enforcement Administration (U.S. DEA) to a schedule other than Schedule I of the federal Controlled Substances Act (CSA) as a controlled substance that may be prescribed in Arizona.
rollCalls.question: Final Reading

rollCalls.title: physical availability exemption credit; groundwater
rollCalls.summary: Allows a person that owns land within the Phoenix or Pinal active management areas (AMAs) that may be legally irrigated with groundwater pursuant to an irrigation grandfathered right (IGFR) to apply to the Director of the Arizona Department of Water Resources (ADWR) to permanently relinquish all of the IGFR in exchange for groundwater savings credits.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: veterinary technicians; certification; education alternative
rollCalls.summary: Broadens the conditions that must be met for a person to commit cruelty to animals.
rollCalls.question: Final Reading

rollCalls.title: 2025-2026; amusements
rollCalls.summary: Makes statutory and session law changes relating to amusements necessary to implement the FY 2026 state budget.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: capital outlay; 2025-2026; appropriations
rollCalls.summary: Makes session law changes relating to capital outlay necessary to implement the FY 2026 state budget.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: 2025-2026; commerce
rollCalls.summary: Makes statutory and session law changes relating to commerce necessary to implement the FY 2026 state budget.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: 2025-2026; criminal justice
rollCalls.summary: Makes statutory and session law changes relating to criminal justice necessary to implement the FY 2026 state budget.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: 2025-2026; environment
rollCalls.summary: Makes statutory and session law changes relating to the environment necessary to implement the FY 2026 state budget.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: 2025-2026; health care
rollCalls.summary: Makes statutory and session law changes relating to health care necessary to implement the FY 2026 state budget.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: 2025-2026; higher education
rollCalls.summary: Makes statutory and session law changes relating to higher education necessary to implement the FY 2026 state budget.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: 2025-2026; human services
rollCalls.summary: Makes statutory and session law changes relating to human services necessary to implement the FY 2026 state budget.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: 2025-2026; K-12 education
rollCalls.summary: Makes statutory and session law changes relating to K-12 education necessary to implement the FY 2026 state budget.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: 2025-2026; local government
rollCalls.summary: Makes session law changes relating to local government necessary to implement the FY 2026 state budget.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: management; state buildings; 2025-2026
rollCalls.summary: Makes statutory and session law changes relating to the management of state buildings necessary to implement the FY 2026 state budget.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: 2025-2026; revenue
rollCalls.summary: Makes session law changes relating to revenue necessary to implement the FY 2026 state budget.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: 2025-2026; state budget implementation
rollCalls.summary: Makes statutory and session law changes relating to budget implementation necessary to implement the FY 2026 state budget.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: 2025-2026; taxation; omnibus
rollCalls.summary: Extends, until June 30, 2029, the specified purposes for which a public school may use monies contributed for the purposes of the Public School Extracurricular Activity Fees Tax Credit. Increases, effective January 1, 2026, the business personal property tax exemption to $500,000. Exempts the property of a veteran with a service-connected disability whose U.S. Department of Veterans Affairs (VA) disability rating is 100 percent, or the veteran's surviving spouse, from the full amount of property tax.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: transportation; 2025-2026
rollCalls.summary: Makes statutory and session law changes relating to transportation necessary to implement the FY 2026 state budget.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: nurses; provisional licensure
rollCalls.summary: Requires the Arizona State Board of Nursing (AZBN) to issue a provisional license or certificate to an out-of-state advanced practice registered nurse (APRN), registered nurse (RN) or licensed practical nurse (LPN) within five business days after receipt of an application and the associated fees, if outlined conditions are met.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: transnational repression; foreign adversaries
rollCalls.summary: Establishes sentencing enhancements for crimes committed by an agent of a foreign government or a foreign terrorist organization and requires the Department of Public Safety (DPS) to establish a Transnational Repression Recognition and Response Training Program (Program).
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: pay parity; law enforcement; benchmarks
rollCalls.summary: Requires the Department of Public Safety (DPS) to establish and consider benchmarks based on the average compensation of personnel compared to peer law enforcement agencies, prescribes related reporting requirements and modifies the administration and use of the Parity Compensation Fund (Fund).
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: state contracts; foreign adversary; prohibition
rollCalls.summary: Prohibits a company domiciled in the People's Republic of China from bidding on, submitting a proposal for or entering into a contract with a state agency for goods or services. Requires each company that submits a bid or proposal for a state contract for goods or services to certify that the company is not domiciled in the People's Republic of China. Outlines penalties for a company that submits a false certification letter.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: school districts; board members; superintendent
rollCalls.summary: Requires, if the State Board of Education (SBE) places a school district in receivership, the school district superintendent to be terminated for cause and each seat of the school district governing board (governing board) to be deemed vacant. Outlines governing board member replacement procedures and deems a person ineligible to hold an appointed office in Arizona if the person held a governing board seat deemed vacant due to the school district being placed in receivership.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: juveniles; temporary custody; parental notification
rollCalls.summary: Requires, effective July 1, 2026, the Arizona Department of Education (ADE), in collaboration with the Arizona Peace Officer and Standards Training Board (AZPOST), to create a training program for law enforcement officers and security personnel who are employed by an Arizona school district.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: antisemitism; public schools; prohibition; penalties
rollCalls.summary: Prescribes prohibitions on public schools, public school personnel, higher education institutions and higher education institution personnel relating to the teaching or promotion of antisemitism or anti-Semitic conduct, acts and processes (antisemitism or anti-Semitic conduct). Outlines reporting procedures, disciplinary requirements and legal remedies for violations of the prohibitions on antisemitism and anti-Semitic conduct and compliance requirements for higher education institutions. Designates this legislation as the Antisemitism in Education Act (Act) .
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: wildlife; firearms discharge; structures; distance
rollCalls.summary: Allows the discharge of a shotgun or archery equipment, within one-quarter mile but outside of one-eighth mile of a building, while taking wildlife.
rollCalls.question: Final Reading

rollCalls.title: designated countries; land ownership; prohibition
rollCalls.summary: Bars the People's Republic of China (PRC) from having a substantial ownership interest in Arizona land, outlines requirements for enforcement and prescribes related exceptions.
rollCalls.question: Final Reading

rollCalls.title: AHCCCS; obesity treatment; study committee
rollCalls.summary: Establishes the Obesity Treatment Study Committee (Study Committee) to study the cost, potential savings, effectiveness, health outcomes and value of expanding coverage under the Arizona Health Care Cost Containment System (AHCCCS) to include comprehensive treatment for people living with obesity. Outlines Study Committee membership, duties and reporting requirements.
rollCalls.question: Final Reading

rollCalls.title: license exemption; basic first aid
rollCalls.summary: Excludes the provision of basic first aid in good faith to an injured person, without compensation, from licensure requirements under the Arizona Medical Board (AMB) if the individual administering aid obtains the injured person’s consent before rendering assistance.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: write-in candidates; filings; ballots
rollCalls.summary: Modifies elections procedures relating to special district mail ballot elections, hand count audits, inactive voters on the active early voting list (AEVL), valid justice precinct designations for certain justice of the peace and constable candidates and the circumstances relating to the cure period which require the county recorder or city or town clerk's office to be open during the weekend before and after the election.
rollCalls.question: Final Reading

rollCalls.title: digital advertising; content; children; penalty
rollCalls.summary: Requires, beginning January 1, 2026, a child-directed application to take appropriate measures to prevent the display of inappropriate and mature advertisements on the application.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: entrance fee; refunds; time frame
rollCalls.summary: Effective January 1, 2026, requires a facility in which life care services are provided, within 60 days after the facility receives a resident's notice to vacate, to assign the vacated unit a sequential refund number and provide refunds in order based on sequential number, with exceptions and subject to specified requirements. Applies the sequential refund requirement and outlined refund release exemptions and conditions to life care contracts entered into on or after December 31, 2025.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: tracking system; sexual assault kits
rollCalls.summary: Establishes a Sexual Assault Kit Evidence Tracking System (System) to track and update the location and status of sexual assault kits (SAKs) and prescribes requirements for System operations and records.
rollCalls.question: Final Reading

rollCalls.title: groundwater replenishment; Pinal AMA
rollCalls.summary: Allows a municipal provider that applies for a new designation of assured water supply in the Pinal Active Management Area (AMA) that relies on a member service area agreement to elect for all parcels of member land in the municipal service area to retain a replenishment obligation.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: accessory dwelling units; requirements
rollCalls.summary: Requires counties to adopt regulations that allow accessory dwelling units (ADUs) on any lot or parcel where a single-family dwelling is allowed. Outlines development standards for the ADUs.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: congressional term limits; convention
rollCalls.summary: Applies to the U.S. Congress to call an Article V convention to propose an amendment to the U.S. Constitution to set a limit on the number of terms a person may serve in the U.S. Congress.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: public resources; influencing elections; penalties
rollCalls.summary: Specifies that a resident may initiate a suit for a city's, town's, county's or school district's violation of the prohibition on the use of public resources to influence an election and requires civil penalties collected by the court to be paid to the resident.
rollCalls.question: Final Reading

rollCalls.title: landlords; property manager; contact information.
rollCalls.summary: An emergency measure that prohibits a municipality or county from enacting or enforcing any noise ordinances, rules or regulations that prohibits any general construction activities during specified summertime hours.
rollCalls.question: Final Reading

rollCalls.title: PSPRS; part-time employment
rollCalls.summary: Allows, beginning July 1, 2026, part-time municipal police officers, state highway patrol officers and county sheriffs and deputies who are engaged to work as patrol officers and who meet other specified requirements to participate in the Public Safety Personnel Retirement System (PSPRS) and receive credited service for the part time service, if the employer has chosen to allow part-time employees to participate and the part-time work is for a maximum period of six years due to specified qualifying events.
rollCalls.question: Final Reading

rollCalls.title: fraudulent voice recordings
rollCalls.summary: Classifies, as criminal impersonation subject to a class 5 felony, using a computer generated voice recording, image or video of another person with intent to defraud other persons.
rollCalls.question: Final Reading

rollCalls.title: unclaimed property; department of revenue
rollCalls.summary: Allows the Cochise County Board of Supervisors (BOS) or the Graham County BOS to vote to place on the 2026 general election ballot a question of whether to designate the portion of the San Simon Valley Groundwater Subbasin that is located in Cochise County or Graham County as an irrigation non-expansion area (INA).
rollCalls.question: Final Reading

rollCalls.title: advanced air mobility infrastructure
rollCalls.summary: Requires, beginning September 1, 2026, the Arizona Department of Transportation (ADOT) to develop or upgrade a statewide aviation plan for advanced air mobility infrastructure.
rollCalls.question: Final Reading

rollCalls.title: municipal development; permits; review
rollCalls.summary: Authorizes third party reviews of single-family residential building permit applications in a municipality with a population of 30,000 persons or more. Modifies municipal licensing time frame requirements.
rollCalls.question: Final Reading

rollCalls.title: patient rights; health care services
rollCalls.summary: Grants patients specified rights when receiving care from a healthcare professional in Arizona.
rollCalls.question: Final Reading

rollCalls.title: legislative appointments; qualifications
rollCalls.summary: Removes membership requirements for certain members of outlined public bodies who are appointed by the Speaker of the House of Representatives (House) and the President of the Senate.
rollCalls.question: Final Reading

rollCalls.title: broadband service district authority; formation
rollCalls.summary: Allows a group of individuals, businesses or organizations in a county with a population between 200,000 and 210,000 to form a broadband service district authority (authority) and prescribes the powers and duties of an authority.
rollCalls.question: Final Reading

rollCalls.title: landlord tenant; assistance animals
rollCalls.summary: States that a landlord is not liable for injuries or damages cause by a purported assistance or service animal that is allowed a reasonable accommodation or modification on the landlord's property.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: public retirement systems; administration
rollCalls.summary: Modifies administration of the Public Safety Personnel Retirement System (PSPRS) and other PSPRS-managed retirement plans relating to reemployment restrictions, authorized investments and supplemental defined contribution plan and disability program participation.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: internet pornography; minors; age verification
rollCalls.summary: Subjects a commercial entity to civil liability for damages if the entity intentionally and knowingly publishes or distributes sexual material that is harmful to minors on the internet without performing a reasonable age verification.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: dental board; licensure; renewal
rollCalls.summary: Deems, as failure to maintain adequate records , a person's knowing failure to maintain or report the destruction of certain behavioral health service records for which a claim is submitted, payment is received or that disclose information on which rates of payment are based, when outlined conditions apply. Prescribes penalty classifications for the failure to maintain or report the destruction of records as outlined.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: individualized education programs; dyslexia diagnosis
rollCalls.summary: Requires a child with a specific learning disability's Individualized Education Program (IEP) to indicate whether the child has been diagnosed with dyslexia.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: acute care services; pilot program
rollCalls.summary: Extends the Acute Care at Home Pilot Program (ACHPP) until January 1, 2029, and requires eligible hospitals to demonstrate the ability to ensure emergency response times of no more than 30 minutes to a patient's home.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: multistate voter registration system; prohibition
rollCalls.summary: Allows Arizona to become a member of a specified governmental or nongovernmental entity for the purpose of sharing and exchanging information relating to voter registration information. Requires the county recorder to establish a general voter registration list maintenance program.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: missing indigenous person; alert system
rollCalls.summary: Establishes the Turquoise Alert System (System) to issue and coordinate alerts for a missing person who is a tribal member under 65 years old and outlines requirements for the issuance and dissemination of an alert.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: total loss vehicle; electronic signatures
rollCalls.summary: Allows a power of attorney (POA) to be to be signed electronically and printed by using a commercial product that uses an identity assurance level 2 (IAL2) or higher authorization without biometrics, prescribes requirements for electronic signatures and allows an agent to execute a POA involving a total loss settlement without notarization.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: technical correction; unclaimed property; interest
rollCalls.summary: Allows a court to order a person convicted of an offense for which forfeiture applies to forfeit any digital asset that is owned by the convicted person and used in, acquired through or traceable to the offense. Prescribes procedures for a government agency to sell seized digital assets and outlines the allocation of monies acquired from the sale. Establishes the Bitcoin and Digital Assets Reserve Fund (Fund), administered by the State Treasurer, to store, manage and allocate digital assets securely.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: county candidates; clean elections pamphlet
rollCalls.summary: Adds candidates for countywide offices to the list of names that must be included in the Voter Education Guide published by the Citizens Clean Elections Commission (Commission). Contains requirements for enactment for initiatives and referendums (Proposition 105).
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: drug-free homeless zones
rollCalls.summary: Establishes drug-free homeless service zones and outlines drug-free homeless zone violations, penalties, fines and requirements.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: apprenticeship; supervised probation.
rollCalls.summary: Allows certain probationers who participate in a recognized apprenticeship program to work during any hours of the day and to travel to work in the apprenticeship program outside of the probationer's jurisdiction when specified conditions are met.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: statewide assessment; accommodations; written form
rollCalls.summary: Modifies the circumstances in which a school district or charter school may administer the statewide assessment in the form of a written test. Authorizes a student to opt out of a school-administered statewide assessment if the student submits an official score report from a nationally recognized assessment as outlined.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: physical therapists; imaging; laboratory tests
rollCalls.summary: Specifies that a physical therapist may order imaging only for patients with an established patient relationship with the physical therapist and for whom there is a clinical need for the imaging. Removes the specification that imaging ordered by a physical therapist be musculoskeletal consisting of plain film radiographs.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: power; public utilities; UCC; securities
rollCalls.summary: Establishes a process for a public power entity to initiate a securitization transaction by providing public notice of the public power entity's intent to adopt a financial resolution or for an applicant to request permission to initiate a securitization transaction from the Arizona Corporation Commission (ACC) by submitting an application for a financing order.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: cancer insurance; public safety; retirees
rollCalls.summary: Allows, effective January 1, 2026, a person who did not receive covered Cancer Insurance Program (CIP) benefits to elect to continue CIP coverage after retirement by paying the CIP premium. Prescribes requirements for the Public Safety Personnel Retirement System (PSPRS) Board of Trustees when determining the cost of the CIP premium for persons who elected to continue coverage. Extends, permanently, the requirement for the state and political subdivisions to offer a supplement benefit plan for public safety employees who have a duty-related injury.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: academic standards; social studies; geography
rollCalls.summary: Expands the high school social studies academic standards to include geography and instruction on the Gulf of America.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: DUI; alternative treatment
rollCalls.summary: Allows a court to order a person convicted of driving under the influence (DUI), at the person's option, to participate in a religious program that is approved by the court. Adds evidence-based psychotherapy as an option for required court-ordered treatment.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: fingerprinting; personnel; committed youth; contact.
rollCalls.summary: Expands mandatory fingerprinting, criminal history records checks and disclosure of outlined criminal offenses required for direct contact with committed youth under the jurisdiction of the Arizona Department of Juvenile Corrections (ADJC) to include volunteers and visitors, immediately terminates of a contract for an employee's noncompliance and restricts a rehabilitated individual to supervised direct contact with committed youth.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: court-ordered evaluations
rollCalls.summary: Specifies that the county's responsibility for court-ordered evaluation of persons who are alleged to be, as a result of a mental disorder, a danger to self or to others or who have a persistent or acute disability or a grave disability, continues until the end of the evaluation period and excludes weekends and holidays from the prescribed timelines relating to court-ordered evaluation.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: voter registrations; transportation department; recorders
rollCalls.summary: Effective January 1, 2026, requires the Arizona Department of Transportation (ADOT) to send voter registration information to both the Secretary of State (SOS) and the appropriate county recorder simultaneously.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: ground ambulances; registration
rollCalls.summary: Allows an ambulance certificate of registration (certificate) to remain valid and in effect pending certain action by the Department of Health Services (DHS).
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: narcotic injection sites; zoning; prohibition
rollCalls.summary: Prohibits a municipality or county from adopting an ordinance, regulation or overlay zoning district that would allow for the development of a narcotics injection site.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: mixed hoteling; signage; requirements
rollCalls.summary: Requires a homeless service provider, building supervisor and building owner of a hotel that engages in mixed hoteling to prominently post a prescribed statement that informs the reader that the business is being used to house homeless individuals alongside the general public. Requires any guest who objects to mixed hoteling to be issued a full refund at the time of arrival and prohibits the use of state or local monies for mixed hoteling.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: preferential treatment; discrimination; policies
rollCalls.summary: Outlines prohibitions for the state or a state agency, a city or town, county, community college district governing board and a state university relating to diversity, equity and inclusion (DEI). Requires the state or a state agency, a city or town, county, community college district governing board and a state university to adopt policies that appropriately discipline an employee or contractor that engages in conduct that violates the prohibitions relating to DEI.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: alternative fuel vehicles; HOV lanes
rollCalls.summary: Allows a person who owns a motor vehicle that uses alternative fuel to apply for a license plate or special plate, rather than an alternative fuel vehicle special plate.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: task order contracts; website; posting
rollCalls.summary: Requires a state governmental unit, school district, or city, town or county government that enters into a task order contract with a contractor in Arizona to conspicuously post the contract on the state governmental unit's website. Outlines personal or proprietary information that may be exempt from the posting requirements.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: inpatient treatment days; computation; exclusion
rollCalls.summary: Excludes any time that a patient has spent in jail or prison from the maximum period of involuntary inpatient treatment days that the court may order the patient to undergo.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: gold star families; legacy preservation
rollCalls.summary: Expresses the Legislature's support of Gold Star Families, pledge to preserve the term Gold Star Families and encouragement of public and private entities in Arizona to protect the term.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: assured water supply; legislative intent
rollCalls.summary: Expresses the Legislatures opposition to the Arizona Department of Water Resources (ADWR) rulemaking relating to the alternative path to the designation of assured water supply (ADAWS) and determines that it is contrary to Arizona statute and therefore null and void. Expresses the Legislatures opposition to any rule, regulation, policy or condition that the Governor or the Director of ADWR proposes or adopts that meets outlined conditions.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: minerals; metals; supporting domestic supply
rollCalls.summary: Expresses the Legislatures recognition of the importance of Arizona's mineral and metal resources and the Legislatures support of policies and initiatives that promote mining and a domestic supply of mineral and metal resources.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: law enforcement; first responders; honoring
rollCalls.summary: Expresses the Legislature's gratitude to all law enforcement personnel, other first responders and volunteers in the State of Arizona for their unparalleled public service.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: Colorado River; cause of decline
rollCalls.summary: Expresses the Legislatures recognition of the importance of the eradication of salt cedars and managing the forest to substantially increase the available water in the Colorado River.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: sovereign authority
rollCalls.summary: Expresses the state's intent to exercise sovereignty over all powers not otherwise granted to the Federal Government or reserved to the people by the U.S. Constitution.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: Yuma agriculture; water rights; supporting
rollCalls.summary: States that it is the intent of the Legislature to protect Yuma agriculture and Arizona's rights to Colorado River water.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: engineers; alterations; commercial space
rollCalls.summary: Adds to the prescribed practices that are exempt from the Arizona Board of Technical Registration's (AZBTR) compliance requirements.
rollCalls.question: Final Reading

rollCalls.title: barbering and cosmetology fund; enforcement
rollCalls.summary: Allows a political subdivision entity to procure insurance from any insurer authorized by the Director of the Department of Insurance and Financial Institutions (DIFI) or establish a self-insurance program. Adds a political subdivision entity to the definition of public agency for the purposes of intergovernmental operations.
rollCalls.question: Final Reading

rollCalls.title: digital assets strategic reserve fund
rollCalls.summary: Establishes the Digital Assets Strategic Reserve Fund (Fund), administered by the State Treasurer, and consisting of monies appropriated by the Legislature and digital assets seized by the state. Allows the State Treasurer to loan digital assets from the Fund, if the loan does not increase financial risk to the state.
rollCalls.question: Final Reading

rollCalls.title: DCS; school visits; identification requirements
rollCalls.summary: Requires a Department of Child Safety (DCS) caseworker to present DCS identification when visiting a child at the child's school for the purpose of an interview. Requires, if a DCS caseworker denies or is unable to present identification, the school to contact the DCS office where the DCS caseworker is employed to verify the DCS caseworker's identification and employment.
rollCalls.question: Final Reading

rollCalls.title: unbuilt certificates; assured water supply
rollCalls.summary: Sets the Town of Wellton's penalty at $100 for exceeding its constitutional expenditure limitation in FY 2023.
rollCalls.question: Final Reading

rollCalls.title: concealed weapons permits; fees
rollCalls.summary: Sets the fee that the Department of Public Safety (DPS) may charge Arizona residents for a concealed carry weapon (CCW) application at 10 percent of the fee that is charged for nonresidents.
rollCalls.question: Final Reading

rollCalls.title: patriotic youth groups; school access
rollCalls.summary: Authorizes a public school principal (principal) to allow representatives from a recognized patriotic youth group to address students during regular school hours in the first quarter of an academic school year. Allows a principal to accept materials provided by the patriotic youth group for distribution to students and prohibits a public school from discriminating against, or denying access to, any patriotic youth group that wishes to conduct a meeting.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: law enforcement; first responders; honoring
rollCalls.summary: Expresses the Legislature's gratitude to all law enforcement personnel, other first responders and volunteers in the State of Arizona for their unparalleled public service.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: student athletes; employment status; restrictions
rollCalls.summary: An emergency measure that outlines prohibitions and requirements on regulators, student athletes and postsecondary education institutions relating to the use of a student athlete's own name, image and likeness (NIL). Prescribes causes of action that may be brought in a court of competent jurisdiction for outlined violations relating to student athlete compensation. Allows a public university or an organization that has qualified for exemption from the taxation of income (nonprofit organization) that assists student athletes to earn compensation from NIL usage to conduct a raffle as prescribed.
rollCalls.question: Final Reading

rollCalls.title: captive insurers; certificate of dormancy
rollCalls.summary: Establishes certification requirements for dormant captive insurers who may not transact insurance business or issue insurance policies while dormant. Modifies administrative requirements for captive insurers.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: disability; voluntary disclosure; licenses
rollCalls.summary: Allows a person to request the Arizona Department of Transportation (ADOT) to note that a communication accommodation may be needed on a person's license or vehicle registration and requires ADOT to establish methods and procedures for requests.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: campaign finance complaints; resolution
rollCalls.summary: Deems a campaign finance violation complaint dismissed if the complaint is not resolved or ruled on by the filing officer within 180 days and the deadline for resolving or ruling is not extended.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: DCS; kinship care placement; requirement
rollCalls.summary: Adds extended family members to the list of persons who qualify as a kinship foster care placement and requires extended family members to be included in all investigations and proceedings related to identifying a kinship foster care placement for a child in the temporary custody of the Department of Child Safety (DCS).
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: indistinguishable; visual depiction; definition.
rollCalls.summary: Modifies certain definitions relating to the sexual exploitation of children criminal classification to account for images created or modified by means of computer software, artificial intelligence or other digital editing tools.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: groundwater replenishment districts; annual dues
rollCalls.summary: Modifies the calculation for the Central Arizona Groundwater Replenishment District (CAGRD) when determining the amount of revenues to be raised through annual membership dues.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: county water authority; post-2024 authority
rollCalls.summary: Allows for a county water authority to be formed in La Paz County and outlines the process for the establishment of a county water authority in La Paz County.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: unclaimed property; virtual currency; security
rollCalls.summary: Establishes a process to deem digital assets as abandoned property and for a holder to deliver the abandoned property to the Arizona Department of Revenue (ADOR). Establishes the Bitcoin and Digital Assets Reserve Fund (Fund) consisting of abandoned digital assets for which three years have passed after the date the abandoned digital assets were transferred to a qualified custodian, if the abandoned digital assets remain unclaimed. Requires the State Treasurer, on approval of the Legislature, to deposit 10 percent of the digital assets held in the Fund into the state General Fund (state GF).
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: fire trucks; diesel fuel; exemption
rollCalls.summary: Authorizes a fire truck, fire engine or other fire apparatus that is exempt from the federal diesel fuel tax to use dyed diesel fuel when transporting fire fighters on state highways outside of areas A, B and C.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: unauthorized encampments; higher education institutions
rollCalls.summary: Prohibits an individual from establishing or occupying an encampment on the campus of a university or community college and outlines requirements for enforcement and penalties for violators.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: reinstatement; WIFA monies
rollCalls.summary: Expresses the Legislature's commitment to long-term water security and to reinstating the full appropriation envisioned for the Water Infrastructure Finance Authority (WIFA).
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: voting centers ban; precinct size
rollCalls.summary: Removes the ability of the county board of supervisors (county BOS) and the county recorder to establish voting centers and on-site early voting locations. Limits an election precinct to a maximum of 1,000 registered voters.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: schools; water safety; information; resources
rollCalls.summary: Requires, before the 2025-2026 school year, the Arizona Department of Education (ADE) to compile and post on ADE's website information regarding water safety courses and swimming lessons and local providers of such courses and lessons. Directs each school district and charter school to provide the webpage address to each parent upon initial enrollment of a child.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: audits; precincts; voting centers
rollCalls.summary: Adds voting centers to the random pool of precincts within a county from which the ballots for the hand count audit must be selected and requires the hand count audit to begin immediately after the selection of precincts or voting centers, except as outlined for the early ballot hand count.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: provisional ballots; cure data
rollCalls.summary: Adds provisional ballot voters to the list of voters whose signatures require curing that the county recorder or other officer in charge of elections must send to the political parties on a daily basis through the end of the signature cure period.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: license exemption; basic first aid
rollCalls.summary: Excludes the provision of basic first aid in good faith to an injured person, without compensation, from licensure requirements under the Arizona Medical Board (AMB) if the individual administering aid obtains the injured person’s consent before rendering assistance.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: school facilities oversight board; continuation
rollCalls.summary: Allows each member of a school district governing board (governing board) to access all information and records that are maintained by a school district for the purpose of carrying out the governing board's official functions and duties. Outlines requirements for an administrator, official or records custodian of a school district relating to the provision of information and records to a governing board member.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: school safety; proposals; assessments; plans
rollCalls.summary: Expands the School Safety Program (Program) to support the costs of placing school safety officers (SSOs) and by establishing an alternative Program proposal process to support the costs of purchasing safety equipment and infrastructure improvements as specified. Requires each school district and charter school to train officers how to interact with children with disabilities and each school that receives Program monies to develop an emergency response plan as outlined. Exempts school building blueprints and floor plans from public record requirements.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: land divisions; disclosure affidavit; recording
rollCalls.summary: Modifies the requirements for and contents of an affidavit of disclosure (affidavit) for the sale of parcels of land in an unincorporated area.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: forced organ harvesting; insurance; prohibition
rollCalls.summary: Allows insurers and the Arizona Health Care Cost Containment System (AHCCCS) to limit coverage for human organ transplants or post-transplant care if the transplant operation is performed in, or the human organ to be transplanted was procured by a sale or donation originating in the People's Republic of China or the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: SNAP; mandatory employment and training
rollCalls.summary: Requires the Department of Economic Security (DES) to require able-bodied adults under 60 years old who are receiving Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program (SNAP) benefits to participate in a mandatory employment and training program, as prescribed by federal law, unless the recipient meets criteria for exemption.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: SNAP; work requirement waivers; exemptions
rollCalls.summary: Prohibits the Department of Economic Security (DES) from seeking, applying for, accepting or renewing any waiver of work requirement under the Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program (SNAP) for able-bodied adults without dependents unless it is required by federal law or authorized by state law. Prohibits DES from exercising the option to provide exemptions from the SNAP work requirement unless authorized by state law.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: early voting list; undeliverable ballots
rollCalls.summary: Requires the county recorder, or officer in charge of elections, to remove the voter from the Active Early Voting List (AEVL) if the AEVL notice is returned undeliverable by the post office.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: long-term RVs; cooling; prohibition
rollCalls.summary: An emergency measure that allows a tenant of a recreational vehicle (RV), that is a motor home, park trailer or travel trailer, to install reasonably necessary commercial cooling methods on the tenant's RV.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: claims; prior authorization; conduct
rollCalls.summary: Effective July 1, 2026, requires a medical director, before a health care insurer may deny a claim or issue a direct denial of a prior authorization, to individually review any denial that involves medical necessity and prohibits the medical director from relying solely on recommendations derived from any other source during the prior authorization denial or claim denial review.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: marijuana; advertising; restrictions
rollCalls.summary: Establishes guidelines and restrictions for the advertising of marijuana, marijuana products and paraphernalia. Contains requirements for enactment for initiatives and referendums (Proposition 105).
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: technical correction; electricity; power authority
rollCalls.summary: Requires public power entities and electric utilities to prepare a biennial wildfire mitigation plan, as prescribed, and outlines wildfire mitigation plan review and approval requirements. Prescribes liability for causing wildfires in any cause of action for negligence against a public power entity or electric utility that is related to wildfire.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: election procedures manual; authority
rollCalls.summary: Asserts that the requirement for the Secretary of State (SOS) to adopt an official instruction and procedures manual, referred to as the Elections Procedures Manual (EPM), must not be construed as an excessive delegation of Legislative powers.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: child sex trafficking; juvenile defendants
rollCalls.summary: Requires a person that is convicted of a class 2 felony for child sex trafficking to be at least 18 years old to be sentenced to imprisonment for natural life. Contains requirements for enactment for initiatives and referendums (Proposition 105).
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: law enforcement; defunding; prohibition
rollCalls.summary: Prohibits a city or town (municipality) from reducing the annual operating budget for a law enforcement agency by any amount below the previous year's budget. Outlines requirements for the State Treasurer to withhold state shared monies from a municipality upon notification of an operating budget reduction. Declares that the regulation of funding of a municipality's law enforcement agency is a matter of statewide concern.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: settlement agreements; report; approval
rollCalls.summary: Requires a city, town or county (local government) to submit a settlement agreement report to outlined parties for review before entering into the settlement agreement.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: advisory committee; subcommittee; exemption
rollCalls.summary: Exempts, from open meeting law, the exchange of communications among a quorum of a three-member advisory committee or subcommittee that involves a discussion or deliberation concerning a matter before the advisory committee or subcommittee.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: elevator contractors; elevator mechanics; regulation
rollCalls.summary: Requires the Arizona Corporation Commission (ACC) to take a majority vote at a public meeting and publish the ACC's position online before the ACC, ACC staff or any registered lobbyist on behalf of the ACC may advocate for or against any legislation, regulation or rule. Requires the Attorney General (AG), at the request of the Legislature to investigate a violation of the requirement that the ACC publicly vote before advocating on any legislation, regulation or rule. Subjects the ACC or a commissioner to a $500 penalty for each instance of noncompliance.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: parental alienation; testimony; prohibition
rollCalls.summary: Prohibits a court from ordering a party to pay for any type of therapy, treatment or counseling program designed to improve or maintain the parent-child or parent-parent relationship, including court-ordered behavioral intervention, in any legal decision-making or parenting time proceeding.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: municipal separate storm sewer system
rollCalls.summary: Modifies the definition of county as it relates to local stormwater quality programs to include counties that operate a regulated medium or large separate storm sewer system, rather than just a small municipal separate storm sewer system.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: technical correction; assured water supply
rollCalls.summary: Allows the Cochise County Board of Supervisors (BOS), by July 2, 2026, to vote to place a question on the 2026 general election ballot for the residents of Cochise County that reside within the Willcox Groundwater Basin on whether to establish a domestic water improvement district.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: postpartum depression; treatment; insurers
rollCalls.summary: Requires the Department of Health Services (DHS) to compile relevant educational materials and information regarding maternal mental health conditions, including postpartum depression, for use by health care institutions, health care professionals and patients and to establish an Advisory Committee on Obstetrics, Gynecology and Maternal Mental Health in Rural Communities (Advisory Committee).
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: murder; law enforcement officer; punishment
rollCalls.summary: States that first degree murder in which a person causes the death of a law enforcement officer who is in the line of duty is punishable by death or natural life, only if the offender is at least 18 years old.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: murder; law enforcement officer; punishment
rollCalls.summary: States that first degree murder in which a person causes the death of a law enforcement officer who is in the line of duty is punishable by death or natural life, only if the offender is at least 18 years old.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: notaries; businesses; prohibition
rollCalls.summary: Stipulates that, if an entity does not provide the option to notarize documents without charge or cost, then individuals seeking notarization may use any authorized notarial officer.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: auditor general; records; financial institutions
rollCalls.summary: Expands the authority of the Office of the Auditor General (OAG) to have access to and examine certain records.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: rare disease advisory council
rollCalls.summary: Establishes the Rare Disease Advisory Council (RDAC) within the Department of Health Services (DHS) to provide guidance and recommendations on the needs of individuals living with a rare disease. Outlines RDAC membership, powers and responsibilities.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: cryptocurrency kiosk; license; fraud prevention
rollCalls.summary: Prescribes requirements and limitations for a cryptocurrency kiosk operator (operator) doing business in Arizona.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: drug-free homeless zones
rollCalls.summary: Establishes drug-free homeless service zones and outlines drug-free homeless zone violations, penalties, fines and requirements.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: website information; pregnant women
rollCalls.summary: Requires the Arizona Health Care Cost Containment System (AHCCCS), by December 1, 2025, to provide a conspicuous link on the agency's public website that directs a person to adoption information and support for pregnant women.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: attorney general; election certification; prohibition
rollCalls.summary: Effective January 1, 2026, prohibits the Attorney General (AG) from prosecuting, bringing criminal charges against or filing a civil action against a member of a county board of supervisors (BOS) based on the member's vote against the certification of an election canvass, when outlined conditions apply.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: psychologist board; complaint-related documents
rollCalls.summary: Modifies documental review requirements relating to an Arizona Board of Psychologist Examiners (Board) investigation.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: unemployment insurance; benefit amounts
rollCalls.summary: Modifies the duration of unemployment insurance (UI) benefits that a person may receive during a benefit year, based on the unemployment rate (UR) during the prior calendar quarter.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: written request; property locators
rollCalls.summary: Outlines requirements for a locator to register with the Arizona Department of Revenue (ADOR) to provide recovery services to the apparent owner of unclaimed property. Establishes the Locator Registration Fund consisting of monies received from locator registration and renewal fees. Reduces the cap on the fee a locator may charge for recovering unclaimed property.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: employment; prohibitions; corporation commission
rollCalls.summary: Prohibits a public service corporation or public power entity that is regulated by the Arizona Corporation Commission (ACC) from employing or entering into an independent contractor agreement with an individual who served as a commissioner in the preceding two years.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: temporary non-expansion area
rollCalls.summary: Establishes the process for the designation of a temporary non-expansion area (TNA) in any location that is not included in an active management area (AMA) or an irrigation non-expansion area (INA) by an outlined petition to the Director of the Arizona Department of Water Resources by at least one-half of the number of irrigation users and at least 10 percent of the registered voters residing within the boundaries of the groundwater basin or subbasin specified in the petition. Outlines groundwater rights for people within the TNA.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: aggravated assault; accomplices; classification
rollCalls.summary: Expands the criminal classification of aggravated assault .
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: on-farm irrigation efficiency program; continuation
rollCalls.summary: Extends the On-Farm Irrigation Efficiency Pilot Program (Pilot Program) from January 1, 2027, to January 1, 2030. Adds to the information that must be included in the statutorily outlined written report relating to the Pilot Program.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: TPT; exemption; qualifying equipment; extension
rollCalls.summary: Extends the transaction privilege tax (TPT) deduction and use tax exemption for qualifying equipment purchased by a certified healthy forest enterprise until December 31, 2028.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: voting equipment; requirements; origin
rollCalls.summary: Prohibits, beginning January 1, 2029, the Secretary of State (SOS) from certifying any vote recording and vote tabulating machines if the parts and components of such machines are not 100 percent sourced from and manufactured in the United States.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: silver alert; criteria; notification
rollCalls.summary: Renames the silver alert as the seek and find alert, expands the alert to include missing persons with cognitive disabilities, prohibits the denial or delay of an alert and requires law enforcement agencies (LEAs) to develop and conduct training on the Seek and Find Alert Notification System (System).
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: small claims court; jurisdictional limit
rollCalls.summary: Increases, from $3,500 to $5,000, the jurisdictional limit for the small claims division of the justice court.
rollCalls.question: Final Reading

rollCalls.title: property tax; limited property value
rollCalls.summary: Adds properties that previously qualified for a property valuation protection option or a statutory valuation and no longer qualify to the circumstances that require the county assessor to determine the property's limited property value (LPV) at a level or percentage of full cash value (FCV) that is comparable to other properties of the same or similar use or classification.
rollCalls.question: Final Reading

rollCalls.title: cast vote record; public record
rollCalls.summary: Requires the county board of supervisors (BOS) or officer in charge of elections to transmit the cast vote record to the Secretary of State (SOS) within 48 hours after the county BOS transmits the county canvass. Prohibits the county BOS or officer in charge of elections from randomizing or altering the cast vote record.
rollCalls.question: Final Reading

rollCalls.title: health insurers; provider; payment; claims
rollCalls.summary: Effective April 1, 2026, modifies deadlines of the health insurance provider credentialing process and prescribes requirements for processing of claims.
rollCalls.question: Final Reading

rollCalls.title: unemployment benefits; requirements; disqualifications; determinations
rollCalls.summary: Modifies the factors that an unemployed individual must meet to be eligible for Unemployment Insurance (UI) benefits. Requires the Department of Economic Security (DES) to cross-check the validity of UI benefit claims against prescribed data sets.
rollCalls.question: Final Reading

rollCalls.title: state fire marshal; phased permitting
rollCalls.summary: Establishes phased permitting for construction projects that are reviewed and approved by the Office of the State Fire Marshal (Office). Authorizes municipalities to review and approve certain construction permits in lieu of approval from the Office.
rollCalls.question: Final Reading

rollCalls.title: charter schools; access; decision-making authority
rollCalls.summary: Authorizes a charter representative, charter school governing body member and officer, director, member and partner of a charter holder, as allowed by the charter holder, to have access to the charter school's student records and campuses and authority to make final decisions regarding learning and safety for the charter school's students and campus.
rollCalls.question: Final Reading

rollCalls.title: commercial motor vehicles; civil penalties
rollCalls.summary: Allows the driver of a large truck to deviate from the lane to the extent necessary to make a right or left turn, lowers penalties prescribed for outlined commercial vehicle violations from misdemeanors to civil penalties, standardizes statutory definitions for commercial vehicles and vehicle weights and reconciles related requirements.
rollCalls.question: Final Reading

rollCalls.title: public records; notification; commercial purpose
rollCalls.summary: Requires a person submitting a public records request to affirm that the public record is not for a commercial purpose, or if the request is for a commercial purpose, requires the person to provide a statement that explains the intended use pursuant to statutory requirements for using the public records for a commercial purpose.
rollCalls.question: Final Reading

rollCalls.title: voter registration rolls; internet access
rollCalls.summary: Requires the county recorder SOS and other officers in charge of elections to provide electronic access to voter registration information and additional copies of an official precinct list to a person who requests the information for noncommercial purposes as outlined. Requires the data from a county voting location ballot report to be made available as a public record by the last posting of election results for that election night and allows an expanded postelection early ballot hand count to be performed at the discretion of the county board of supervisors (BOS).
rollCalls.question: Final Reading

rollCalls.title: political signs; homeowners' associations
rollCalls.summary: Adds a flag to the definition of a political sign for a condominium unit owners' association (COA) or planned community association (HOA).
rollCalls.question: Final Reading

rollCalls.title: epinephrine delivery systems
rollCalls.summary: Replaces statutory references to the term epinephrine auto-injector with the term epinephrine delivery system.
rollCalls.question: Final Reading

rollCalls.title: computer-generated pictorial representations; unlawful disclosure
rollCalls.summary: Stipulates that, if an image depicting a person in a state of nudity or sexual activity is a realistic pictorial representation, the depicted person need not have a reasonable expectation of privacy for the nonconsensual disclosure of such image to be considered unlawful, unless the image was created or modified by the depicted person themselves.
rollCalls.question: Final Reading

rollCalls.title: personal property exemptions; vehicles
rollCalls.summary: Exempts a person's value in a homestead from bankruptcy proceedings, up to the amount of the homestead exemption plus any value increase during pendency of the case. Adds, to the property types that qualify for the $400,000 homestead exemption, park model trailers, motor homes, travel trailers, fifth wheel trailers, houseboats, manufactured homes and other forms of shelter in which a person resides, plus the land on which the shelter is located.
rollCalls.question: Final Reading

rollCalls.title: licensed secure facility; incompetent defendants
rollCalls.summary: Prohibits patients found dangerous and incompetent to stand trial and who are court ordered to involuntary treatment from being treated at a secure behavioral health residential facility (SBHRF) that treats patients who are civilly committed to treatment at the SBHRF.
rollCalls.question: Final Reading

rollCalls.title: school districts; overexpenditures; ADE; notice
rollCalls.summary: Requires, if the Arizona Department of Education (ADE) determines without prior notification from a county school superintendent that a school district's expenditures exceed the school district's general budget limit or unrestricted capital budget limit, ADE to notify the county school superintendent and take any required actions prescribed by statute. Allows a county school superintendent to review the operations and finances of each school district within the county.
rollCalls.question: Final Reading

rollCalls.title: developmental disabilities; appropriations; waivers
rollCalls.summary: An emergency measure that appropriates $122,300,300 from the Prescription Drug Rebate Fund and $403,000,000 in Medicaid Expenditure Authority in FY 2025 to the Department of Economic Security (DES) for the developmental disabilities Medicaid program. Prescribes requirements for the Arizona Health Care Cost Containment System (AHCCCS) relating to DES's developmental disabilities Medicaid program.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: developmental disabilities; appropriations; waivers.
rollCalls.summary: An emergency measure that appropriates $122,300,300 from the Prescription Drug Rebate Fund and $403,000,000 in Medicaid Expenditure Authority in FY 2025 to the Department of Economic Security (DES) for the developmental disabilities Medicaid program. Prescribes requirements for the Arizona Health Care Cost Containment System (AHCCCS) relating to DES's developmental disabilities Medicaid program.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: vehicle license tax; exemption; military
rollCalls.summary: Expands the exemption on vehicle license taxes (VLTs) and registration fees for an active duty member of the U.S. Armed Forces to include the 30 days before deployment and allows qualifying payments to be refunded, rather than prorated in the following year.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: supply and demand; assessment; groundwater
rollCalls.summary: Requires the Director of the Arizona Department of Water Resources (ADWR) to include outlined data in each five-year supply and demand assessment for each groundwater basin.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: juveniles; change of judge; impartiality
rollCalls.summary: Grants each party to a permanency determination action the right to request a change of judge for cause and the right to make one request for change of judge without cause. Outlines procedures and filing requirements for requesting a change of judge for or without cause.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: corporation commission; electricity; reliability; management
rollCalls.summary: Prohibits the Arizona Corporation Commission (ACC) from authorizing or approving the retirement of an electric generation facility as presented in a rate case, integrated resource plan or other submission to the ACC unless there is a new electric generation facility with equal or greater power generation that is presently available on the grid.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: DCS; hearings; complete disclosure requirements
rollCalls.summary: Requires a petition to terminate parental rights or to determine dependency of a child, to include a notarized affidavit stating that there has been full disclosure and an exchange of all information in the custody of the Department of Child Safety (DCS) and evidence relating to the matter. Outlines affidavit requirements and modifies the procedures the court must follow when finding the allegations in a dependency petition are true.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: grandfathered right; Willcox AMA; extension
rollCalls.summary: Retroactive to January 8, 2025, extends the time period, from no later than 15 months to no later than 21 months after the date of the designation of the Willcox Active Management Area (AMA), in which a person claiming the right to withdraw or receive and use groundwater in the Willcox AMA pursuant to a grandfathered right must apply for a certificate of grandfathered right with the Arizona Department of Water Resources (ADWR).
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: technical correction; groundwater rights; AMAs
rollCalls.summary: Allows a person that owns acres of land within a subsequent active management area (AMA) described on an irrigation grandfathered right (IGFR) that have not been retired from irrigation for a non-irrigation use, to apply to the Director of the Arizona Department of Water Resources (ADWR) to add acres of land within the same groundwater basin or subbasin to the person's IGFR. Grants the owner or lessee of the additional acres the right to use groundwater to irrigate the additional acres.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: technical correction; plants; containers; non-irrigation
rollCalls.summary: Expands non-irrigation uses of groundwater in an active management area (AMA) to include using groundwater to water plants grown using hydroponics and wine grapes.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: small land subdivision; requirements
rollCalls.summary: Allows the county board of supervisors (county BOS) of each county to adopt ordinances and regulations that allow small land subdivisions of 6 to 10 lots or parcels for parcels that are 2 acres or more in size and not subject to an assured water supply requirement or a mandatory adequate water supply requirement. Requires an applicant for small land subdivisions to submit a small land subdivision report and notice. Prescribes disclosure requirements for small land subdivisions and civil penalties for violations.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: notice; violation; deficiency correction
rollCalls.summary: Modifies the procedures relating to inspections for a regulated person by requiring an agency to provide a regulated person with the opportunity to correct an alleged deficiency.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: native plants; fire prevention; exemption
