rollCalls.summary: Exempts the Department of Forestry and Fire Management (DFFM), if the State Forester determines necessary to prevent, manage or suppress wildfires, from the requirement that the DFFM notify the Arizona Department of Agriculture (AZDA) before the removal or destruction of native plants over an area of state land exceeding one-fourth acre.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: fentanyl; motor vehicle; sentencing
rollCalls.summary: Establishes specific sentencing ranges for persons convicted of possession or transportation of a narcotic drug if the offense involves the possession of fentanyl in a motor vehicle in an amount of at least 200 grams.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: manufactured housing; certification; compliance
rollCalls.summary: Modifies certification requirements relating to manufactured housing.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: school districts; leases; termination; nonrenewal
rollCalls.summary: Grants a charter school that is leasing or is the most recent lessee of a building owned by a school district the right of first refusal to purchase the building if the building is up for sale. Prescribes actions a school district must take before terminating or refusing to renew a lease for school buildings. Exempts proceeds derived from the sale or lease of school property to other schools from the statutory restrictions on the expenditure of proceeds derived from the sale or lease of school property.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: electoral college; support
rollCalls.summary: Declares that the Legislature affirms the importance of the electoral college for presidential elections in the United States.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: victims; disclosure requirements; witnesses; names
rollCalls.summary: Allows a victim's name to be redacted from records released pursuant to a public records request if the agency reasonably expects that the release of the victim's name will result in harassment of the victim, threats to the victim's safety or witness tampering, with outlined exceptions.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: trusts; estates; policies; procedures
rollCalls.summary: Modifies various terms that are used when dealing with trusts, estates and protective proceedings.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: health education; fetal development instruction
rollCalls.summary: Requires the State Board of Education (SBE) to require all health education instruction provided to students in grades 7 or 8 include outlined instruction on fetal development. Allows the SBE to require that health education instruction that is provided to students in any of grades 1 through 6 or 9 through 12 include age-appropriate instruction on fetal development.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: genetic sequencing; insurance; prohibition
rollCalls.summary: Allows an insurer and the Arizona Health Care Cost Containment System (AHCCCS) to limit coverage for genetic sequencing if the company or operation is associated with a foreign adversary. Establishes prohibitions and requirements for health care institutions and research facilities relating to genetic sequencers and software used for genetic sequencing.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: unmanned aircraft; qualified immunity
rollCalls.summary: Immunizes a public entity or employee from liability to an unmanned aircraft operator for any injury to personal property caused by a peace officer rendering an unmanned aircraft inoperative under outlined conditions.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: groundwater permits; technical correction
rollCalls.summary: Modifies the definition of water supply development as it relates to the Water Infrastructure Finance Authority (WIFA) to include planning, designing, building or developing water-related facilities, permits or plans reasonably necessary for those facilities for remediation, including by a reclamation or remediation project that is approved by the U.S. Environmental Protection Agency (EPA) and that increases the availability of water.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: Arizona teachers academy; community colleges..
rollCalls.summary: Expands the definition of eligible postsecondary institution for the purposes of the Arizona Teachers Academy by including any Arizona community college.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: technical correction; certificate; environmental compatibility
rollCalls.summary: Allows a utility, after providing 30 days written notice to the Arizona Corporation Commission (ACC) to construct a new small modular nuclear reactor in Arizona without filing an application or receiving a certificate of environmental compatibility if the new or small nuclear reactor is co-located with a large industrial energy user.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: utility; resource plan; commission review
rollCalls.summary: Requires the Arizona Corporation Commission (ACC) to require an electric public service corporation in Arizona to prepare and submit an outlined integrated resource plan to the ACC for review and approval at least once every three years.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: noncustodial federal monies; appropriation
rollCalls.summary: Effective January 1, 2027, authorizes the Legislature to appropriate noncustodial federal monies.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: legislative subpoena; refusal; contempt
rollCalls.summary: Allows a legislative committee to hold a witness in contempt for neglecting to obey a legislative subpoena if an order of contempt is issued by the committee chairperson for failure to comply with the subpoena after the witness is given an opportunity for a hearing to present evidence as to why the witness is not in contempt. Requires all testimony produced pursuant to legislative proceedings to be sworn testimony under penalty of perjury.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: identification driver licenses; Native American
rollCalls.summary: Effective January 1, 2026, allows a distinguishing mark to show on a nonoperating identification or driver license that identifies the licensee as an enrolled member of a Native American tribe located in Arizona, if elected by an applicant who submits satisfactory proof, as outlined.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: financial technology; digital assets program
rollCalls.summary: Retitles the Arizona Regulatory Sandbox Program as the Financial Technology, Digital Assets and Blockchain Sandbox Program and modifies the definition of innovation to include digital assets.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: qualifying tax rate; tax bill
rollCalls.summary: Requires each property tax bill and property tax statement prepared for any property located within a school district to include a prescribed statement regarding specified tax rates.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: public meetings; records; requirements; penalties
rollCalls.summary: Modifies requirements relating to open meeting law and public records requests by requiring the minutes or recording of a public meeting to be available online for public inspection, within three working days after the meeting and remain available online indefinitely. Requires the Attorney General (AG) to respond to a violation of open meeting law within with 120 days. Requires electronic copies of public records to be provided on request and charges for the public record to be provided in the least expensive manner possible with a preference for providing electronic copies.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: workers' compensation; assigned risk plan
rollCalls.summary: Outlines the factors that exclude an employer who is refused workers' compensation coverage from placement in the assigned risk plan.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: school districts; board meetings; expenditures
rollCalls.summary: Requires a school district governing board (governing board) to hold governing board meetings at a public facility in the school district and provide public access to meeting materials and recordings as outlined. Prescribes requirements on a governing board regarding the approval of out-of-state travel for school employees and governing board members.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: DCS; vaccinations; child placement
rollCalls.summary: Prohibits the Department of Child Safety (DCS) from refusing to place a child with a foster home or kinship foster care parent based solely on the vaccination status of the child or other children in the home.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: children with disabilities; evaluation; deadline
rollCalls.summary: Requires a home school district, if a child's parent submits a request between May 1 and August 15 for an evaluation in accordance with the federal Individuals with Disabilities Education Act (IDEA), to begin the evaluation or provide the parent notice of refusal to conduct the evaluation within 15 calendar days.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: JPs; constables; signatures
rollCalls.summary: Requires a nomination petition for a candidate for justice of the peace or constable, in a county with a population of fewer than 1,000,000 persons, to receive either 300 signatures or at least one percent of the number of qualified signers in the precinct, rather than requiring the candidates to receive at least one percent of qualified signers in the precinct.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: birth certificates; amendments; prohibition
rollCalls.summary: Modifies the conditions and procedures relating to amending a person's birth certificate and prohibits the sex designation of a person from being changed on the person's original birth certificate as a result of a sex change surgery. Prohibits a commissioner from ordering an amendment to a person's name on the person's birth certificate.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: voting locations; emergency designation; electioneering
rollCalls.summary: Modifies restrictions related to electioneering and requires all government-owned buildings or facilities of a county, city or town that are accessible to the public to be made available as voting locations on request.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: administrative hearings; change of judge
rollCalls.summary: Grants one peremptory change of administrative law judge to the parties to a contested case or an appealable agency action and adds conflicts of interest and being a material witness in an action to the reasons for which a party may file a nonperemptory motion to disqualify an administrative law judge.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: critical telecommunications infrastructure; construction requirements
rollCalls.summary: Effective January 1, 2026, establishes the Secure Telecommunications Act of 2025 which prohibits, and requires the removal of, any critical telecommunications infrastructure that uses equipment manufactured by a foreign adversary and prescribes reporting requirements for telecommunications providers and penalties for noncompliance.
rollCalls.question: Final Reading

rollCalls.title: postconviction relief proceedings; hourly rate
rollCalls.summary: Allows court appointed counsel of a capital defendant for state postconviction relief proceedings to receive compensation exceeding $100 per hour if the higher compensation rate has been approved by the county board of supervisors (BOS) and does not exceed $200 per hour.
rollCalls.question: Final Reading

rollCalls.title: SNAP; TANF; public welfare; verification
rollCalls.summary: Establishes evaluation requirements for the Department of Economic Security (DES) to confirm eligibility for Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program (SNAP) benefits.
rollCalls.question: Final Reading

rollCalls.title: behavioral health facilities; accreditation
rollCalls.summary: Establishes patient intake form requirements for behavioral health outpatient treatment centers that are service providers for the Arizona Health Care Cost Containment System (AHCCCS) or a regional behavioral health authority. Requires the Department of Health Services (DHS) to provide a priority matrix for complaints filed against health care institutions on its public website and to implement an annual training program for licensing surveyors, supervisors and managers.
rollCalls.question: Final Reading

rollCalls.title: public utilities; electric grid improvements
rollCalls.summary: Requires the Arizona Corporation Commission (ACC), during the integrated resource planning process, to require a public service corporation to ensure that any changes to maintain or improve an electric power grid are capable of producing enough electricity to provide safe, adequate and reliable service throughout the year.
rollCalls.question: Final Reading

rollCalls.title: congregate care; dependent children; placement
rollCalls.summary: Requires the Department of Child Safety (DCS) to establish a minimum number of licensed foster homes sufficient to place a child in a licensed foster home that best meets the needs of the child. Outlines reporting requirements and procedures that DCS must follow within 30 days of placing a child in a congregate care setting. Prohibits licensed behavioral health facilities from denying placement of a foster child when outlined conditions apply. Makes modifications to the Foster Youth Permanency Pilot Project Team.
rollCalls.question: Final Reading

rollCalls.title: liquor sampling; reporting; requirements
rollCalls.summary: Establishes the criminal classification of impersonating a veteran , which a person commits by knowingly misrepresenting themselves to be a veteran and engaging in specified acts with intent to obtain money, property or any other tangible benefit.
rollCalls.question: Final Reading

rollCalls.title: law enforcement officers; probation; termination
rollCalls.summary: Modifies the permissive authority of an employer to terminate promoted or transferred law enforcement officers and police recruits under specified conditions and asseverates that an employer may terminate an officer at any time with just cause.
rollCalls.question: Final Reading

rollCalls.title: common expense liens; foreclosure; amount
rollCalls.summary: Increases the amount over which an owner in a planned community association (HOA) must be delinquent to $10,000 and the period of delinquency to 18 months for an HOA to foreclose a common expense lien.
rollCalls.question: Final Reading

rollCalls.title: grid security; cybersecurity; reviews; commission
rollCalls.summary: Requires the Arizona Corporation Commission (ACC) to conduct a grid security review at least every two years or as a part of the ACC's integrated resource planning process or biennial transmission assessment and make outlined assessments and evaluations when conducting the review.
rollCalls.question: Final Reading

rollCalls.title: homestead exemption; equity increase
rollCalls.summary: Requires certain municipalities to allow hotels and multifamily residential housing as an ancillary use in a district zoned for light industrial use without requiring an application that will require a public hearing if the ancillary use is located within an international headquarters campus and developed in accordance with prescribed standards.
rollCalls.question: Final Reading

rollCalls.title: workers' compensation; disability; definitions
rollCalls.summary: Modifies the requirements for the Industrial Commission of Arizona (ICA) to set a physician's schedule of fees for employee injuries under workers' compensation. Increases the monthly dependent allowance provided to an employee in addition to compensation for a temporary total disability.
rollCalls.question: Final Reading

rollCalls.title: election mailings; third-party disclosures
rollCalls.summary: Requires the words "not from a government agency" to appear on the outside of an election-related document that is mailed or hand delivered by any nongovernmental person or entity.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: voter registrations; payment prohibited
rollCalls.summary: Prohibits a person from paying or receiving anything of value based on the number of voter registration forms collected, completed or submitted.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: guardianship; minors; appointment; notice
rollCalls.summary: Modifies the conditions that allow the court to appoint a guardian for a minor, as well as the requirements relating to providing notice of the time and place of a guardianship hearing to the minor's living parents. Allows the court to extend the authority of a temporary guardian if the extension is in the best interests of the minor.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: cell phone carrier; spam calls
rollCalls.summary: Prohibits a city, town or county from regulating the act of lawfully assessing or using computational power in a residence.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: parenting time; neutral exchange location
rollCalls.summary: Allows a court to order that the custody of minor child is exchanged at a safe exchange location and a sheriff's office and city or town police department to designate two or more parking spots as a neutral safe exchange location and prescribes requirements for designated locations.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: notices; directory information; disclosure; consent
rollCalls.summary: Allows a school to disclose student directory information if the school notifies a parent or eligible student of the information designated as directory information and of the right to refuse the disclosure of the information. Outlines directory information that may not be disclosed unless outlined conditions are met. Modifies requirements relating to a school district's parental involvement policy.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: truth in taxation; bonds; notices
rollCalls.summary: Adds the tax rate and estimated cost associated with each proposed capital improvement for a single-family home valued at $400,000 to the information required to be included in an informational pamphlet for certain budget override and bond elections. Adds the estimated tax impact of an increase in property taxes on a home valued at $400,000 to the information required to be included in a statutorily required Truth in Taxation hearing notice of tax increase (TNT notice).
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: pharmacies; emergency authority
rollCalls.summary: Requires the rules adopted by the Arizona State Board of Pharmacy (Board) relating to the emergency provision of pharmaceutical care and drug device delivery to allow pharmacies owned by a health system to compound and repackage prescription drugs on a nonpatient-specific basis during a declared natural disaster or terrorist attack.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: liquor sampling; reporting; requirements.
rollCalls.summary: Prescribes the authorized means for a licensed beer and wine store or liquor store with sampling privileges to maintain and report required sampling records.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: school immunizations; exemption; adult students
rollCalls.summary: Requires a higher education institution that requires students to submit documentary proof of immunization to exempt any student who is at least 18 years old from the requirement if the student submits a statement that the student understands the risks of nonimmunization and does not consent to the immunizations due to personal beliefs or an outlined written certification that states that one or more of the required immunizations may be detrimental to the student's health.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: parental notification; school immunization exemptions
rollCalls.summary: Requires any school communication regarding school immunization requirements to a parent, guardian or person in loco parentis to include information about school immunization exemptions.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: life insurance; illustrations
rollCalls.summary: Effective January 1, 2026, prescribes requirements for life insurance policy forms and illustrations.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: water improvements program; water hauling
rollCalls.summary: Modifies the requirements of a water improvement program by allowing persons to make gifts, grants or donations for the purpose of providing financial assistance to qualified owners of residential real property for water hauling for water delivery and adds acquiring or installing storage tanks for receiving and storing water delivered through water hauling to the list of projects that a recipient's grant must be used toward.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: subsequent AMA; director; removal
rollCalls.summary: Requires the Director of Arizona Department of Water Resources (ADWR) to periodically review all areas that are included within a subsequent AMA to determine whether the areas continue to meet the statutorily outlined criteria for inclusion in an AMA. Allows the Director of ADWR, if the Director of ADWR determines that an area no longer meets the criteria for inclusion as a subsequent AMA, to remove the subsequent AMA designation. Outlines public hearing and notification requirements for the removal of a subsequent AMA designation.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: subsequent AMA; voters; removal
rollCalls.summary: Allows, beginning 10 years after the designation of a subsequent active management area (AMA), 10 percent of the registered voters who reside within the boundaries of the subsequent AMA to file an outlined petition to remove the subsequent AMA designation. Outlines requirements for the Director of the Arizona Department of Water Resources (ADWR) to examine the groundwater condition in the basin and file an order in the county recorder's office declaring whether or not the AMA is necessary.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: acting in concert; evidence; exceptions
rollCalls.summary: Outlines exemptions to unlawful acting in concert for the purpose of the sale or lease of subdivision lots or parcels of land.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: real estate; definition of contiguous
rollCalls.summary: Modifies the definition for contiguous relating to subdivision requirements.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: governor; attorney general; duties; immigration
rollCalls.summary: Mandates that the Governor, the Attorney General (AG) and each county, city and town must enforce, administer and cooperate with actions, orders and programs that relate to the enforcement of federal immigration laws until January 20, 2029.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: minerals; land inventory; technical correction
rollCalls.summary: Adds, to the criteria allowing a vehicle owner to participate in the Voluntary Vehicle Repair Program (VVRP), that the vehicle owner repair the vehicle not more than 60 days after acceptance into the VVRP. Extends the Waste Tire Fund (Fund) and Program from January 1, 2026, to January 1, 2029.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: suicide prevention special plate
rollCalls.summary: Establishes special plates for 988 suicide awareness, America250, Arizona bicycling, education fundraising, the Hopi Tribe, Italian Americans, kidney disease awareness, made in Arizona, public safety personnel mental health, sororities and fraternities and a youth charities organization.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: model city tax code; notice
rollCalls.summary: Requires a municipality that proposes an ordinance to adopt or repeal a model or local option in the Model City Tax Code (MCTC) to notify all affected taxpayers before the proposed ordinance is approved or rejected, with exceptions.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: medical records; parental rights
rollCalls.summary: Requires a healthcare entity, while maintaining required confidentiality, to provide the parent of a minor child with access to any electronic portal and delivery platform for the minor's medical records, regardless of whether parental consent is required for the medical treatment rendered.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: write-in candidates; filings; ballots
rollCalls.summary: Modifies elections procedures relating to special district mail ballot elections, hand count audits, inactive voters on the active early voting list (AEVL), valid justice precinct designations for certain justice of the peace and constable candidates and the circumstances relating to the cure period which require the county recorder or city or town clerk's office to be open during the weekend before and after the election.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: voting locations; political party observers
rollCalls.summary: Adds on-site and emergency early voting locations, and other early voting locations, to the voting locations at which a county party chairperson may designate persons to act as challengers. Requires, rather than allows, persons designated by the county chairperson to act as challenger for that party.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: subsequent AMA; previously nonirrigated land
rollCalls.summary: Allows a person in a subsequent Active Management Area (AMA), on the Director of the Arizona Department of Water Resources' (ADWR's) determination of Irrigation Grandfathered Rights (IGFR), to irrigate land that was not previously subject to irrigation if outlined conditions apply.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: historical water use; subsequent AMA
rollCalls.summary: Retroactive to August 30, 2022, modifies the time frames, from 5 years to 10 years, prior to a designation of a subsequent active management area (AMA) or an AMA, that are used to determine the amount of groundwater a person has the right to withdraw for irrigation and non-irrigation groundwater rights.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: groundwater model; stormwater recharge; AMAs
rollCalls.summary: Requires the Director of the Arizona Department of Water Resources (ADWR) to adopt rules and annually update the groundwater model for active management areas (AMA) to account for new natural, incidental or artificial stormwater recharge.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: electric vehicle charging stations; report
rollCalls.summary: Adds gasoline fuel reformulation options for all gasoline sold or offered for sale for use in motor vehicles in a county with a population of 1,200,000 or more people and in Area A. Allows any person to petition the Associate Director of the Plant Services Division of the Arizona Department of Agriculture (Associate Director) to request a waiver from the statutorily prescribed standards for motor fuel or the federal standards established by the U.S. Environmental Protection Agency (EPA) Clean Air Act.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: silent witness; records; nondisclosure; exceptions
rollCalls.summary: Prohibits the disclosure of any information that may be used to identify an individual who submits an anonymous tip, unless required by a constitutional, legal or ethical duty or on a motion that establishes good cause and prescribes requirements for legal proceedings and the retention of tip materials.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: AHCCCS; enrollment verification; presumptive eligibility
rollCalls.summary: Establishes, beginning January 1, 2026, enrollment verification requirements for the Arizona Health Care Cost Containment System (AHCCCS) to confirm member eligibility and standards for qualified hospitals to make presumptive eligibility determinations.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: behavioral health; temporary licensure; graduates
rollCalls.summary: Provides a 90-day licensure exemption for a college graduate who is in the process of applying for an associate level license, possesses a valid fingerprint clearance card and has completed an accredited course of study in social work, counseling, marriage and family therapy or addiction counseling.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: voter registration cards; mailing limitation
rollCalls.summary: Prohibits the county recorder from providing an initial or updated voter registration card to anyone whose mailing address is outside of Arizona, with outlined exceptions.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: dental board; formal hearings
rollCalls.summary: Modifies the procedures of the Arizona State Board of Dental Examiners (BODEX) when investigating and adjudicating a complaint against a licensee. Specifies examination requirements for a dental hygienist to administer local anesthetics.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: state sovereign authority; elections
rollCalls.summary: Asserts the sovereign authority of Arizona election statutes over qualifications to vote in federal elections that are held in Arizona.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: sex-based terms; laws; rules; regulations
rollCalls.summary: Requires any policy, program, rule or law that prohibits sex discrimination to prohibit the unfair treatment of a female or male in relation to a similarly situated member of the opposite sex. Provides statutory definitions for boy , father , female , girl , male , man , mother and sex .
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: public schools; ultraprocessed foods
rollCalls.summary: Prohibits, beginning in school year 2026-2027, any school that participates in a federally funded or assisted meal program from serving, selling or allowing a third party to sell ultraprocessed food on school campus during the normal school day.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: SNAP; prohibited purchases; waiver
rollCalls.summary: Requires the Director of the Department of Economic Security (Director) to request a waiver from the U.S. Department of Agriculture (USDA) to exclude soda from the Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program (SNAP) and, if the waiver is granted, to prohibit SNAP enrollees from purchasing soda with SNAP benefits.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: public safety cancer insurance
rollCalls.summary: Modifies the calculation of the administrative costs of the Public Safety Personnel Retirement System's (PSPRS's) Cancer Insurance Program (CIP).
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: child care facilities; program providers
rollCalls.summary: Prescribes requirements for an out-of-school time (OST) program provider licensed as a child care facility to maintain rosters of school-age children.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: sexual conduct; minor; classification; sentence
rollCalls.summary: Increases the penalty for sexual conduct with a minor who is at least 15 years old from a class 6 felony to a class 4 felony, if the defendant is more than 60 months older than the victim and is at least 21 years old at the time of the offense.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: environmental remediation; liability; release
rollCalls.summary: Allows the Arizona Department of Environmental Quality (ADEQ) to provide to a prospective remediator of a site, a written release and covenant not to sue. Allows the agreement with ADEQ and a prospective remediator to include an agreement by the prospective remediator to provide substantial funding or other resources to perform or facilitate remedial measures at a facility.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: commercial driver license examiners; notice
rollCalls.summary: Requires use fuel dispenser labels to be provided to vendors that submit receipts from one fueling position for each use fuel type and, if applicable, one in-store point of sale system.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: mandatory reporting; school employees; investigations
rollCalls.summary: Adds school district governing board (governing board) and charter school governing body (governing body) members to the list of individuals subject to the duty to report abuse, physical injury, neglect and denial or deprivation of medical care or nourishment of minors (abuse of minors). Expands reporting and investigation requirements relating to the duty to report immoral or unprofessional conduct.
rollCalls.question: Final Reading

rollCalls.title: emergency use products; employers; prohibition
rollCalls.summary: Prohibits an employer, government entity or healthcare entity from requiring the administration of an emergency use product.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: ballot order; names; parties; rotation
rollCalls.summary: Modifies, beginning in 2027, requirements for the rotation of political party candidates on the ballot for a general election.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: registered sanitarians; qualifications
rollCalls.summary: Modifies the eligibility requirements for registration as a sanitarian.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: opioids; containers; labeling; requirements; repeal
rollCalls.summary: Eliminates the requirement that prescription opioid containers, directly dispensed by a pharmacist and not for immediate use, have a red cap.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: condominiums; commercial structures; residential structures
rollCalls.summary: Requires a condominium that includes commercial structures that are separate from the residential structures to assess common expenses that exclusively benefit the residential or commercial structures against the respective units.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: development; adaptive reuse; rezoning; prohibition
rollCalls.summary: An emergency measure that modifies the requirement for certain municipalities to establish objective standards for multifamily residential development or adaptive reuse of existing commercial, office and mixed use buildings.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: hazardous substance release; notice; liability
rollCalls.summary: Requires the owner of a qualifying property where there has been a release or threatened release of a hazardous substance to provide written notice that there has been a release or threatened release of a hazardous substance on the qualifying property to any prospective buyer of the qualifying property, the Director of the Arizona Department of Environmental Quality (ADEQ) and the State Mine Inspector if the site is a mine or abandoned mine.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: professional registration; reciprocity; endorsement
rollCalls.summary: Outlines the qualifications for registration with the Arizona Board of Technical Registration (AZBTR) as a professional engineer, architect, land surveyor or landscape architect in Arizona through reciprocity or endorsement.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: tracking system; sexual assault kits
rollCalls.summary: Establishes a Sexual Assault Kit Evidence Tracking System (System) to track and update the location and status of sexual assault kits (SAKs) and prescribes requirements for System operations and records.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: hunting; fishing; license; deferred prosecution
rollCalls.summary: Allows the Arizona Game and Fish Commission (Commission), on entering a deferred prosecution agreement and after a public hearing, to revoke or suspend a license issued to any person and deny the person the right to secure another license to take or possess wildlife for a period of up to five years for statutorily outlined violations and the unlawful taking or possession of wildlife.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: nuclear energy; Palo Verde; support
rollCalls.summary: Expresses the Legislatures support for the Palo Verde Generating Station and the safe and efficient use of nuclear energy to supply the energy consumption needs of the people of Arizona.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: corrections; Marana; transitional facility; study
rollCalls.summary: Directs the Arizona Department of Corrections, Rehabilitation and Reentry (ADCRR) to conduct a comprehensive study that determines whether the Marana Prison Site could be converted into and used as a transitional facility and program.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: state land transfer; Bullhead City
rollCalls.summary: Transfers the title of approximately 38.38 acres of state sovereign land from the Arizona State Land Department (ASLD) to Bullhead City.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: craft producer; festival; fair; license
rollCalls.summary: Establishes a craft producer festival license and a craft producer fair license. Repeals statutes authorizing farm winery, craft distillery and microbrewery festival and fair licenses.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: legal document preparers; license requirements
rollCalls.summary: Adds legal document preparers to the licensees who, when earning continuing education credit towards a state agency license renewal, must also earn credit towards the licensee's annual continuing legal education (CLE) activity requirement.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: topical medications
rollCalls.summary: Allows any unused portion of a facility-provided multidose medication (topical medication) that was administered to a patient to be offered to the patient on discharge from a hospital or outpatient surgical center if specified conditions apply.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: self-certification program; administrative review
rollCalls.summary: Requires, rather than allows, a city or town by ordinance to authorize administrative personnel to review and approve certain development documents.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: self-certification program; administrative review
rollCalls.summary: Requires, rather than allows, a city or town by ordinance to authorize administrative personnel to review and approve certain development documents.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: pharmacists; emergency medication; administration
rollCalls.summary: Allows a pharmacist to order and administer emergency medication to manage an acute allergic reaction to medication that was administered at the pharmacy and requires the pharmacist to notify the person's primary care provider within 48 hours of administering the emergency medication.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: hydrolyzed cocaine; threshold amount
rollCalls.summary: Modifies the statutory drug threshold amount for hydrolyzed cocaine by including it in the existing 9 gram threshold amount for regular cocaine.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: medical assistants; scope of practice
rollCalls.summary: Allows a medical assistant to place and remove urinary catheters under the general supervision of a physician, physician assistant (PA) nurse practitioner (NP), clinical nurse specialist or certified nurse midwife.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: communications from inmate; victims' right
rollCalls.summary: Expands the prohibition against an inmate sending correspondence to a victim to include any written, verbal or nonverbal communication, rather than just mail, if the victim has requested to not receive such correspondence.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: observing nude minor; sexual gratification
rollCalls.summary: Deems that a person commits sexual exploitation of a minor by knowingly observing a nude minor for the purpose of engaging in sexual conduct for the person's sexual gratification and outlines defenses to a prosecution for sexual exploitation of a minor .
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: small estate; affidavit; limits
rollCalls.summary: Increases the maximum value of real or personal property that allows a small estate to be transferred to the decedent's successor through an affidavit.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: mental health inquiry; prohibition
rollCalls.summary: Prohibits a health profession regulatory board or licensing authority from asking on an application for a license, permit, certificate, endorsement or registration whether an applicant has received mental health assistance, diagnosis or treatment.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: on-site wastewater treatment; general permit
rollCalls.summary: Requires the Director of the Arizona Department of Environmental Quality (ADEQ), by January 1, 2026, to issue a general permit that authorizes a liquid effluent collection system that is designed as a septic tank effluent pump system or a septic tank effluent gravity system, complies with statutorily prescribed requirements relating to general permits for defined classes of facilities and is owned or operated by a single person.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: appropriation; waterline project; Ganado
rollCalls.summary: Appropriates $340,000 in FY 2026 from the state General Fund (state GF) to the Arizona Department of Administration (ADOA) to distribute to the Navajo Nation for the Ganado Waterline Pipeline Project.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: loan agreements; escrow
rollCalls.summary: Prescribes exceptions to an escrow agent's authorization to only use monies in an escrow account to make a onetime payment or multiple payments pursuant to a loan agreement.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: justices of the peace; online signature
rollCalls.summary: Adds justice of the peace and constable to the list of offices for which the Secretary of State (SOS) must provide the means for qualified electors to electronically sign nomination petitions by using the online signature collection system (E-Qual).
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: school policies; internet; wireless devices
rollCalls.summary: Requires each school district governing board (governing board) and charter school governing body (governing body) to prescribe and enforce policies and procedures that govern student access to internet, restrict student access to social media platforms and limit student use of wireless communication devices during the school day as outlined, unless the school district or charter school has existing policies and procedures that meet the prescribed requirements on the effective date.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: campaign finance; third-party complaints
rollCalls.summary: Prohibits a filing officer from accepting a complaint from a third-party unless the complaint is filed by an individual, or by an individual on behalf of an entity, who submits evidence that the individual is an identifiable human being.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: CORP; defined contribution; membership election
rollCalls.summary: Prescribes employee and employer contribution rates for Corrections Officer Retirement Plan (CORP) employers and CORP members who participate in the Public Safety Personnel Retirement System (PSPRS) Defined Contribution Plan.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: animal cruelty; classification
rollCalls.summary: Increases criminal penalties associated with animal cruelty offenses.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: early ballots; identification; tabulation
rollCalls.summary: Requires early ballots to be returned to the county recorder or a designated location by 7:00 p.m. on the Friday before election day, after which a voter must present prescribed identification, in order for the ballot to be counted and valid. Allows county recorders to provide for on-site tabulation of early ballots at any time during the period of early voting, rather than only on election day. Eliminates emergency voting that occurs between 7:00 p.m. on the Friday before election day and 5:00 p.m. on the Monday before election day.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: public school tax credit; purposes
rollCalls.summary: Retroactive to July 1, 2024, extends, until June 30, 2029, the specified purposes for which a public school may use monies contributed for the purposes of the Public School Extracurricular Activity Fees Tax Credit.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: veterinarian malpractice actions; damages
rollCalls.summary: Allows a person, if the person prevails in a malpractice action against a veterinarian, to receive specified reasonable damages for the death or injury of the person's domestic animal.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: cosmetics sales; animal testing; prohibitions
rollCalls.summary: Deems it unlawful for a manufacturer to knowingly sell or offer for sale, in Arizona, a cosmetic that used cosmetic animal testing during the development or manufacture of the cosmetic and subjects a manufacturer that violates the prohibition on cosmetic animal testing to a civil penalty of up to $1,000 for the first day of the violation and an additional civil penalty of $500 for each day the violation continues.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: veterinarians; malpractice; unprofessional conduct
rollCalls.summary: Expands the scope of what is considered unprofessional, dishonorable or sanctionable conduct by veterinarians. Increases, from $1,000 to $1,900, the maximum civil penalty for veterinary malpractice that can be charged by the Arizona State Veterinary Medical Examining Board (Board).
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: CORP; defined contribution; membership election
rollCalls.summary: Prescribes employee and employer contribution rates for Corrections Officer Retirement Plan (CORP) employers and CORP members who participate in the Public Safety Personnel Retirement System (PSPRS) Defined Contribution Plan.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: death benefits; burial costs
rollCalls.summary: Increases the amount of burial expenses, from $5,000 to $10,000, that are paid as a workers' compensation death benefit in the case of a workplace injury causing death.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: workers' compensation; death benefits; remarriage
rollCalls.summary: Establishes workers' compensation death benefit payment requirements for the surviving spouse of a first responder, including allowing the surviving spouse to receive death benefit payments until their death. Applies the death benefit eligibility to spouses of first responders who lost benefits due to remarriage on or after January 1, 2000, only for prospective benefit payments.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: animal cruelty; classification
rollCalls.summary: Increases criminal penalties associated with animal cruelty offenses.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: animal cruelty; failure to treat
rollCalls.summary: Broadens the conditions that must be met for a person to commit cruelty to animals.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: technical correction; military; special plates
rollCalls.summary: Establishes the Sheriff's Criminal Justice Commission (SCJC) and repeals the Arizona Criminal Justice Commission (ACJC).
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: defensive driving schools; fees.
rollCalls.summary: Prohibits, beginning December 31, 2028, the state, a state agency or a state agency's independent contractor from operating an unmanned aircraft that is manufactured or assembled by a company domiciled in the People's Republic of China for collecting data concerning any restricted critical infrastructure unless the unmanned aircraft is equipped with outlined software to prevent the extraction of intelligence data by a covered foreign entity.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: municipal development; permits; review
rollCalls.summary: Authorizes third party reviews of single-family residential building permit applications in a municipality with a population of 30,000 persons or more. Modifies municipal licensing time frame requirements.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: permanent school fund; distribution; uses
rollCalls.summary: Subject to voter approval, statutorily requires, beginning in FY 2027, the State Treasurer and the Arizona State Land Department (ASLD) to annually transfer Permanent State School Fund (Permanent School Fund) monies to provide guaranteed financing for common schools to acquire, construct, refinance or improve capital facilities before transferring Permanent School Fund monies for any other authorized purpose.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: TPT; use tax; exemption; aviation
rollCalls.summary: Expands aviation related transaction privilege tax (TPT) deductions and use tax exemptions to include property used for maintaining, repairing or overhauling general aviation aircraft and property used for aircraft repair, remodeling or maintenance, rather than only property used for such purposes by persons who are certified or licensed carriers of persons and property.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: transportation system performance; ADOT
rollCalls.summary: Adds requirements and restrictions for the development, measurement and delivery of transportation system performance factors that include modified variables and prescribed weights.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: ADOT; report; construction projects; bidders
rollCalls.summary: Establishes a reporting requirement for when the lowest responsible bidder is not selected for a construction contract.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: biosolids; land application; immunity
rollCalls.summary: Requires the Director of the Arizona Department of Environmental Quality (ADEQ) to adopt rules for the application of biosolids to agricultural lands that are consistent with regulations from the U.S. Environmental Protection Agency (EPA) regarding standards for the use or disposal of sewage sludge. Requires the Arizona State Land Commissioner (Commissioner) to require an agricultural lessee of state lands to comply with outlined regulations, including rules and laws on the use of fertilizers, biosolids and soil amendments.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: litigation; financing; consumer protection; enforcement
rollCalls.summary: Effective January 1, 2026, prescribes consumer protection requirements for litigation financing agreements.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: school safety; cell phone bans
rollCalls.summary: Expands the School Safety Program (Program) to support the costs of implementing a policy to limit the use of cell phones in school classrooms. Outlines requirements for a Program proposal to implement a policy to limit the use of cell phones in school classrooms.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: issuance; affidavit; arrest warrant
rollCalls.summary: Requires a magistrate to issue an arrest warrant for a person if presented with an affidavit that establishes probable cause that a felony offense has been committed, and modifies requirements relating to where a person who is arrested by virtue of an arrest warrant must be brought before the court.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: impaired persons; court-ordered stabilization
rollCalls.summary: Establishes a court ordered stabilization process for the treatment of persons who are impaired due to intoxication, withdrawal or substance-induced symptoms and outlines procedures and requirements related to the court ordered stabilization and treatment of impaired persons. Prohibits an impaired person from being charged for the services related to the person's court ordered stabilization treatment.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: technical correction; legal opinions; schools
rollCalls.summary: Appropriates $957,180 and 5 FTEs from the state General Fund (state GF) in FY 2026 to the Arizona Department of Agriculture (AZDA) for outlined positions.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: technical correction; self-service storage; notice
rollCalls.summary: Establishes the Department of Natural Resources (Department) to oversee the acquisition and management of all state lands as outlined. Establishes the Commission on Natural Resources (Commission), administered by the Department, to administer the laws of the state relating to natural resources.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: appropriation; wildfire readiness and response
rollCalls.summary: Appropriates $12,500,000 from the state General Fund (state GF) in FY 2026 to the Department of Forestry and Fire Management (DFFM) to award grants to fire districts for wildfire readiness and response. Appropriates $250,000 from the state GF in FY 2026 to the Arizona Trail Fund and exempts the appropriation from lapsing.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: PSPRS; part-time employment
rollCalls.summary: Allows, beginning July 1, 2026, part-time municipal police officers, state highway patrol officers and county sheriffs and deputies who are engaged to work as patrol officers and who meet other specified requirements to participate in the Public Safety Personnel Retirement System (PSPRS) and receive credited service for the part time service, if the employer has chosen to allow part-time employees to participate and the part-time work is for a maximum period of six years due to specified qualifying events.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: brass knuckles; purchase; possession; minors
rollCalls.summary: Deems it unlawful for a juvenile to purchase or possess brass knuckles and classifies a violation as a class 3 misdemeanor.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: noncertificated school personnel; disciplinary action
rollCalls.summary: Requires specified school district personnel to obtain a fingerprint clearance card, rather than be fingerprinted, as a condition of employment and removes exemptions for outlined school personnel from the requirement to be fingerprinted or obtain a fingerprint clearance card. Subjects charter school personnel to the requirements of school district personnel to receive a fingerprint check or obtain a fingerprint clearance card.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: reimbursement rate increases; appropriations
rollCalls.summary: Appropriates $50,000,000 from the state General Fund (state GF) and $84,201,000 in Medicaid Expenditure Authority in each of FYs 2026 through 2030 to the Department of Economic Security (DES) for reimbursement rate increases for home and community-based services (HCBS) and room and board services for individuals with intellectual and developmental disabilities.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: temporary assistance; child only case
rollCalls.summary: Expands the definition of child only case , for purposes of Temporary Assistance for Needy Families (TANF) Cash Assistance eligibility, to include cases in which an eligible dependent child is living with a nonparent relative that is both responsible for meeting the basic needs of the child and is not receiving Cash Assistance.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: advanced air mobility infrastructure
rollCalls.summary: Requires, beginning September 1, 2026, the Arizona Department of Transportation (ADOT) to develop or upgrade a statewide aviation plan for advanced air mobility infrastructure.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: congregate care; dependent children; placement
rollCalls.summary: Requires the Department of Child Safety (DCS) to establish a minimum number of licensed foster homes sufficient to place a child in a licensed foster home that best meets the needs of the child. Outlines reporting requirements and procedures that DCS must follow within 30 days of placing a child in a congregate care setting. Prohibits licensed behavioral health facilities from denying placement of a foster child when outlined conditions apply. Makes modifications to the Foster Youth Permanency Pilot Project Team.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: school mapping data; requirements; accessibility.
rollCalls.summary: Establishes the School Mapping Data Program (Program) and School Mapping Data Program Fund (Program Fund) to facilitate efficient emergency responses on school campuses. Outlines administrative and policy requirements for the Program. Appropriates $10,360,000 from the state General Fund in FY 2026 to the Program Fund.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: group home monitoring program
rollCalls.summary: Extends the Developmental Disabilities Group Home Monitoring Program (Program) past the three-year pilot period until January 1, 2031, and modifies Program requirements.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: department of housing; continuation.
rollCalls.summary: Continues the Arizona Department of Housing (ADOH) for four years. Modifies the powers and duties of ADOH.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: appropriation; law enforcement; recruitment
rollCalls.summary: Appropriates $2,000,000 from the state General Fund (state GF) in FY 2026 to the Department of Public Safety (DPS) to acquire coaching resource providers and administer the Law Enforcement Recruitment and Retention Grant Program (Program).
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: appropriation; secure behavioral health facilities
rollCalls.summary: Appropriates $25,000,000 from the state General Fund (state GF) to the Arizona Health Care Cost Containment System (AHCCCS) to distribute for secure behavioral health residential facilities (SBHRF). Requires appropriated monies to be used either to construct new SBHRFs or to retrofit existing buildings for use as SBHRFs. Outlines reporting requirements, and metrics and outcomes that each SBHRF must measure and evaluate.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: helium exploration; aquifer protection permit
rollCalls.summary: Allows a county improvement district (District) that is formed in a subsequent active management area (AMA), for the purpose of delivering water through water hauling, to exercise the power of eminent domain only for the limited purpose of acquiring or otherwise securing a site in the subsequent AMA for the construction of and legal access to a single well and a standpipe to produce water and make water available at the site for delivery through water hauling.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: appropriations; anesthesia; rotations
rollCalls.summary: Establishes the Student Registered Nurse Anesthetist Clinical Rotation Program (Program) to expand the capacity of preceptor training programs for nurse anesthetist students and appropriates $3,000,000 from the state General Fund (state GF) in FY 2026 to the Arizona State Board of Nursing (AZBN) for Program administration.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: appropriation; midomafetamine; research
rollCalls.summary: Appropriates $10 million in FY 2026 from the state General Fund (state GF) to the Department of Health Services (DHS) to award grants for trials or other research relating to midomafetamine as a treatment for Post Traumatic Stress Disorder (PTSD).
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: computer-generated pictorial representations; unlawful disclosure
rollCalls.summary: Stipulates that, if an image depicting a person in a state of nudity or sexual activity is a realistic pictorial representation, the depicted person need not have a reasonable expectation of privacy for the nonconsensual disclosure of such image to be considered unlawful, unless the image was created or modified by the depicted person themselves.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: graduation; children with disabilities
rollCalls.summary: Authorizes an Individualized Education Program (IEP) team to determine that a student may benefit from special education and services until the end of the school year in which the student turns 22 years old. Prohibits the Arizona Department of Education (ADE) from imposing a penalty or withholding monies from a school for providing special education and services to a high school student for more than four years if the IEP extends the student's graduation date beyond four years.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: school district budgets; three years
rollCalls.summary: Requires a school district governing board (governing board) to prepare a budget for the next three fiscal years, rather than the fiscal year that immediately follows the current year.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: DCS; school visits; identification requirements
rollCalls.summary: Requires a Department of Child Safety (DCS) caseworker to present DCS identification when visiting a child at the child's school for the purpose of an interview. Requires, if a DCS caseworker denies or is unable to present identification, the school to contact the DCS office where the DCS caseworker is employed to verify the DCS caseworker's identification and employment.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: appropriation; criminal intelligence coordination center
rollCalls.summary: Appropriates $1,000,000 from the state General Fund (state GF) in FY 2026 to the State Treasurer to distribute to the Yavapai County Sheriff's Office to operate a criminal information intelligence analysis coordination center (CIIACC).
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: federal search; seizure; sheriff; permission
rollCalls.summary: Prohibits a federal employee who is not a certified peace officer in Arizona from making an arrest, search or seizure without written permission from the county sheriff or Attorney General (AG). Allows a county attorney to prosecute a person who executes an unlawful arrest, search or seizure for kidnapping, trespass, theft or homicide, if applicable. Outlines exemptions to the written permission requirements and allows the AG or a county sheriff to refuse permission for any reason considered sufficient.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: continuation; school facilities oversight board
rollCalls.summary: Continues the School Facilities Oversight Board (SFOB) for five years. Modifies conflict of interest disclosure requirements for SFOB employees and removes the authorization for the SFOB Director to expedite money requests for specified projects.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: independent corrections ombudsman; auditor general
rollCalls.summary: Establishes the Office of the Independent Corrections Ombudsman (Office) within the Ombudsman-Citizens Aide to monitor inmate health and safety and investigate related complaints.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: budget unit; vacant positions; reporting
rollCalls.summary: Requires the Arizona Department of Administration (ADOA) to collect a list of all vacant full-time equivalent positions (FTEs) that have been vacant for at least 150 days and requires each budget unit to eliminate the vacant positions each fiscal year, with outlined exceptions.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: appropriations; interoperability fund; equipment fund
rollCalls.summary: Reallocates specified distributions from the School Safety Interoperability Fund to the Peace Officer Training Equipment Fund.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: off-highway vehicles; weight
rollCalls.summary: Allows a 30-day temporary general use registration (temporary registration) to be issued to a nonresident who owns an off-highway vehicle (OHV) titled in another state and continues the Arizona OHV Study Committee (Study Committee) for two years.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: water protection; technical correction
rollCalls.summary: An emergency measure that establishes the process for the designation of a basin management area (BMA) to be initiated in the Gila Bend, Hualapai Valley or Willcox Groundwater Basin by a designation of the Director of the Arizona Department of Water Resources (ADWR) if outlined conditions apply or by an outlined petition to the Director of ADWR. Establishes a BMA council (BMA council) and outlines the goals of the BMA council. Outlines requirements for public meetings, reporting and groundwater rights. Repeals the Willcox Active Management Area (AMA) and establishes the Willcox BMA.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: unbuilt certificates; assured water supply
rollCalls.summary: Sets the Town of Wellton's penalty at $100 for exceeding its constitutional expenditure limitation in FY 2023.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: CTEDs; state universities; intergovernmental agreements
rollCalls.summary: Authorizes a career technical education district (CTED) and a public university to enter into an intergovernmental agreement (IGA) to provide administrative, operational and educational services or facilities if a community college district (CCD) in the county of the CTED is not able to offer the course or program in the next school year. Applies the IGA and funding calculation requirements for a CTED that enters into an IGA with a CCD to a CTED that enters into an IGA with a public university.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: municipal housing; preapproved design
rollCalls.summary: Requires municipalities to establish standard preapproved housing design plans or a preapproved housing design plan program, as prescribed. Modifies municipal annexation requirements.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: appropriation; behavioral health fee schedule
rollCalls.summary: Appropriates $15,000,000 from the state General Fund (state GF) to the Arizona Health Care Cost Containment System (AHCCCS) in FY 2026 for a 5 percent increase to the outpatient behavioral health fee schedule and outlines reporting requirements.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: transitional housing; reentry programs; licensure
rollCalls.summary: Establishes a regulatory system for the licensing and operation of transitional housing facilities to provide temporary living arrangements and basic living necessities to individuals transitioning from incarceration to independent living.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: appropriation; coal-impacted workforce; study
rollCalls.summary: Appropriates $600,000 from the state General Fund (state GF) in FY 2026 to the Office of Economic Opportunity (OEO) to conduct a workforce development study on the communities in Coconino County impacted by the closure of the Navajo Generating Station. Establishes the Study Committee on Coal Impacted Communities (Study Committee).
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: appropriation; Sage memorial hospital; dialysis
rollCalls.summary: Appropriates $3 million from the state General Fund (state GF) in FY 2026 to the Department of Health Services (DHS) to distribute to the Sage Memorial Hospital (Hospital).
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: patient rights; health care services
rollCalls.summary: Grants patients specified rights when receiving care from a healthcare professional in Arizona.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: ALTCS; rate increases; appropriations
rollCalls.summary: Appropriates $13,592,216 from the state General Fund (state GF) and $63,331,829 from Expenditure Authority to the Arizona Health Care Cost Containment System (AHCCCS) and $821,989 from the state GF and $1,504,001 in developmental disabilities Medicaid Expenditure Authority to the Department of Economic Security (DES) to provide rate increases in the Arizona Long Term Care System (ALTCS) for assisted living centers and skilled nursing facilities.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: student athletes; employment status; restrictions
rollCalls.summary: An emergency measure that outlines prohibitions and requirements on regulators, student athletes and postsecondary education institutions relating to the use of a student athlete's own name, image and likeness (NIL). Prescribes causes of action that may be brought in a court of competent jurisdiction for outlined violations relating to student athlete compensation. Allows a public university or an organization that has qualified for exemption from the taxation of income (nonprofit organization) that assists student athletes to earn compensation from NIL usage to conduct a raffle as prescribed.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: veterinary technicians; certification; education alternative
rollCalls.summary: Broadens the conditions that must be met for a person to commit cruelty to animals.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: state board; allegations of misconduct
rollCalls.summary: Allows the highest ranking official of a school or school district to request information from the State Board of Education (SBE) relating to allegations of conduct that, if true, constitutes grounds for disciplinary action before the SBE investigates the allegations or determines whether to take disciplinary action.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: sex offender management board; fund
rollCalls.summary: Establishes the Sex Offender Surcharge Fund (Fund) consisting of monies collected from additional assessments on sexual offenses. Modifies the composition of the Sex Offender Management Board (Board).
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: traditional healing services; AHCCCS
rollCalls.summary: Includes traditional healing services in the list of services covered by the Arizona Health Care Cost Containment System (AHCCCS) and services provided by the Arizona Long Term Care System (ALTCS), subject to approval by the Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services (CMS) and available funding. Appropriates $1,300,000 from the state General Fund (GF) and $_____ from Medicaid Expenditure Authority in FY 2026 to AHCCCS to provide traditional healing services.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: veterans' benefits; claims; prohibition.
rollCalls.summary: Establishes requirements and procedures that a person assisting with veterans' benefits must fulfill prior to receiving compensation for such services.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: public high schools; AEDs; requirements
rollCalls.summary: An emergency measure that requires, beginning August 1, 2025, each public school that provides instruction to students in grades 9 through 12 and sponsors an athletic team or sports program to purchase, provide, maintain and keep an automated external defibrillator (AED). Appropriates $500,000 from the state General Fund (state GF) in FY 2026 to the Arizona Department of Education (ADE) for the implementation of requirements relating to the provision of AEDs in schools.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: veterans; mental health; grant program
rollCalls.summary: Establishes the Mental Health Services for Veterans Grant Program (Program), prescribes related requirements and appropriates $2,000,000 in FYs 2026 and 2027 to the Arizona Department of Veterans' Services (ADVS) for the Program.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: marijuana; dual licensees; rural communities
rollCalls.summary: Requires the Department of Health Services (DHS) to adopt rules establishing a rural opportunity initiative and to issue marijuana establishment licenses to each entity that is qualified pursuant to the rural opportunity initiative and nonprofit medical marijuana dispensary registration certificates to each entity that is issued a marijuana establishment license. Contains requirements for enactment for initiatives and referendums (Proposition 105).
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: oil and gas commission; helium
rollCalls.summary: Removes the Oil and Gas Conservation Commission (Commission) from the purview of the Arizona Department of Environmental Quality (ADEQ). Establishes the Commission Fund (Fund) consisting of legislative appropriations and outlined fees and redirects all Commission fees to the Fund, rather than the state General Fund (state GF).
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: compensation; elective state officers; inflation
rollCalls.summary: Subject to voter approval, constitutionally adjusts each State Legislator's most recently approved salary for inflation from the calendar year that the salary was approved and on January 1 of each year.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: high school graduation; requirements
rollCalls.summary: Requires the Arizona Department of Education (ADE) to establish a method and standard for determining a minimum performance level on the statewide assessment and the State Board of Education (SBE) to include the minimum performance level on the statewide assessment as a competency requirement for high school graduation. Outlines exemptions from the minimum performance level requirement.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: ASRS; return to work; prosecutors
rollCalls.summary: Allows a retired Arizona State Retirement System (ASRS) member, after six months of retirement, to return to work as a state, county, city or town prosecutor and still be eligible for retirement benefits.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: aggravated assault; commission; certain officials
rollCalls.summary: Adds elected officials and animal control officers as protected persons in the aggravated assault criminal classification.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: wildlife; firearms discharge; structures; distance
rollCalls.summary: Allows the discharge of a shotgun or archery equipment, within one-quarter mile but outside of one-eighth mile of a building, while taking wildlife.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: community college districts; tax rate
rollCalls.summary: Appropriates $2,000,000 from the state General Fund (state GF) in FY 2026 to the Auditor General (OAG) for software to be used to conduct audits of state agencies and school districts.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: adult education programs; revisions; appropriation
rollCalls.summary: An emergency measure that removes the June 30, 2025, repeal date and modifies enrollment, reporting and funding requirements for the Continuing High School and Workforce Training Program (Continuing High School Program), the Adult Workforce Diploma Program (Adult Diploma Program) and the Community College Adult Education Workforce Development Program (Community College Program). Appropriates a total of $18,000,000 from the state General Fund (state GF) in FY 2026 to the Arizona Department of Education (ADE), the Adult Diploma Program Fund and the Community College Program Fund.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: barbering and cosmetology fund; enforcement
rollCalls.summary: Allows a political subdivision entity to procure insurance from any insurer authorized by the Director of the Department of Insurance and Financial Institutions (DIFI) or establish a self-insurance program. Adds a political subdivision entity to the definition of public agency for the purposes of intergovernmental operations.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: equine economic improvement fund
rollCalls.summary: Establishes the Equine Economic Improvement Fund (Fund) consisting of monies deposited from the Fantasy Sports Contest Fund, the Event Wagering Fund or from any other source.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: AHCCCS; comprehensive dental care
rollCalls.summary: Expands Arizona Health Care Cost Containment System (AHCCCS) coverage of dental services, from only emergency dental care and extractions, to include coverage of comprehensive dental care for members who are at least 21 years old.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: appropriations; public safety equipment
rollCalls.summary: Appropriates a total of $1,228,000 from the Peace Officer Training Equipment Fund (Fund) in FY 2026 to the Flagstaff and Glendale Police Departments (PDs) for specified weapons and public safety training simulators.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: appropriation; on-farm irrigation efficiency fund
rollCalls.summary: Adopts the Dentist and Dental Hygienist Compact (Compact), permitting dentists and dental hygienists licensed in a participating state to obtain licensure in any other Compact state.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: small school adjustments; district eligibility
rollCalls.summary: Authorizes a common school district to receive a small school adjustment in FY 2026 if the school district meets outlined eligibility requirements. Repeals the small school adjustment eligibility modifications for FY 2026 on January 1, 2027.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: cities and towns; primary elections
rollCalls.summary: Specifies that a resolution of any election contest must occur before declaring, as elected, a candidate for a new term in the office of mayor or city council who received a majority of all votes cast at the primary election , if the office is currently being served by appointment .
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: water technology study committee
rollCalls.summary: Establishes the Water Technology Study Committee (Study Committee).
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: mental health; autism; insurance coverage
rollCalls.summary: Removes the maximum insurance benefit cap on behavioral therapy for eligible persons who are 16 years old or younger and updates the definition of autism spectrum disorder.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: county detention facilities; arrestees; information
rollCalls.summary: Requires county detention facilities to provide personal identifying information and access to a person arrested for an outlined offense on the request of U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement (U.S. ICE), except as specified.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: appropriations; graduate medical education program
rollCalls.summary: Appropriates $10,000,000 from the state General Fund (state GF) and $18,768,700 in expenditure authority in FY 2026 to the Arizona Health Care Cost Containment System (AHCCCS) for the direct and indirect costs of graduate medical education (GME) and to fund the development of a new residency program.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: continuation; state fair board
rollCalls.summary: Continues the Arizona Exposition and State Fair Board (Board) for eight years.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: citrus; fruit; vegetable; fund; posting
rollCalls.summary: Requires the Arizona Department of Agriculture (AZDA) to post the report detailing all monies paid into and disbursed from the Citrus, Fruit and Vegetable Trust Fund (Fund) on the AZDA's website.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: appropriation; civil air patrol
