rollCalls.summary: Appropriates $250,000 from the state General Fund (state GF) in FY 2026 to the Department of Public Safety (DPS) for the maintenance and operation of the Civil Air Patrol (CAP).
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: legislature; time of assembly
rollCalls.summary: Requires a city, town and county to satisfy any statutory requirement for advertising, publishing or printing by placing the public notice on the public body's official website.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: public entity liability; sexual offenses
rollCalls.summary: Until January 1, 2028, subjects a public entity to liability for losses that arise out of an act or omission by a public employee that is determined to be a felony sexual offense if the victim is a minor or a child with a disability and one or more outlined conditions apply.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: appropriations; law enforcement; records management
rollCalls.summary: Appropriates a total of $4,582,575 from the state General Fund (state GF) in FY 2026 to the Arizona Department of Administration (ADOA) to distribute to 37 law enforcement entities to expand participation in the Law Enforcement Data Sharing Pilot Program (Pilot Program).
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: behavioral health facilities; accreditation
rollCalls.summary: Establishes patient intake form requirements for behavioral health outpatient treatment centers that are service providers for the Arizona Health Care Cost Containment System (AHCCCS) or a regional behavioral health authority. Requires the Department of Health Services (DHS) to provide a priority matrix for complaints filed against health care institutions on its public website and to implement an annual training program for licensing surveyors, supervisors and managers.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: government anti-identification procedures; technical correction
rollCalls.summary: Allows a storer in the Phoenix Active Management Area (AMA) to recharge stormwater within a constructed underground storage facility pursuant to outlined requirements and permits and receive a replenishment credit. Allows a storer to use replenishment credits or transfer the replenishment credits to any other eligible entity and offset an equal amount of the storer's replenishment obligation within the same subbasin for any year.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: technical correction; military; special plates
rollCalls.summary: Establishes the Sheriff's Criminal Justice Commission (SCJC) and repeals the Arizona Criminal Justice Commission (ACJC).
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: driver licenses; reciprocity; foreign military
rollCalls.summary: Allows the Arizona Department of Transportation (ADOT) to waive the examination for and issue a driver license to an active duty member of the armed forces of specified foreign countries under outlined conditions.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: income tax; subtraction; retirement distribution
rollCalls.summary: Establishes an individual income tax subtraction for distributions from a retirement account by persons who are at least 67 years old and caps the total subtraction at the amount of the standard deduction.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: false claims; agriculture; technical correction
rollCalls.summary: Allows a municipal provider that applies for a new designation of assured water supply in the Pinal Active Management Area (AMA) that relies on a member service area agreement to elect for all parcels of member land in the municipal service area to retain a replenishment obligation.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: community colleges; baccalaureate degrees; reports
rollCalls.summary: Requires each community college district (CCD) that offers baccalaureate degree programs to include the projected enrollment for each baccalaureate degree program in the CCD's annual report. Requires the total number of students pursuing a baccalaureate degree and the total number of completed baccalaureate degrees to be disaggregated by baccalaureate degree program in a CCD's annual report.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: corporation commission; non-thermal generating unit
rollCalls.summary: Modifies the definition of plant to include a non-thermal electric generating unit and increases the nameplate rating threshold from 100 megawatts or more to 200 megawatts or more.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: naturopathic physicians; board; investigations; scope
rollCalls.summary: Outlines various actions that constitute unprofessional conduct for the purpose of disciplining a doctor of chiropractic (DC). Outlines causes for termination of the Executive Director of the Arizona Board of Chiropractic Examiners (Chiropractic Board). Modifies the powers and duties of the Chiropractic Board and the Naturopathic Physicians Medical Board (Naturopathic Board).
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: licensed secure facility; incompetent defendants
rollCalls.summary: Prohibits patients found dangerous and incompetent to stand trial and who are court ordered to involuntary treatment from being treated at a secure behavioral health residential facility (SBHRF) that treats patients who are civilly committed to treatment at the SBHRF.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: legislative appointments; qualifications
rollCalls.summary: Removes membership requirements for certain members of outlined public bodies who are appointed by the Speaker of the House of Representatives (House) and the President of the Senate.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: massage therapy; continuation; study committee
rollCalls.summary: Continues the Board of Massage Therapy (Board) for two years. Establishes the Board of Massage Therapy Continuation Study Committee (Committee) to review the Board and create a report detailing recommendations for the Board.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: municipalities; emergency measures; vote
rollCalls.summary: Subjects an emergency measure adopted by a city or town council to a referendum in the same manner as provided for nonemergency ordinances, resolutions and other measures.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: broadband service district authority; formation
rollCalls.summary: Allows a group of individuals, businesses or organizations in a county with a population between 200,000 and 210,000 to form a broadband service district authority (authority) and prescribes the powers and duties of an authority.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: students; interscholastic activities; eligibility; costs
rollCalls.summary: Requires a public school to allow eligible private school students to try out for interscholastic activities on behalf of the public school. Prohibits a public school from charging a private school student an interscholastic activity participation fee that exceeds the student's pro rata share of program costs.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: firearms; state preemption; civil penalty
rollCalls.summary: Allows a court to assess a $5,000 civil penalty against a government official or agency head who knowingly and willfully violates state firearm preemption laws and prevents public monies from being used to defend or reimburse this unlawful conduct.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: unlawful occupants; property; removal; documents
rollCalls.summary: Allows an owner of residential real property, or the owner's authorized agent, to request the appropriate law enforcement agency to expeditiously remove an unlawful occupant from the residential dwelling when prescribed conditions are met. Outlines procedures related to a request to remove an unlawful occupant and penalties for unlawful occupancy depending on the amount of damage caused to the residential dwelling.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: underground storage tanks; reimbursement
rollCalls.summary: Requires applicants for reimbursement from the Underground Storage Tank Revolving Fund (Fund) to apply to the Arizona Department of Environmental Quality (ADEQ) within one year after the completion of work. Requires ADEQ, by September 1, 2025, and by September 1 every year thereafter, to compile a report on the Fund preapproval process.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: state trust land; land exchanges
rollCalls.summary: Subject to voter approval, constitutionally requires the transfer of state land for other lands, rather than only public lands, to be approved by the Legislature and the Governor, rather than by the qualified electors of Arizona by referendum.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: federal lands; supporting disposal
rollCalls.summary: Expresses the Legislature's support for the disposal of federally held unappropriated lands by the Bureau of Land Management (BLM) and opposition of the federal 30x30 Initiative.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: elections; foreign contributions; certification; donations
rollCalls.summary: Subject to voter approval, statutorily prohibits the use of monies or in-kind goods or services donated by a foreign source for election administration purposes and prohibits a person, entity or committee from accepting or using contributions, expenditures or in-kind goods or services contributed by a foreign national to influence the outcome of a ballot measure.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: general elections; required tally
rollCalls.summary: Subject to voter approval, requires the Legislature to enact laws and procedures to ensure that 95 percent of the votes cast in every general election are tallied within one day after election day.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: appropriations; criminal justice; salary increases
rollCalls.summary: Appropriates a total of $128,563,150 from the state General Fund (state GF) in FY 2026 to the Arizona Department of Corrections, Rehabilitation and Reentry (ADCRR), the Arizona Department of Juvenile Corrections (ADJC), the Department of Public Safety (DPS) and the Administrative Offices of the Courts (AOC) for employee salary increases.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: audiologists; speech-language pathologists; compact
rollCalls.summary: Adopts the Audiologists and Speech-Language Pathologists Compact (Compact), permitting audiologists and speech-language pathologists to obtain licensure in other Compact states . Establishes the Audiology and Speech-Language Pathology Compact Commission (Commission).
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: ADWR; hydrology reports
rollCalls.summary: Requires a city or town, county, state agency and the state (public entity) or an independent contractor of a public entity to comply with all federal laws, rules, regulations or orders that relate to immigration and deportation and cooperate with outlined federal immigration authorities. Outlines penalties for a public entity or independent contractor that violates prescribed federal immigration and deportation compliance requirements.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: elections; voting centers; polling places
rollCalls.summary: Requires voting centers to be established in addition to, rather than in place of, specifically designated polling places. Requires a state, county, city, town or school district office and schools within a school district (district schools) with a gymnasium to provide sufficient space for use as a polling place and requires district schools to close on an election day.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: early ballot drop off; identification
rollCalls.summary: Outlines identification and attestation requirements for voters and voters' agents who drop off one or more voted early ballots at a polling location, voting center or emergency voting center and classifies a knowing violation of the outlined attestation and identification requirements as a class 5 felony.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: equine economic improvement fund
rollCalls.summary: Establishes the Equine Economic Improvement Fund (Fund) consisting of monies deposited from the Fantasy Sports Contest Fund, the Event Wagering Fund or from any other source.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: air quality; causation; state boundaries
rollCalls.summary: Allows the Attorney General (AG) to file suit on behalf of Arizona against the U.S. Environmental Protection Agency (EPA) if the EPA does not approve a demonstration that establishes that any area of Arizona would achieve and maintain the applicable national ambient air quality standard but for emissions emanating outside of the United States.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: firearms transactions; merchant codes; prohibition
rollCalls.summary: Establishes the Second Amendment Financial Privacy Act (Act) which preempts a government entity from keeping a record of privately owned firearms or firearm, prohibits a merchant category code from distinguishing firearm retailers from other retailers and requires the Attorney General (AG) or county attorney to enforce the Act, as prescribed.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: community facilities districts; prompt pay
rollCalls.summary: Prescribes requirements and prohibitions for construction contract payments for infrastructure projects in revitalization special taxing districts.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: state land; exchanges
rollCalls.summary: Outlines requirements relating to the establishment, decommissioning, location, permitting, operation and conveyance of wind farms. Outlines requirements relating to financial sureties and public hearings and notice for wind farms.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: planning; home design; restrictions; prohibition.
rollCalls.summary: Prescribes certain restrictions on municipalities relating to home design and minimum development standards for single-family homes.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: marijuana; clinical research trials
rollCalls.summary: Requires, rather than allows, monies in the Medical Marijuana Fund (Fund) to be used to provide grants for marijuana clinical trials. Directs the Arizona Biomedical Research Center (ABRC) to provide $2,000,000 by July 1, 2026, and an additional $2,000,000 by July 1, 2028, to administer and award competitive grants. Contains requirements for enactment for initiatives and referendums (Proposition 105).
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: health profession regulatory boards; membership
rollCalls.summary: Restructures the statutory membership of certain health profession regulatory boards (health board). Establishes the Health Board Oversight Council (Council) and outlines its powers and duties.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: cast vote record; public record
rollCalls.summary: Requires the county board of supervisors (BOS) or officer in charge of elections to transmit the cast vote record to the Secretary of State (SOS) within 48 hours after the county BOS transmits the county canvass. Prohibits the county BOS or officer in charge of elections from randomizing or altering the cast vote record.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: health insurers; provider; payment; claims
rollCalls.summary: Effective April 1, 2026, modifies deadlines of the health insurance provider credentialing process and prescribes requirements for processing of claims.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: child fatality; maternal mortality
rollCalls.summary: Establishes the Maternal Mortality Review Program (MMR Program), consisting of members and staff of the Maternal Mortality Review Committee (Committee), to evaluate the incidence, causes and preventability of pregnancy associated deaths. Outlines Committee membership and duties of the MMR Program.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: newborn screening program
rollCalls.summary: Adds an exemption to the requirement that new congenital disorders be added to the Arizona newborn screening panel within two years of being added to the federal Recommended Uniform Screening Panel (RUSP) if laboratory testing is required but there is not yet a commercially available test approved or authorized by the U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA).
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: ambulances; response times; rates
rollCalls.summary: Modifies requirements of the Department of Health Services' (DHS') rules relating to certificates of necessity (CON) and ambulance service response times, operations and rate schedules.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: voter registration rolls; internet access
rollCalls.summary: Requires the county recorder SOS and other officers in charge of elections to provide electronic access to voter registration information and additional copies of an official precinct list to a person who requests the information for noncommercial purposes as outlined. Requires the data from a county voting location ballot report to be made available as a public record by the last posting of election results for that election night and allows an expanded postelection early ballot hand count to be performed at the discretion of the county board of supervisors (BOS).
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: election officials; oversight; candidates
rollCalls.summary: Prohibits a public officer or employee whose duties include election administration or operations from engaging in those election duties if the officer or employee is a candidate on the ballot for that election.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: common expense liens; foreclosure; amount
rollCalls.summary: Increases the amount over which an owner in a planned community association (HOA) must be delinquent to $10,000 and the period of delinquency to 18 months for an HOA to foreclose a common expense lien.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: national guard; active duty; requirements
rollCalls.summary: Prohibits the National Guard of Arizona from being released from Arizona into active duty combat without an official action by or declaration of war from the U.S. Congress.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: literacy endorsement; curricula; special education
rollCalls.summary: Directs the State Board of Education (SBE) to require all approved educator preparation programs in mild-moderate special education to require the necessary courses to obtain the literacy endorsement. Specifies that curriculum , for the purposes of a K-3 literacy plan, includes any curriculum that is used to provide reading instruction to children with disabilities or English language learners.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: certified teachers; braille literacy; requirements
rollCalls.summary: Modifies the methods for a teacher to demonstrate braille competency for certification in educating blind pupils and visually impaired pupils.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: technical correction; additional judges
rollCalls.summary: Directs a school district governing board (governing board) to adopt definitions for bullying, cyberbullying, harassment and intimidation as prescribed for the governing board's policy and procedures to prohibit harassing, intimidating and bullying.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: water use; prohibition; landscaping
rollCalls.summary: Prohibits a municipality that is located in an initial active management area (AMA) from adopting or enforcing any requirement that establishes, directly or indirectly, outlined turf and plant installation requirements.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: ballot measures; description; legislative council
rollCalls.summary: Requires either the Legislative Council or a local official as specified, rather than the Secretary of State (SOS) and the Attorney General (AG), to prepare descriptive titles for proposed measures and constitutional amendments.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: homeowner's associations; address lights
rollCalls.summary: Prohibits a condominium unit owners' association (COA) or planned community association (HOA) from prohibiting a lighted home address device as outlined.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: early voting list; ten years
rollCalls.summary: Requires a voter to be removed from the Active Early Voting List (AEVL) after 10 years if the voter does not notify the county recorder as prescribed.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: adult hemp beverages; policies; procedures
rollCalls.summary: Establishes requirements for the manufacture, distribution and sale of adult hemp beverages, including licensure with the Arizona Department of Liquor Licenses and Control (DLLC). Modifies the statutes governing spirituous liquor products by incorporating adult hemp beverage products.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: supplemental appropriation; Prescott rodeo grounds
rollCalls.summary: Redirects the FY 2024 $15,300,000 appropriation to the City of Prescott to renovate and repair the rodeo ground owned by the city, rather than to a nonprofit volunteer organization that operates a rodeo at the Yavapai County Fairgrounds.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: gender transition procedures; provider liability
rollCalls.summary: Imposes civil liability on health care professionals or physicians relating to gender transition or detransition procedures provided to minors.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: concealed weapons permits; fees
rollCalls.summary: Sets the fee that the Department of Public Safety (DPS) may charge Arizona residents for a concealed carry weapon (CCW) application at 10 percent of the fee that is charged for nonresidents.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: municipal; county; measures; standing
rollCalls.summary: Grants a resident that conducts business in Arizona standing to institute a civil proceeding to challenge any emergency measure that is adopted by the governing body of a municipality or county.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: photo enforcement systems; prohibition
rollCalls.summary: Subject to voter approval, statutorily prohibits a local authority or state agency from using a photo enforcement system to identify violators of speed restrictions or traffic control devices.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: sober living homes
rollCalls.summary: Modifies requirements of the Department of Health Services (DHS) relating to the licensing, oversight and regulation of sober living homes. Prescribes guidelines for the inspection and penalizing of sober living homes that are noncompliant with applicable state and local regulations.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: election officer certification training; yearly
rollCalls.summary: Specifies that an election officer's certificate, which must be issued by the Secretary of State before June 1 or January 1 as prescribed, expires on or by December 31 in the year after the general election.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: gift cards; theft; forgery
rollCalls.summary: Establishes the criminal classification of gift card theft and classifies gift card theft as a class 4 felony.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: special census; state population; appropriation
rollCalls.summary: Allows the state to conduct, during the fifth year after the U.S. Decennial Census, a special census of the state's population and requires the statewide special census to be used when apportioning certain state shared revenues. Appropriates $10,000,000 from the state General Fund (state GF) in FY 2026 to the Office of Economic Opportunity to conduct the statewide special census.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: authorized recipients; donated medicine; information
rollCalls.summary: Allows authorized recipients of donated medicine, the Arizona Department of Health Services (DHS), the Arizona Health Care Cost Containment System (AHCCCS) and health profession regulatory boards to post on their public website where and how to donate medicine, who is eligible and where to receive donated medicine.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: international medical graduates; requirements
rollCalls.summary: Modifies the additional medical licensure requirements for students graduating from an unapproved allopathic school of medicine.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: mental health transition program; extension
rollCalls.summary: Extends the Mental Health Transition Program (Program) for three years.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: schools; administrative employees; instruction requirement
rollCalls.summary: Requires Arizona schools to require each full-time administrative employee of the school to provide classroom instruction at least once per school year as a substitute teacher. Outlines exemptions from the requirement to substitute teach at least once per school year.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: prohibition; geoengineering
rollCalls.summary: Prohibits a person from intentionally injecting, releasing or dispensing by any means any chemical, chemical compound, substance or apparatus within the borders of Arizona with the express purpose of solar radiation management.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: empowerment scholarship accounts; debit cards
rollCalls.summary: Allows a person who receives a subject matter expert standard teaching certificate (subject matter expert certificate) to provide instruction to students in kindergarten programs and grades 1 through 12, rather than grades 6 through 12. Expands eligibility to receive a subject matter expert certificate by including persons who meet outlined requirements and applies the literacy endorsement requirement to a person who receives a subject matter expert certificate and provides literacy instruction in kindergarten programs or grades one through five.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: K-12; school funding; revisions
rollCalls.summary: An emergency measure that establishes a state student funding formula (SSF formula) which must be used to calculate charter school equalization assistance. Outlines procedures for an eligible school district to elect to use the SSF formula and prescribes the calculation of tax rates for a school district that uses the SSF formula.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: ASRS retirement; legislators; other employment
rollCalls.summary: Allows an Arizona State Retirement System (ASRS) member who is a state elected official and who attains a normal retirement date through employment other than as a state elected official to retire at any time without resigning the member's elected position.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: subsequent AMAs; groundwater portability
rollCalls.summary: Allows an owner of an irrigation grandfathered right (IGFR), in a subsequent active management area (AMA), to use, sell, transfer or lease the IGFR and the water duty that was associated with those acres. Allows a person that receives a sold, leased or transferred associated water duty to use the associated water duty anywhere in the subsequent AMA for irrigation use and to further convey the associated water duty.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: groundwater storage facility; withdrawals; area
rollCalls.summary: Requires the Director of Arizona Department of Water Resources (ADWR), for the purposes of the recovery of stored water within an active management area (AMA) and if a recovery well permit applicant does not submit a separate hydrologic study to the Director, to assume that the recovery well is located within the area of impact of stored water if the recovery well location is either in land permitted to operate as a groundwater savings facility or within one mile of outlined locations.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: workers' compensation; disability; definitions
rollCalls.summary: Modifies the requirements for the Industrial Commission of Arizona (ICA) to set a physician's schedule of fees for employee injuries under workers' compensation. Increases the monthly dependent allowance provided to an employee in addition to compensation for a temporary total disability.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: psilocybin services; regulation; licensure
rollCalls.summary: Declares any pharmaceutical composition of crystalline polymorph psilocybin approved by the U.S. Food and Drug Administration (U.S. FDA) and rescheduled by the U.S. Drug Enforcement Administration (U.S. DEA) to a schedule other than Schedule I of the federal Controlled Substances Act (CSA) as a controlled substance that may be prescribed in Arizona.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: referendums; strict compliance
rollCalls.summary: Allows the Secretary of State (SOS) to enforce compliance with the constitutional and statutory requirements for referendum. Outlines requirements related to initiative and referendum applications and the rejection of an initiative or referendum application.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: public employees; merit; hiring practices
rollCalls.summary: Prohibits the State of Arizona or a political subdivision of Arizona from establishing any policies or practices requiring employees to be hired based on anything other than the merit of the employee .
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: sexual abuse; dangerous crimes; children
rollCalls.summary: Modifies the definition of a dangerous crime against children (DCAC).
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: agencies; interpretations; directives; rules
rollCalls.summary: Directs each agency in Arizona to submit guidance, interpretations and directives from any federal agency regarding guidance for implementation of federal agency rules to the Legislature.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: higher education; withholding state monies
rollCalls.summary: Deems an Arizona higher education institution ineligible from receiving state monies and prohibits the State Treasurer, the Arizona Board of Regents (ABOR) and the Arizona Department of Administration (ADOA) from distributing state monies to a higher education institution in a fiscal year that the higher education institution offers one or more courses on diversity equity and inclusion (DEI).
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: technical correction; air pollution; permits
rollCalls.summary: Establishes the Air Quality Permitting Coordination Committee (Committee). Requires the Committee to meet quarterly to review the air quality permits and practices issued by each entity, ensure air quality permit consistency across each jurisdiction and share best practices on air quality issues. Requires the Arizona Department of Environmental Quality (ADEQ) and each county that issues air quality permits, by January 1, 2026, to review air quality permits issued by ADEQ or a county in Arizona.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: unlawful feeding of wildlife; exception
rollCalls.summary: Adds placing holiday-related decorations outside of a residence or property to the exceptions for unlawful feeding of wildlife .
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: technical correction; obstructing governmental operations
rollCalls.summary: Prohibits the Arizona Department of Agriculture (AZDA) from adopting rules that require or prescribe minimum housing size standards for egg-laying hens.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: legislative districts; population; census; citizenship
rollCalls.summary: Subject to voter approval, constitutionally requires the independent redistricting commission (IRC) to conduct a census in each year that ends in zero and create legislative districts of equal citizen population during the commencement of the mapping process. Establishes the State Census Fund and transfers monies from the Citizens Clean Elections Fund (CCEF) to the State Census Fund each fiscal year to conduct the census.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: mine inspector; four-year term
rollCalls.summary: Subject to voter approval, constitutionally resolves conflicting constitutional sections by repealing Ariz. Const. art. 19 § 0 vers. 1 as passed by Proposition 107 in 1992. Sets the term limit for the State Mine Inspector at two consecutive terms.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: permanent school fund; distribution; uses
rollCalls.summary: Subject to voter approval, statutorily requires, beginning in FY 2027, the State Treasurer and the Arizona State Land Department (ASLD) to annually transfer Permanent State School Fund (Permanent School Fund) monies to provide guaranteed financing for common schools to acquire, construct, refinance or improve capital facilities before transferring Permanent School Fund monies for any other authorized purpose.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: fair jury improvement fund
rollCalls.summary: Renames the Arizona Trial and Digital Evidence Fund (Fund) the Fair Jury Improvement Fund . Terminates the Fund and the additional fee that supplies the fund on July 1, 2031, and January 1, 2031, respectively.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: cruelty to working animals; classification
rollCalls.summary: Allows the county medical examiner or alternate medical examiner to retain the body of an indigent deceased person and supervise the cremation at a licensed crematory that is owned and operated by the county. Modifies fingerprint submission requirements for licensure of funeral industry professionals and training requirements for a licensed physician supervising pathology training.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: assisted living; hyperbaric oxygen therapy
rollCalls.summary: Allows assisted living homes and assisted living centers (assisted living facilities) to offer mild hyperbaric oxygen therapy (HBOT) to residents and outlines requirements and restrictions on HBOT use.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: juror summons; election worker option
rollCalls.summary: Allows the jury commissioner to give a qualified juror the option to serve as a temporary election worker in the appropriate county in place of fulfilling a jury service obligation.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: appropriation; university of Arizona; agriculture
rollCalls.summary: Appropriates $3.5 million in FY 2026 from the state General Fund (state GF) to the University of Arizona for the Yuma Center of Excellence for Desert Agriculture (YCEDA).
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: central bank digital currency; ban
rollCalls.summary: Prohibits federally recognized central bank digital currency (CBDC) from being the subject or medium of payment of any contract, security or other similar instrument in Arizona and excludes CBDC from the definition of legal tender for the purposes of all Arizona Revised Statutes, including the Uniform Commercial Code.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: bullion depository; establishment
rollCalls.summary: Establishes the Arizona Bullion Depository (Depository), administered by the Department of Insurance and Financial Institutions (DIFI), and outlines duties, procedures and requirements.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: apprenticeship; supervised probation
rollCalls.summary: Allows certain probationers who participate in a recognized apprenticeship program to work during any hours of the day and to travel to work in the apprenticeship program outside of the probationer's jurisdiction when specified conditions are met.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: assured water supply; analysis; availability
rollCalls.summary: An emergency measure that allows an applicant for a Certificate of Assured Water Supply (Certificate) that holds an analysis to submit a sworn statement to the Arizona Department of Water Resources (ADWR) in which the applicant agrees to reduce the remaining volume of groundwater reserved by the analysis by 15 percent after the Director of ADWR grants a Certificate and requires the Director of ADWR, after receipt of a sworn statement, to grant the applicant a Certificate.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: watermark; paper ballots
rollCalls.summary: Requires fraud countermeasures for ballots to include at least 3 of the 10 outlined features.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: history of communism; instruction requirement
rollCalls.summary: Expands the high school social studies academic standards requirements relating to comparative politics by including instruction on specified topics regarding communism.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: early voting; mailing date
rollCalls.summary: Modifies statutory timeframes related to the distribution of early ballots and the mailing of official ballots for mail ballot elections in special taxing districts.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: pharmacists; independent testing; treatment
rollCalls.summary: Allows a pharmacist to independently test for and treat eligible persons for outlined medical conditions.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: ADOA; Marana prison; lease
rollCalls.summary: Requires the Arizona Department of Administration (ADOA) to lease the Marana Prison Site to the U.S. Government or a private contractor of the U.S. Government for $1 per year to house individuals held for immigration violations and outlines requirements for the agreement.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: unemployment benefits; requirements; disqualifications; determinations
rollCalls.summary: Modifies the factors that an unemployed individual must meet to be eligible for Unemployment Insurance (UI) benefits. Requires the Department of Economic Security (DES) to cross-check the validity of UI benefit claims against prescribed data sets.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: appropriation; fire incident management grants
rollCalls.summary: Appropriates $6.5 million in FY 2026 from the state General Fund (state GF) to the Arizona Department of Administration (ADOA) for a fire incident management grant program.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: law enforcement personnel; grant program
rollCalls.summary: Establishes the Law Enforcement Personnel Grant Program (Grant Program) to reimburse law enforcement agencies (LEAs) for federal immigration training costs and appropriates $2,000,000 from the state General Fund (state GF) in FY 2026 to the Department of Public Safety (DPS) for the Grant Program.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: Asian American history; instruction requirements
rollCalls.summary: Requires the State Board of Education (SBE) to require instruction on the history of Asian Americans, Native Hawaiians and Pacific Islanders in common schools and high schools beginning in the 2028-2029 school year.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: appropriation; state department of corrections
rollCalls.summary: Appropriates $103.3 million from the state General Fund (state GF) in FY 2026 to the Arizona Department of Corrections, Rehabilitation and Reentry (ADCRR) for salary increases of 20 percent for correctional officers and 10 percent for all other employees.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: prohibited weapons; muffling device; repeal
rollCalls.summary: Removes a device that is designed, made or adapted to muffle the report of a firearm from the definition of prohibited weapon .
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: disruption; educational institution; concealed weapon
rollCalls.summary: Prohibits the governing board of any university, college or community college from prohibiting the possession of a concealed weapon by a concealed weapon permit holder, or the lawful transportation or storage of a firearm.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: state agencies; payments; cryptocurrency
rollCalls.summary: Effective January 1, 2026, authorizes a state agency to enter into an agreement with a cryptocurrency service provider to accept cryptocurrency as a payment method for any amount due to the state agency or the state. Allows tax payments to be made in cryptocurrency if the Arizona Department of Revenue (ADOR) enters into an agreement with a cryptocurrency service provider to accept cryptocurrency as a payment method.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: public monies; investment; virtual currency
rollCalls.summary: Allows the State Treasurer, the Arizona State Retirement System and the Public Safety Personnel Retirement System (public funds) to invest up to 10 percent of the public monies under its control in virtual currency holdings.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: virtual currency; property tax exemption
rollCalls.summary: Conditional on the voter approval of S.C.R. 1001, exempts virtual currency from property tax.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: postconviction relief proceedings; hourly rate
rollCalls.summary: Allows court appointed counsel of a capital defendant for state postconviction relief proceedings to receive compensation exceeding $100 per hour if the higher compensation rate has been approved by the county board of supervisors (BOS) and does not exceed $200 per hour.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: homeowner's associations; meetings; recordings
rollCalls.summary: Requires the board of directors of a condominium unit owners' association (COA) or planned community association (HOA) to keep a copy of a recorded meeting for at least six months.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: working animal; harm; classification
rollCalls.summary: Adds to the types of identification that may be used in scrap metal transactions.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: internal investigations; notice; confidentiality
rollCalls.summary: Requires an employer to provide relevant materials to a law enforcement officer at least 24-hours before an interview for an administrative investigation, except as specified.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: SNAP; TANF; public welfare; verification
rollCalls.summary: Establishes evaluation requirements for the Department of Economic Security (DES) to confirm eligibility for Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program (SNAP) benefits.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: penalty assessment; victims' rights enforcement
rollCalls.summary: Increases, from $2 to $4, the penalty assessment that is levied on fines, penalties and forfeitures that are deposited into the Victims' Rights Enforcement Fund (Fund).
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: property tax exemptions; inflation adjustment
rollCalls.summary: Modifies the method used to annually increase the property assessment limit under which a person qualifies for certain statutory property tax exemptions.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: psychologists; prescribing authority
rollCalls.summary: Beginning January 1, 2027, allows a licensed psychologist to apply for a prescription license to enter into a collaborative prescription agreement with a licensed physician to prescribe psychotropic medication to treat mental health and substance use disorders.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: vehicle accident; insurance verification
rollCalls.summary: Beginning January 1, 2027, authorizes a candidate committee for a city or town candidate to transfer contributions to that same candidate's statewide or legislative candidate committee, provided that the aggregate amount of contributions from an individual do not exceed statutory limits for statewide or legislative office.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: appropriation; older individuals; blind
rollCalls.summary: Appropriates $1 million in FY 2026 from the state General Fund (state GF) to the Department of Economic Security (DES) for the Older Individuals Who Are Blind Program.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: AHCCCS; continuous glucose monitors
rollCalls.summary: Requires contractors with the Arizona Health Care Cost Containment System (AHCCCS) to provide AHCCCS members with continuous glucose monitors and outlines requirements related to coverage criteria for continuous glucose monitors.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: jail facilities excise tax; extension
rollCalls.summary: Authorizes a county that levies a jail facilities excise tax by resolution adopted before the expiration of the tax (Maricopa County) to extend the tax for up to 20 years, if approved by qualified voters before January 1, 2028.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: kidney disease awareness special plates
rollCalls.summary: Establishes a kidney disease awareness special plate and the Kidney Disease Awareness Special Plate Fund (Fund).
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: write-in candidates; nomination paper filing
rollCalls.summary: Requires a write-in candidate to file a nomination paper no later than 5:00 p.m. on the 60th, rather than 40th, day before an election.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: income tax; subtraction; uniformed services
rollCalls.summary: Effective January 1, 2026, expands the individual income tax subtraction for active service compensation to include compensation received for active service in the U.S. Uniformed Services, rather than the U.S. Armed Forces.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: employment practices; wage claims
rollCalls.summary: Increases, from $5,000 to $12,000, the cap under which an employee may file an unpaid wages claim against an employer with the Labor Department of the Industrial Commission of Arizona (Labor Department).
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: sheriffs; constables; service; mileage; fees
rollCalls.summary: Increases the cap, from $5 to $10, for a fee for a writ issued on behalf of a justice of the peace and modifies the calculation of a constable's mileage to begin at the office of the precinct the constable serves, rather than the office originating the civil action. Contains requirements for enactment and becomes effective on signature of the Governor (Proposition 108).
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: appropriation; highway project; Patagonia; use
rollCalls.summary: Allows the Town of Patagonia to use the FY 2024 appropriation of $1,500,000 to reconstruct McKeown Avenue between Third Avenue West and State Route (SR) 82.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: veterans; emergency admission; transport
rollCalls.summary: An emergency measure that grants a peace or police officer who is an employee of the U.S. Department of Veterans Affairs (U.S. VA), the authority to apprehend and transport veterans to a screening or evaluation agency and apply for emergency admission evaluations.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: immigration laws; local enforcement
rollCalls.summary: Establishes the Arizona Immigration, Cooperation and Enforcement Act (Arizona ICE Act) and prescribes requirements for state and local cooperation with federal immigration authorities and the enforcement of federal immigration laws that include facilitating immigration detainer requests, providing temporary housing for detainees and procedures for noncompliance.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: landlords; property manager; contact information.
rollCalls.summary: An emergency measure that prohibits a municipality or county from enacting or enforcing any noise ordinances, rules or regulations that prohibits any general construction activities during specified summertime hours.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: mandated health coverage; JLBC; analysis
rollCalls.summary: Requires an organization or individual advocating for a legislative proposal that would restrict the form or amount of cost sharing applied to a health plan benefit to report to the Joint Legislative Audit Committee (JLAC) on the social and financial impacts of the cost sharing restriction. Modifies the statutorily prescribed social and financial factors for the report .
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: AHCCCS; speech therapy; cochlear implants
rollCalls.summary: Requires the Arizona Health Care Cost Containment System (AHCCCS) to cover the costs of speech therapy and cochlear implants for eligible persons who are at least 21 years old.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: appropriation; dementia awareness
rollCalls.summary: Appropriates $750,000 from the state General Fund (state GF) in FY 2026 to the Department of Health Services (DHS) to implement a public education campaign to increase awareness of Alzheimer's disease and dementia.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: G&F; publications revolving fund
rollCalls.summary: Reverts any monies exceeding $250,000, rather than $80,000, in the Arizona Game and Fish Publications Revolving Fund (Revolving Fund) to the Arizona Game and Fish Fund.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: juvenile detention centers; education programs
rollCalls.summary: Prohibits an accommodation school from counting a pupil as being in attendance on a day that the pupil is counted as being a prisoner in a county jail education program or a student in a juvenile detention center education program (juvenile education program). Determines that a county may operate and fund, or operate but not fund, a county jail education program or a juvenile education program through an existing accommodation school.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: victims' rights; audio recordings; appeal
rollCalls.summary: Requires a law enforcement agency to provide crime victims with a free copy of any audio recordings within a police report and allows a victim to appeal a denied public records request as prescribed.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: school policies; wireless communications devices
rollCalls.summary: Requires each school district governing board (governing board) to develop and adopt a policy to limit students' use of wireless communications devices during instructional time. Outlines requirements that the policies may include.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: newly elected constables; training
rollCalls.summary: Allows an elected or appointed constable to request training from the Constable Ethics Standards and Training Board (CESTB) as prescribed.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: school safety; proposals; assessments; plans.
rollCalls.summary: Expands the School Safety Program (Program) to support the costs of placing school safety officers (SSOs) and by establishing an alternative Program proposal process to support the costs of purchasing safety equipment and infrastructure improvements as specified. Requires each school district and charter school to train officers how to interact with children with disabilities and each school that receives Program monies to develop an emergency response plan as outlined. Exempts school building blueprints and floor plans from public record requirements.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: agency accounts; technical correction
rollCalls.summary: Prohibits full-time state employees from working remotely with prescribed exemptions.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: animal bites; owner contact information
rollCalls.summary: Requires a person responsible for a dog that bites a person in a public or private place to provide the owner's contact information to the person who suffered the dog bite.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: board of executive clemency; continuation
rollCalls.summary: Continues the Board of Executive Clemency (BOEC) for 5 years.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: Arizona teachers academy; community colleges
rollCalls.summary: Conforms the state minimum legal age to buy or possess a tobacco product to the federal minimum legal age of 21. Allows National Guard or U.S. Armed Forces personnel who are at least 18 years old to possess, receive or use a tobacco product if specified conditions are met.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: technical correction; game and fish
rollCalls.summary: Appropriates $7,000,000 from the state General Fund (state GF) in FY 2026 to the University of Arizona (U of A) to construct a regional medical center in the City of Yuma.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: tax corrections act of 2025
rollCalls.summary: Corrects errors and obsolete language, addresses blending problems and provides clarifying changes to tax statutes.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: adjutant general; duties
rollCalls.summary: Modifies existing and prescribes additional requirements for a person to qualify as the Adjutant General of Arizona (TAG) or an Assistant TAG. Allows, rather than requires, TAG to establish an educational program and authorizes TAG to enter into contracts and agreements to support the program.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: extended foster care service model
rollCalls.summary: Requires the Department of Child Safety (DCS) to prepare a scope of work for an Extended Foster Care Comprehensive Service Model (Model) that includes supportive services and case management provided by contracted community providers for young adults who participate in the Extended Foster Care Program. Requires the Model to include an extended foster care success coaching program and prescribes program requirements.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: appropriation; crime victim notification fund
rollCalls.summary: Appropriates $2,594,840 from the state General Fund (state GF) in FY 2026 to the Law Enforcement Crime Victim Notification Fund (Fund).
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: coordinated reentry; grants; appropriation
rollCalls.summary: Appropriates $20,000,000 from the Consumer Restitution Subaccount of the Consumer Restitution and Remediation Revolving Fund (Revolving Fund) in FY 2026 to the Attorney General (AG) to distribute Coordinated Reentry Planning Services Program (Reentry Program) grants to participating counties and outlines related reporting requirements.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: AHCCCS; teledentistry; report
rollCalls.summary: Authorizes the Legislative Council to provide for the placement of a Don Bolles Memorial in the Wesley Bolin Plaza.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: probation supervision; transfer
rollCalls.summary: Removes the requirement that a request to courtesy transfer a probationer's supervision to another county be made at the time of sentencing or disposition.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: physical therapists; disability placards
rollCalls.summary: Allows a physical therapist to certify that a person has a physical disability on an application for a disability placard or special plate with an international symbol of access.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: evaluation agencies; hearings; witnesses
rollCalls.summary: Clarifies requirements related to certain witness testimony during a hearing for court ordered treatment and limits specified witness testimony to observed facts, not including expert opinion or conclusions.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: public records; notification; commercial purpose
rollCalls.summary: Requires a person submitting a public records request to affirm that the public record is not for a commercial purpose, or if the request is for a commercial purpose, requires the person to provide a statement that explains the intended use pursuant to statutory requirements for using the public records for a commercial purpose.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: digital assets strategic reserve fund
rollCalls.summary: Establishes the Digital Assets Strategic Reserve Fund (Fund), administered by the State Treasurer, and consisting of monies appropriated by the Legislature and digital assets seized by the state. Allows the State Treasurer to loan digital assets from the Fund, if the loan does not increase financial risk to the state.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: schools; health services; disclosures
rollCalls.summary: Requires a school district or charter school that provides routine healthcare services to students in a school health care office to provide a parent or guardian, upon request, the health care credentials of individuals who provide such services. Requires a school district or charter school to provide a parent or guardian, upon request, information describing the types of emergency response training that school employees must complete.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: liquor sampling; reporting; requirements
rollCalls.summary: Establishes the criminal classification of impersonating a veteran , which a person commits by knowingly misrepresenting themselves to be a veteran and engaging in specified acts with intent to obtain money, property or any other tangible benefit.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: DCS information; central registry; exceptions
rollCalls.summary: Requires the Department of Child Safety (DCS) to provide all DCS and central registry information to the Board of Fingerprinting (Board) for purposes of determining central registry exceptions. Subjects any person who knowingly discloses confidential DCS or central registry information to a class 5 felony.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: appropriation; braille transcription program
rollCalls.summary: Appropriates $400,000 from the state General Fund (state GF) in FY 2026 to the Arizona Department of Corrections, Rehabilitation and Reentry (ADCRR) for the Braille Transcription Program.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: epinephrine delivery systems
rollCalls.summary: Replaces statutory references to the term epinephrine auto-injector with the term epinephrine delivery system.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: study committee; scrap metal theft
rollCalls.summary: Establishes the Study Committee on Scrap Metal Theft (Study Committee).
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: law enforcement officers; probation; termination
rollCalls.summary: Modifies the permissive authority of an employer to terminate promoted or transferred law enforcement officers and police recruits under specified conditions and asseverates that an employer may terminate an officer at any time with just cause.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: liquor; consumption; watercraft
rollCalls.summary: Modifies the requirements, under a government series liquor license, to operate a dock and boats as a licensed premises for the sale and consumption of spirituous liquor.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: permanency placement; grandparent; priority
rollCalls.summary: Beginning January 1, 2026, establishes a claimant's ability to bring an action against the state for an erroneous conviction, with outlined procedures for the processing of the claim and entitlements to the claimant if the claim is granted.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: department of corrections; reporting; website
rollCalls.summary: Allows the Director of the Arizona Department of Corrections, Rehabilitation and Reentry (ADCRR) to post statutorily required information on the ADCRR website as prescribed.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: appropriation; satellite communication system
rollCalls.summary: Grants four peremptory challenges to each party to a civil action in the superior court and outlines procedures related to use, waiver and additional granting of peremptory challenges.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: employer-employee arbitration; contract; disputes
rollCalls.summary: Authorizes arbitration agreements for resolution of certain employment-related disputes between an employer and employee.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: occupational boards; renewal extension
rollCalls.summary: Outlines requirements for a health profession regulatory board (health board) or nonhealth licensing authority (licensing authority) if the processing of renewal applications for licenses or certifications is suspended.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: personal information: confidentiality; judge's families
rollCalls.summary: Allows a family member of a justice, judge, commissioner or hearing officer (judicial officer) with the same full name as the judicial officer to request that the court prohibit the general public from accessing specified personal information.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: personal property exemptions; vehicles
rollCalls.summary: Exempts a person's value in a homestead from bankruptcy proceedings, up to the amount of the homestead exemption plus any value increase during pendency of the case. Adds, to the property types that qualify for the $400,000 homestead exemption, park model trailers, motor homes, travel trailers, fifth wheel trailers, houseboats, manufactured homes and other forms of shelter in which a person resides, plus the land on which the shelter is located.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: personal property exemption; money proceeds
rollCalls.summary: Exempts all, rather than only the refundable portion of, federal or state Earned Income Tax Credits (EITCs) and any federal or state Child Tax Credits from specified actions to collect a debt.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: conservation easements; valuation
rollCalls.summary: Requires the Arizona Department of Revenue (ADOR) or a county assessor, when determining the full cash value (FCV) of a conservation easement, to use and apply standard appraisal practices and techniques unless a statutory formula takes precedence.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: campaign finance reports; filing dates
rollCalls.summary: Modifies filing requirements for various campaign finance reports and adds a postprimary report to the list of reports required to be filed as outlined.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: supplemental appropriation; Prescott rodeo grounds
rollCalls.summary: Redirects the FY 2024 $15,300,000 appropriation to the City of Prescott to renovate and repair the rodeo ground owned by the city, rather than to a nonprofit volunteer organization that operates a rodeo at the Yavapai County Fairgrounds.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: appropriation; Arizona America250 commission
rollCalls.summary: Appropriates $500,000 and 5 FTEs from the state General Fund (state GF) in FY 2026 to the Secretary of State (SOS) to support the Arizona America250 commission (commission).
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: America250 specialty plates
rollCalls.summary: Establishes an America250 special plate and the America250 Special Plate Fund (Fund).
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: document retention; proposals; donations
rollCalls.summary: Modifies the requirements under the Arizona Procurement Code and for the solicitation and award of grants by state governmental units.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: appropriation; State Route 347
rollCalls.summary: Appropriates $49,000,000 from the state General Fund (state GF) in FY 2026, rather than FY 2028, to the Arizona Department of Transportation (ADOT) to construct an overpass at Riggs Road and State Route 347.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: security guards; private investigators; licensure
rollCalls.summary: Extends the validity, from two years to four years, for private investigator and security guard agency licenses and related registration certificates and removes the 90-day limit on renewing licenses and certificates after expiration.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: appropriation; public safety training simulators
rollCalls.summary: Appropriates $400,000 from the state General Fund (state GF) in FY 2026 to the State Treasurer to pay for the public safety training simulators used by the Arizona State University Police Department (ASU PD) and the Santa Cruz County Sheriff's Office (SCSO).
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: narcotic drugs; definition
rollCalls.summary: Adds various drugs to the statutory definition of narcotic drug .
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: youth charity special plates
rollCalls.summary: Establishes a youth charity special plate and the Youth Charity Special Plate Fund (Fund).
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: health insurance; surprise billing; disputes
rollCalls.summary: Applies requirements related to providing notice to a health insurance enrollee regarding the enrollee's statutory right to dispute surprise out of network medical billing only to dispute resolution claims that are not subject to an independent dispute resolution (IDR) under the federal No Surprises Act (NSA).
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: Hopi Tribe special plates
rollCalls.summary: Establishes a Hopi Tribe special plate and transmits special plate donations to the Hopi Tribal Department of Public Safety and Emergency Services (DPSES).
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: county board of equalization; decisions
rollCalls.summary: Prohibits a county board of equalization's (county board's) decision on the valuation or legal classification of a petitioner's property from exceeding the county assessor's noticed valuation and recommended classification.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: veterans' donations fund; annual transfer
rollCalls.summary: Requires an annual transfer of 15 percent of Veterans' Donation Fund (VDF) monies to a State Homes for Veterans Trust Fund (SHVF) subaccount, as prescribed, and allocates specified resources to the Arizona Department of Veterans' Services (ADVS).
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: AHCCCS; obesity treatment; study committee
rollCalls.summary: Establishes the Obesity Treatment Study Committee (Study Committee) to study the cost, potential savings, effectiveness, health outcomes and value of expanding coverage under the Arizona Health Care Cost Containment System (AHCCCS) to include comprehensive treatment for people living with obesity. Outlines Study Committee membership, duties and reporting requirements.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: nonresident real estate sales; notice
rollCalls.summary: Modifies reporting requirements for the Arizona Department of Revenue (ADOR) relating to capital gains tax paid on and revenue collected from nonresident real estate sales in Arizona.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: GPLET; notice; abatement period
rollCalls.summary: Limits the revenues that may be abated during the government property lease excise tax (GPLET) abatement period by prohibiting GPLET revenue designated for school districts from being abated. Outlines posting requirements for GPLET leases, development agreements and notices.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: voter registration; temporary absence
rollCalls.summary: Removes the eligibility of certain U.S. citizens who have never resided within the United States to register to vote and cast a vote in Arizona by using the federal write-in early ballot.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: move over law; study committee
rollCalls.summary: Establishes the Efficacy of Arizona's Move Over Law Study Committee (Study Committee).
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: legal tender; cryptocurrency
rollCalls.summary: Defines legal tender to include cryptocurrency and applies the definition to all Arizona Revised Statutes.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: voting; equipment; internet; custody; violation
rollCalls.summary: Prescribes various security requirements for vote recording equipment and tabulating equipment that is certified for use in elections in Arizona.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: tax deed land sales; procedures
rollCalls.summary: Modifies the procedures for a county board of supervisors (county BOS) to sell tax deeded real property that is held by the state.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: school districts; bonds; overrides; ballots
rollCalls.summary: Prescribes required ballot language for elections related to a school district budget override continuation or a school district's authority to continue issuing and selling bonds that states the estimated average secondary property tax reduction if voters reject the override or bond proposal.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: designated countries; land ownership; prohibition
rollCalls.summary: Bars the People's Republic of China (PRC) from having a substantial ownership interest in Arizona land, outlines requirements for enforcement and prescribes related exceptions.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: groundwater model; receipt; written findings
rollCalls.summary: Requires the Director of the Arizona Department of Water Resources (ADWR) to provide notification of receipt within five days and an outlined written response within 60 days to applicants who submit alternative groundwater models.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: residential utilities; consumer office; definition
rollCalls.summary: Defines represents the interests of as advocating for the safest and most reliable utility service achievable at the lowest retail rate possible.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: assessor's valuations; special districts; petitions
rollCalls.summary: Clarifies the property type and assessed valuation that is used during the process to establish fire, community park maintenance, sanitary or hospital special taxing districts.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: dental board; oral preventive assistants
rollCalls.summary: Establishes a pathway for dental assistants to practice as oral preventative assistants (OPA) upon completion of a training course approved by the Arizona State Board of Dental Examiners (BODEX) and outlines OPA scope of practice.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: ADWR; application; review; time frames
rollCalls.summary: Outlines requirements for a county water augmentation authority (Authority) to issue revenue bonds, hold public hearings relating to the issuance of revenue bonds and enter into loan repayment agreements with the Water Infrastructure Finance Authority (WIFA).
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: write-in candidate; filing deadline; cancellation
rollCalls.summary: Requires a write-in candidate to file a nomination paper no later than 5:00 p.m. on the 92nd, rather than 106th, day before an election that may be cancelled due to lack of competing candidates.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: special deposits; banks; requirements; definitions
rollCalls.summary: Adopts the Uniform Special Deposits Act (Act), which governs bank deposits made under an account agreement that designates at least one beneficiary who may receive payments from the deposit, subject to a contingency. Outlines bank requirements and responsibilities and special deposit permissible purposes and termination requirements.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: vehicle titles; out-of-state purchase
rollCalls.summary: Allows a vehicle certificate of title pending registration to be issued for a vehicle purchased by a state resident from an out-of-state dealer as prescribed.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: townsites; trustees; board of supervisors.
rollCalls.summary: Designates the trustee of a townsite as the county board of supervisors (county BOS) of the county in which the townsite is located, rather than the judge of the superior court.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: China; public funds; divestment
rollCalls.summary: Prohibits publicly managed funds from holding certain investments in the People's Republic of China or in companies owned or controlled by, or domiciled within, the People's Republic of China or other specified Chinese entities. Requires publicly managed funds to immediately divest from the prohibited companies, with exceptions.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: property tax; limited property value
rollCalls.summary: Adds properties that previously qualified for a property valuation protection option or a statutory valuation and no longer qualify to the circumstances that require the county assessor to determine the property's limited property value (LPV) at a level or percentage of full cash value (FCV) that is comparable to other properties of the same or similar use or classification.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: child abduction; biological family relationship
rollCalls.summary: Modifies the conditions that classify abduction of a child from a state agency as a class 1 misdemeanor, rather than a prescribed felony, by including an adult with a biological family relationship to the child.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: hospitals; patient immigration status; reporting
rollCalls.summary: Requires hospitals that accept payment from the Arizona Health Care Cost Containment System (AHCCCS) to include on patient admission forms a place to indicate citizenship status and prescribes quarterly reporting requirements.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: ballots; count; identification number; appropriation
rollCalls.summary: Requires ballots that are used for an election in Arizona to be numbered and prescribes requirements relating to the distribution of the numbered ballots. Requires the county recorder or other officer in charge of elections to maintain a count of the physical ballots and post the count on the county's website.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: elections; canvass; certification; acknowledgment
rollCalls.summary: Requires the governing body holding an election to acknowledge the canvass of the election without prejudice.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: fraudulent voice recordings
rollCalls.summary: Classifies, as criminal impersonation subject to a class 5 felony, using a computer generated voice recording, image or video of another person with intent to defraud other persons.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: unclaimed property; department of revenue
rollCalls.summary: Allows the Cochise County Board of Supervisors (BOS) or the Graham County BOS to vote to place on the 2026 general election ballot a question of whether to designate the portion of the San Simon Valley Groundwater Subbasin that is located in Cochise County or Graham County as an irrigation non-expansion area (INA).
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: public utilities; electric grid improvements
rollCalls.summary: Requires the Arizona Corporation Commission (ACC), during the integrated resource planning process, to require a public service corporation to ensure that any changes to maintain or improve an electric power grid are capable of producing enough electricity to provide safe, adequate and reliable service throughout the year.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: false documents; recording; violations
rollCalls.summary: Increases, from a class 1 misdemeanor to a class 4 felony, the penalty for knowingly filing a forged or groundless, materially misstated or otherwise invalid document with the county recorder asserting a person's claim to real property.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: west valley charity specialty plates
rollCalls.summary: Establishes a west valley charity special plate and the West Valley Charity Special Plate Fund (Fund).
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: income tax rate; reduction; surplus
rollCalls.summary: Directs the Joint Legislative Budget Committee (JLBC) to determine certain state revenue metrics beginning in FY 2026 and requires, for each taxable year beginning January 1, 2026, the Arizona Department of Revenue (ADOR) to reduce the individual income tax rate by 50 percent of the structural surplus, as determined by JLBC.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: implements of husbandry; autonomous; automated
rollCalls.summary: Expands the definition of an implement of husbandry to add an implement or vehicle that is an autonomous vehicle or uses an autonomous driving system.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: state broadband office; transfer; ADOA
rollCalls.summary: Transfers authority of the State Broadband Office (Office) from the Arizona Commerce Authority (ACA) to the Arizona Department of Administration (ADOA).
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: income tax subtraction; capital gains
rollCalls.summary: Applies, to taxable years beginning January 1, 2026, the 25 percent individual income tax subtraction for net long-term capital gains included in federal adjusted gross income to all assets, rather than only assets acquired beginning January 1, 2012.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: homeowner's associations; violations; notice
rollCalls.summary: Requires written notice of violation (written notice) from a condominium unit owners' association (COA) or planned community association (HOA) to provide outlined information about the alleged violation and the process by which the person may respond and petition on the matter.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: charter schools; access; decision-making authority
rollCalls.summary: Authorizes a charter representative, charter school governing body member and officer, director, member and partner of a charter holder, as allowed by the charter holder, to have access to the charter school's student records and campuses and authority to make final decisions regarding learning and safety for the charter school's students and campus.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: commercial motor vehicles; civil penalties
rollCalls.summary: Allows the driver of a large truck to deviate from the lane to the extent necessary to make a right or left turn, lowers penalties prescribed for outlined commercial vehicle violations from misdemeanors to civil penalties, standardizes statutory definitions for commercial vehicles and vehicle weights and reconciles related requirements.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: political signs; homeowners' associations
