rollCalls.summary: Adds a flag to the definition of a political sign for a condominium unit owners' association (COA) or planned community association (HOA).
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: property tax oversight commission; continuation
rollCalls.summary: Continues the Property Tax Oversight Commission (PTOC) for eight years.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: attorney discipline investigations; costs
rollCalls.summary: Allows an attorney who prevails in an attorney discipline matter to file a claim against the State Bar of Arizona (SBA), if the attorney has suffered damage to their reputation.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: school districts; partisan elections
rollCalls.summary: Requires a school district governing board candidate's political party to appear on the ballot.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: parental rights; compensatory damages
rollCalls.summary: Requires compensatory damages awarded for violations of the Parents' Bill of Rights to total at least $2,500 for each violation.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: lifetime injunction; undesignated offenses
rollCalls.summary: Requires a class 6 felony offense, before the offense has been designated as a felony or a misdemeanor by the court, to be treated as a felony for the purpose of issuing a lifetime injunction.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: initiatives; existing laws; impact statement
rollCalls.summary: Requires initiative descriptions to include a list of statutes that are likely to conflict with or be impacted by the proposed measure with a brief summary of how the statutes may conflict.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: tax laws; interpretation; application; hearing
rollCalls.summary: Requires the Arizona Department of Revenue (ADOR) to notify the Legislature of a proposed interpretation or application of tax law that will adversely affect taxpayers before the new interpretation or application is adopted and requires ADOR to provide testimony regarding the interpretation or application, if the Legislature holds a hearing.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: tax credit; qualifying charitable organizations
rollCalls.summary: Modifies the definitions of qualifying charitable organizations (QCOs) and services for the purposes of the Credit for Contributions to QCOs.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: grid security; cybersecurity; reviews; commission
rollCalls.summary: Requires the Arizona Corporation Commission (ACC) to conduct a grid security review at least every two years or as a part of the ACC's integrated resource planning process or biennial transmission assessment and make outlined assessments and evaluations when conducting the review.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: homestead exemption; equity increase
rollCalls.summary: Requires certain municipalities to allow hotels and multifamily residential housing as an ancillary use in a district zoned for light industrial use without requiring an application that will require a public hearing if the ancillary use is located within an international headquarters campus and developed in accordance with prescribed standards.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: second degree murder; presumptive sentence
rollCalls.summary: Increases the presumptive prison sentence for a person who commits second degree murder, from 16 to 20 calendar years, if the person has no prior convictions of second degree murder or outlined felonies, and, from 20 to 25 calendar years, if the person has a prior conviction of second degree murder or an outlined felony.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: narcotic drugs; death; sentence enhancement
rollCalls.summary: Establishes a specific sentencing range for persons convicted of selling a narcotic drug if the narcotic drug sold contributed to the death of another person.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: school transparency portal; reporting; requirements
rollCalls.summary: Requires each school district and charter school to annually post a copy of the previous fiscal year's general ledger, including receipts of revenues, expenditures and disbursements, on the school district's or charter school's website by October 1. Specifies information that a school district or charter school must include and exclude from the general ledger for the posting requirement.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: school districts; overexpenditures; ADE; notice
rollCalls.summary: Requires, if the Arizona Department of Education (ADE) determines without prior notification from a county school superintendent that a school district's expenditures exceed the school district's general budget limit or unrestricted capital budget limit, ADE to notify the county school superintendent and take any required actions prescribed by statute. Allows a county school superintendent to review the operations and finances of each school district within the county.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: fentanyl; nine grams
rollCalls.summary: Decreases, from 200 grams to 9 grams, the amount of fentanyl that must be involved in a sale to another person for specific sentencing ranges for fentanyl sales to apply.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: medical schools; admissions; in-state students
rollCalls.summary: Effective January 1, 2027, requires a public university medical school (medical school) to give priority consideration in the first round of admissions interviews to applicants from Arizona who meet prescribed admissions qualifications and requirements and to offer an interview to such applicants from Arizona. Outlines admissions information that a medical school must include in promotional materials and on the medical school's website and reporting requirements for medical schools to demonstrate compliance with the prescribed requirements.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: revenue increases; administrative fee authorization
rollCalls.summary: Subject to voter approval, constitutionally eliminates the exemption from the two-thirds vote requirement for legislative acts that provide for an increase in state revenues in the form of fees and assessments that are authorized by statute and set by a state officer or agency but that are not prescribed by formula, amount or limit.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: surplus; income tax rate; reduction
rollCalls.summary: Subject to voter approval, statutorily directs the Joint Legislative Budget Committee (JLBC) to determine certain state revenue metrics beginning in FY 2028 and requires, for each taxable year beginning January 1, 2028, the Arizona Department of Revenue (ADOR) to reduce the individual income tax rate by 50 percent of the structural surplus, as determined by JLBC.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: internal revenue code; conformity.
rollCalls.summary: Conforms Arizona tax statutes to the U.S. Internal Revenue Code (U.S. IRC) as of January 1, 2025, to reflect changes adopted by the U.S. Congress during 2024.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: foreign entities; land; legislative approval
rollCalls.summary: Prohibits land in Arizona from being conveyed to a foreign entity that is hostile to the United States.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: residential contractor assessments; recovery fund
rollCalls.summary: Reduces the maximum assessment paid by a residential contractor every two years and prescribes adjustments to the assessment amount based on the total balance of the Residential Contractors' Recovery Fund (Fund) at the end of a fiscal year.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: international medical licensees; provisional licensure
rollCalls.summary: Effective January 1, 2026, allows the Arizona Medical Board (AMB) and the Arizona Board of Osteopathic Examiners in Medicine and Surgery (ABOE) to grant a provisional medical license to an international medical licensee who meets outlined criteria and who is licensed to practice in a country other than the United States, as prescribed.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: DCS information; review; location
rollCalls.summary: Allows a legislative review of Department of Child Safety (DCS) information to occur at a secure location within a legislative chamber within 10 working days of the records request.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: child neglect; exception; financial resources
rollCalls.summary: Prohibits the inability of a parent, guardian or custodian to provide a child with supervision, clothing, food, shelter or medical care, solely due to a lack of available financial resources, from being considered neglect of a child.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: counties; board; administrative review; approval
rollCalls.summary: Expands the administrative review and approval of certain planning and development documentation by a county.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: state fire marshal; phased permitting
rollCalls.summary: Establishes phased permitting for construction projects that are reviewed and approved by the Office of the State Fire Marshal (Office). Authorizes municipalities to review and approve certain construction permits in lieu of approval from the Office.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: pronouns; biological sex; school policies
rollCalls.summary: Prohibits a school district or charter school employee or independent contractor from, without parental permission, knowingly referring to a student under 18 years old by a pronoun that differs from the pronoun that aligns with the person's biological sex or a first name that is not listed in school records. Precludes a school district or charter school from requiring an employee or independent contractor to use a pronoun that differs from a person's biological sex if doing so is contrary to their convictions.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: photo enforcement systems; prohibition
rollCalls.summary: Prohibits a local authority or state agency from using a photo enforcement system to identify violators of speed restrictions or traffic control devices.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: critical infrastructure; prohibited agreements
rollCalls.summary: Prohibits a business or government entity in Arizona from entering into an agreement with a company if the company would be able to access or control critical infrastructure in Arizona or is owned or controlled by the citizens or government of, or headquartered in, China, Iran, North Korea or Russia, except as prescribed.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: critical telecommunications infrastructure; construction requirements
rollCalls.summary: Effective January 1, 2026, establishes the Secure Telecommunications Act of 2025 which prohibits, and requires the removal of, any critical telecommunications infrastructure that uses equipment manufactured by a foreign adversary and prescribes reporting requirements for telecommunications providers and penalties for noncompliance.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: public resources; influencing elections; penalties
rollCalls.summary: Specifies that a resident may initiate a suit for a city's, town's, county's or school district's violation of the prohibition on the use of public resources to influence an election and requires civil penalties collected by the court to be paid to the resident.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: manufacturer plates; proof of contract
rollCalls.summary: Allows a person to use an unladen truck or passenger vehicle that is owned by a manufacturer (manufacturer vehicle) for personal transportation, if other evidence of a contract and designation is present in the vehicle.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: vehicle mileage; tracking; tax; prohibitions
rollCalls.summary: Establishes prohibitions on recording a person's vehicle miles of travel, imposing a fee, charge or tax based on vehicle miles traveled and considering or establishing any vehicle miles of travel reduction goals or targets, as prescribed.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: government investments; products; fiduciaries; plans
rollCalls.summary: Requires a fiduciary to take into account only pecuniary factors when evaluating an investment or discharging the fiduciary's duties with respect to a plan and outlines plan voting of ownership interests and proxy voting. Prescribes requirements and prohibitions relating to the State Treasurer's investments.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: business; discrimination prohibition; social criteria
rollCalls.summary: Prohibits a financial institution, insurer or credit reporting agency from discriminating against any person based on a political affiliation or other social credit, environmental, social or governmental score or similar values-based or impact criteria.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: medical marijuana dispensaries; location
rollCalls.summary: Prohibits a nonprofit medical marijuana dispensary or cultivation site from being within 500 feet of a child care facility or facility that provides preschool programs. Prohibits a locality from enacting any ordinance or rule that allows a marijuana establishment to be located within 500 feet of a public school, private school, child care facility or facility that provides preschool programs. Contains requirements for enactment for initiatives and referendums (Proposition 105).
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: grade levels; 9/11 instruction
rollCalls.summary: An emergency measure that limits the requirement to provide age-appropriate instruction on 9/11 Education Day to students in grades 7 through 12.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: open meetings; call to public
rollCalls.summary: Requires an open call to the public in a meeting of a public body to be made at the beginning of the meeting and before the public body conducts any official business. Outlines requirements relating to the conduct of an open call to the public.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: public schools; safety; reporting requirements
rollCalls.summary: Requires the Arizona Department of Education (ADE), by December 15, to annually submit a school safety report that includes specified information reported to the U.S. Department of Education Office of Civil Rights for the Civil Rights Data Collection survey (CRDC). Requires each Arizona public school and local education agency (LEA) to post a link on its website the most recent information reported to the U.S. Department of Education for the CRDC.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: diversity; equity; inclusion; training; prohibition
rollCalls.summary: Prohibits the state or an agency, board, commission or department of the state from requiring participation in diversity, equity and inclusion (DEI) programs or using DEI programs for hiring, training, or promotion.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: public schools; volunteer chaplains; authorization
rollCalls.summary: Authorizes a school district governing board (governing board) or charter school governing body (governing body) to allow volunteer school chaplains to provide support, services and programs to students and outlines policy requirements each governing board and governing body must adopt regarding volunteer school chaplains. Requires a school principal to ensure that each volunteer school chaplain meets outlined requirements, including the fingerprinting, affidavit form and background investigation requirements for school employment.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: aggravated unlawful flight; law enforcement
rollCalls.summary: Establishes the offense of aggravated unlawful flight from a pursuing law enforcement vehicle and classifies a violation as a class 4 felony, or a class 2 felony depending on the nature of the offense.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: municipalities; counties; recycling; prohibition
rollCalls.summary: Prohibits a municipality, county or other political subdivision of the state from recommending or requiring that a resident place any product in a recycling bin that is not being actively recycled in present time.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: performance audits; auditor general
rollCalls.summary: Requires the Auditor General (OAG) to conduct performance audits of an agency or political subdivision to determine whether the required terms and conditions are being met, if requested by the Joint Legislative Audit Committee (JLAC).
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: JLAC; attorney general's office; audit
rollCalls.summary: Requires the Joint Legislative Audit Committee (JLAC) to conduct a review of the Department of Law and the Attorney General's office (AG) at least every 10 years.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: mandatory reporting; school employees; investigations
rollCalls.summary: Adds school district governing board (governing board) and charter school governing body (governing body) members to the list of individuals subject to the duty to report abuse, physical injury, neglect and denial or deprivation of medical care or nourishment of minors (abuse of minors). Expands reporting and investigation requirements relating to the duty to report immoral or unprofessional conduct.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: prohibit tax; monitoring; vehicle mileage
rollCalls.summary: Subject to voter approval, constitutionally prohibits a tax or fee based on vehicle miles traveled or any rule or law that monitors or limits vehicle miles traveled and outlines exemptions to the prohibition.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: municipalities; counties; vote; fee increases
rollCalls.summary: Subject to voter approval, statutorily prohibits the common council of a municipality or the board of supervisors of a county from increasing an assessment, tax or fee without a two-thirds vote of the governing body.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: early voting; tabulation; ballot deadlines
rollCalls.summary: Requires a voted early ballot that is deposited at a voting location to be received by the voting location not later than 7:00 p.m. on the Friday before election day in order to be counted and valid. Allows county recorders to provide for on-site tabulation of early ballots at any time during the period of early voting, rather than only on election day. Eliminates emergency voting that occurs between 7:00 p.m. on the Friday before election day and 5:00 p.m. on the Monday before election day.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: ROTC cadets; in-state student status
rollCalls.summary: Expands eligibility for in-state student classification by including contracted cadets participating in a Reserve Officer Training Corp (ROTC) program in Arizona.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: small claims court; jurisdictional limit
rollCalls.summary: Increases, from $3,500 to $5,000, the jurisdictional limit for the small claims division of the justice court.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: animal seizure; bond amount
rollCalls.summary: Increases, from $25 per animal to $500 per animal, the bond that a person must post to cover the cost of care for an animal that was properly seized by law enforcement.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: recall elections; procedures; timeline
rollCalls.summary: Modifies prescribed statutory timeframes for recall elections, including timeframes related to petition signatures, nomination petitions and the date on which a recall election must be held. Deems invalid any nomination petition signatures that are collected before a candidate's statement of interest is filed and before the recall application is filed.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: retirement; reemployment; school resource officers
rollCalls.summary: Exempts school resource officers (SROs) from limitations on receiving pensions payments from the Public Safety Personnel Retirement System (PSPRS) after retiring and subsequently becoming reemployed.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: railroad grade crossing; on-track equipment
rollCalls.summary: Applies railroad crossing regulations to other on-track equipment .
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: newborn screening; Duchenne muscular dystrophy
rollCalls.summary: Effective October 1, 2027, or two years from the date Duchenne muscular dystrophy is added to the Recommended Uniform Screening Panel (RUSP), expands the Department of Health Services' (DHS') newborn screening requirements to include screening for Duchenne muscular dystrophy.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: appropriations; victims of crime; services
rollCalls.summary: Appropriates a total of $20,650,000 from the state General Fund (state GF) in FY 2026 to the Arizona Criminal Justice Commission (ACJC), the Department of Economic Security (DES) and the Department of Public Safety (DPS) to backfill funding for services paid for with monies received by the state from the VOCA Fix to Sustain the Crime Victims Fund Act of 2021 (Act).
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: constables; report; board of supervisors
rollCalls.summary: Bars a foreign adversary nation or agent from having a substantial interest of 30 percent or more in real property in Arizona, outlines requirements for enforcement and prescribes related exceptions. Classifies making a false report of a violation to the prohibition as a class 1 misdemeanor.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: police reports; victims; prosecuting agency
rollCalls.summary: Broadens the responsibility of providing outlined information to crime victims to include the charging prosecutorial agency.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: motorcycle safety fund continuation
rollCalls.summary: Continues the deposit of $1 of each motorcycle registration fee into the Motorcycle Safety Fund (Fund), holds Fund monies in trust and immunizes Fund monies from being used for any purpose other than as prescribed.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: property tax exemption; virtual currency
rollCalls.summary: Subject to voter approval, constitutionally exempts virtual currency from property tax.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: public schools; restrooms; reasonable accommodations
rollCalls.summary: Requires a public school to provide access to a single-occupancy or employee restroom or changing facility to a person who is unwilling or unable to use a multi-occupancy restroom or changing facility designated for the person's sex or multi-occupancy sleeping quarters. Grants a private cause of action, against the public school, to a person who encounters a person of the opposite sex in specified areas. Designates this legislation as the Arizona Accommodations for All Children Act (Act).
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: health boards; fund balances; fees
rollCalls.summary: Requires a health profession regulatory board (health board) or nonhealth profession licensing authority (licensing authority) to temporarily reduce or eliminate licensing or application fees if its fund balance exceeds a prescribed amount.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: engineers; alterations; commercial space
rollCalls.summary: Adds to the prescribed practices that are exempt from the Arizona Board of Technical Registration's (AZBTR) compliance requirements.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: personal property exemption; increase
rollCalls.summary: Effective January 1, 2026, increases the business personal property tax exemption to $500,000.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: pharmacy benefits; prescribing; exemption
rollCalls.summary: Prohibits a pharmacy benefit manager (PBM) from limiting or excluding coverage of a prescription drug for any covered individual who is on a specific prescription drug if outlined conditions are met. Prescribes formulary change notification requirements and establishes a formulary prescription drug exception process.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: demand calculator; rules; conservation code
rollCalls.summary: An emergency measure that requires the Director of the Arizona Department of Water Resources (ADWR) to adopt rules to update ADWR's project demand calculator every five years.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: elections; foreign contributions; prohibition
rollCalls.summary: Prohibits foreign corporations, persons and nongovernmental sources from contributing monies or in-kind goods or services to influence the outcome of an election on a ballot measure.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: appropriations; nuclear emergency management fund
rollCalls.summary: An emergency measure that appropriates monies from the Nuclear Emergency Management Fund (Fund) to the Department of Emergency and Military Affairs (DEMA) and the Arizona Department of Agriculture (AZDA) in FY 2026 and FY 2027 to implement the state off-site nuclear emergency response plan (plan).
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: municipalities; counties; fee increases; vote
rollCalls.summary: Prohibits the common council of a municipality or the board of supervisors of a county from increasing an assessment, tax or fee without a two-thirds vote of the governing body. Declares the regulation of increases in municipal or county assessments, taxes and fees to be a matter of statewide concern and preempts further regulation by a municipality or county.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: blockchain technology; tax; fee; prohibition
rollCalls.summary: Declares the regulation of the imposition of a tax or fee on a person or entity running a node on blockchain technology to be a matter of statewide concern and preempts further regulation by a city, town or county.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: school board candidates; electronic signatures.
rollCalls.summary: Includes school district governing board candidates on the list of elected offices for which the Secretary of State (SOS) must provide the means for qualified electors to electronically sign nomination petitions using the online signature collection system (E-Qual).
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: appropriations; named claimants
rollCalls.summary: Appropriates monies from various funds to named claimants in FY 2025.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: liquified petroleum gas containers; penalties.
rollCalls.summary: Raises the penalty for the unauthorized filling, evacuating or defacing of a liquefied petroleum gas container.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: medical boards; complaints; time limit
rollCalls.summary: Requires the Arizona Medical Board (AMB) and the Arizona Board of Osteopathic Examiners in Medicine and Surgery (ABOE) to take final action on a complaint unrelated to protecting the public health and safety within one year of receiving the complaint.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: obstetrics; gynecology services; rural communities
rollCalls.summary: Requires the Department of Health Services (DHS) to convene stakeholders and staff to develop recommendations to ensure obstetrics and gynecology services are provided in low-volume, high-risk rural communities and report its recommendations to the Governor, the President of the Senate and the Speaker of the House of Representatives by December 31, 2026.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading
